name: 2025 Kindness Matters Walk - CA
description:
The Kindness Matters Walk will be held in-person in Fullerton, CA on Thanksgiving morning and virtually wherever you are for 2025!  All participants are encouraged to register online in advance of the walk.

How does the virtual walk work?  You can run, walk, rollerblade, kayak, or even push a stroller on your own 5K.  It’s your choice!  We will be streaming a live event complete with giveaways, contests, speakers, and more on 11/27/2025 at 8:00 am PST.  Post pictures of you/your group as you do your activity, and post to Facebook and Instagram with the hashtag "#KMWalk2025" - we would love to see you!

Event Challenge:

Starting on 11/14/25 through 11/26/25, participants can log miles walked, ran, biked or swam.  We'll have some awards for those participants with the most miles.  *** If you want to participate in the event challenge (i.e., who walks or runs the most miles), you will need to register for the virtual walk - and of course you are welcome to walk in-person on 11/27 in Fullerton even if you register for the virtual walk ***

Registration is simple - just click the "Sign Up" button to start your registration process.  Register yourself or others in your family/group - and please create or join an existing team if you'd like.  Registration is $20 per person ($10 for ages 0-18).  Each participant will have the option during the registration process to select an "add on" walk shirt.  The add-on purchase options will only be available until: 10/31/2025.

You also have the option to make a donation directly to the KM Legacy Fund at the Orange County Community Foundation at oc-cf.org - another great way to support the KM Legacy Foundation! (optional)

Kindness is cool ... and so are our sponsors!  You will see our event sponsors on the screens during registration.  Please help support these companies/groups as they have so generously supported the KM Legacy Foundation.  Thank you sponsors!

Proceeds from the KM Walk support brain tumor research at a national level, and young adult leadership development opportunities locally in the Fullerton Joint Union High School District.

name: 2025 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.2.25
description:
2025 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.2.25. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon,  RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

2025 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.2.25. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon,  RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2025 Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot
description:
The annual Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot celebrates its 11th Year on Thanksgiving Day 2025! Please come be part of the family fun...

REGISTER TODAY and join us at The Palisades Village Green in downtown Pacific Palisades on Thanksgiving morning -- November 27th -- to get your holiday season off to a running start!

(NOTE: The 10K course is a second lap of the 5K course)

In order to keep this tradition going strong, we must minimize the impact we place upon the neighborhoods along the course route. Being respectful to our community has always been an important priority as we strive to continue this holiday tradition.

10 Things to Know for About The 11th Annual Pacific Palisades Turkey Trot…(Please check back in October on updated site and parking information)

  1. Parking is available in and around the Alphabet Streets
  2. If you live near Palisades Village, please walk. Less cars = better experience for everyone involved with the event
  3. Head directly to Sunset & Swarthmore and look for the Registration Area
  4. Festivities start at 7:30 AM -- the earlier you come, the more fun your day will be
  5. Both the 5K and 10K start at 8:30 AM. The race program will conclude by 11AM
  6. Fast runners to the front. Slower runners, walkers and strollers please move to the back of the field
  7. Dogs allowed this year. Please lean up after your dog (bring bags) and be mindful of other runners.
  8. Medals and Water will be available at the Finish Line
  9. 5k runners ideally should finish by 9:30 AM. 10K runners by 10:30 AM
  10. Medical Staff will be on-site

name: 2025 RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM - "Together we can Wipe-Out DM"
description:
🐾 Baroooo! Welcome Everypawdy! 🐾
We’re tail-wagging excited that you’re joining us for this year’s RACE at Your Own Pace to #ShadeOutDM!

This year, we're doing things a little differently - and we can't wait to see how YOU Bark Out Loud for the pups! Our goal? To quadruple the awareness about Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) by inspiring dog lovers everywhere to take action alongside you.
Because let's face it - everyone knows at least one dog lover!

This year’s design gives you new and creative ways to build your own community, honor dogs past and present, and help prevent this heartbreaking disease.

 
🌟 Event Details

  • Location: Wherever you are! It’s virtual so walk, run, ride, or roll from your own neighborhood.
  • Dates:  November 9-16, 2025
  • Registration: FREE! (But we kindly suggest a $25 donation to help us continue our mission.)
  • RACE Packet, FAQs, and More: Scroll below for full details!

 ******************************************************

 🐶 Why We RACE

Because some pups can’t - and we can!
Degenerative Myelopathy (DM) is a devastating disease, but the good news is it’s preventable through proper genetic testing prior to breeding. Together, we’re barking out loud to spread awareness and save future pups.

 ****************************************************** 

🚶🏽‍♀️ Ways to Participate

Choose your style - move your way!

🏃 Competitive Runners

  • "The Fast & the Furriest 5K Run" - Fastest 5K in a single day
  • “Iron Paw Endurance Challenge” - Most miles run total over the week

🚶 Competitive Walkers

  • “The ShadeOutDM Sprint” - Longest distance walked in a single day (tie-breaker: fastest time)
  • “Miles for Mutts Marathon” - Most miles walked total over the week

🐕 Dog Jog

  • Are you already walking your dog daily? Make it count by participating virtually with your pup(s) – non competitive
  • There will be a special award for the “Top Dog Distance Challenge” - Top 10 distances on our WoofTrax Event

🐾 Couch Dog - (Supporter)

  • Don’t want to go out, but still want to cheer us on? This is your moment! Every event needs a barking fan club - and we know a few pups who’d rather bark from the window. WOOF, BORK, WOOF!

🚴 Cruisin’ for Dogs

  • 🚴 “Pedal for the Pups” (Bicycle) - Top Pedal-Powered Distance (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🏍️ "The Ruff Riders " (Motorcycle) - Ruff Rider Mileage Master (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛴 ,"Sidewalk Surfers" (Scooter) - Scooter Squad Mileage Leader Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)
  • 🛹 "Shreddin’ to Save Tails" (Skateboard) - Gnarliest Skate Miles Logged total over the week
  • 🛼 "Skates, Blades & Barks" (Roller skates, Roller blades, Ice Skates) - Distance Award (Most miles skated total over the week)
  • 🐴 "Hoofbeats for Hope" (horse) - Distance Award (Most miles ridden total over the week)

🏊‍♂️ Surf & Swim Supporters for Dogs

  • 🏊‍♂️ "The Big Splash Swim"  Furthest distance swam over the full week
  • 🏄‍♂️"Ride the Tide Challenge" Awards for the Most consecutive days surfed over the week

🐶 Aqua Paws - Pup Swim or Dog Surf

  • 🐶🏊 "Doggy Paddle Dash" - ALL swims logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • 🐶🏄 "Surf’s Pup Showdown" - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES! 

NEW! ♿ Wheelin’ Warriors 💪💜 - for our handi’cappable people and pups with any type of disability or special need who want to roll, stroll, or simply be part of the race community! 

We proudly include participants using wheelchairs, mobility scooters, adaptive devices, or living with mobility, sensory, cognitive, or chronic health conditions - and of course, our amazing pups in wheels too. 🐾🦽

  • "Pups With Grit" (pups in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Racing with Heart" (people in wheels) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Rolling, Not Strolling" (mobility scooters) - ALL rides logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!
  • "Adaptive Allies" (handicappable people) - ALL walks logged will be eligible for additional PRIZES!

You're not just joining a race, you’re helping us show the world what strength, heart, and inclusion really look like.

 

*Log your miles by using our Group "2025 Walk to Wipe-Out DM by ShadeOutDM" on WoofTrax https://link.wooftrax.com/lxa416 
 

******************************************************

👕 How to Get Your Official RACE T-Shirt

Only participants who raise $200 or more will receive an official Shade Out DM Race T-Shirt!
This reward is based on individual fundraising totals - not team totals or general donations - so be sure your donations are credited to your personal page!

Check out our Fundraising Prize Wave (below)  -  Additional shipping charges may apply for shipping outside the USA.

🎯 Make it your goal to earn a shirt, and challenge your friends, family, and coworkers to earn theirs too!

 ******************************************************

📌 How to Sign Up

  1. Register Online
    Choose to support an existing team or start your own.
  2. Start a Warrior Team
    If your dog has taken or is taking the DM journey, start a Warrior Team in their honor. (You don't have to have a pup with DM to start a team, Teams can be Advocacy, Corporate, Rescues, Schools, Clubs, etc.)
  3. Get Your Bib
    You’ll receive a race bib via email (check spam or log into your profile).
  4. Strike a Pose!📸
    Snap a photo of your pup (or stuffed animal!) wearing sunglasses and your race bib.
  5. Post & Tag!
    Share on social media during race week and tag #ShadeOutDM in ALL your posts!
    (Let’s flood the feed and get people asking, “What’s DM?”)

Build your Team Early to ensure you receive your Prizes prior to RACE week! (International winners may choose to donate back their prizes or may be asked to cover the additional shipping fees)

Prizes will begin shipping mid October - While supplies last! *

****************************************************** 

🧬 About Degenerative Myelopathy (DM)

DM is often called the canine version of ALS (Lou Gehrig’s Disease). It’s a progressive, genetic disease affecting the spinal cord and over 100 dog breeds (& mixed breeds now too). Symptoms usually appear between ages 8-14, starting with ONE hind-leg weakness & loss of coordination, eventually leading to full paralysis, incontinence, organ failure, and respiratory failure all while their mind is still fully aware.

The tragedy?

  • Many vets still don’t know about DM
  • It’s often misdiagnosed
  • It’s entirely preventable with genetic testing

DM is on the rise - NOW is the time to speak up for the pups!

******************************************************

💜 About Shade Out DM Foundation

Shade Out DM Foundation is a 100% volunteer-run, registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We are dedicated to:
📚 Educating ~ 💬 Supporting ~ ♿ Loaning ~ 📣 Advocating

Our Mission:
To improve the health and well-being of dogs affected by DM while preventing future cases through awareness and education.

Your Support Helps:

  • Fund KC’s Kruisers Loaner Cart Program for dogs in need
  • Attend veterinary and breed-specific conferences
  • Contribute to DM research
  • Provide awareness materials and educational outreach

All proceeds go directly toward these efforts.
🌐 Donate at: www.shadeoutdm.org

 
Let’s RACE to #ShadeOutDM - because no dog should suffer needlessly!
Together, we can make a difference. 💜🐾

name: 2025 Rio Vista Turkey Trot
description:

name: 2025 SHAY 5K Run/Walk
description:
Spreading Help Around You is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that was founded in 2014 in honor of Shaylyn Anela Pinoliar, who tragically passed away on November 14, 2012. Our mission is to help and support families who have lost a loved one, educate them on the importance of being prepared during such a time of loss, and provide active service to the community.  As well as promoting Pedestrian Safety Awareness. This year, we proudly launched the SHAY Scholarship Program, marking an exciting new chapter in our commitment to supporting education and empowering future leaders. 

Each year, since Shaylyn’s passing, family, friends, and community members gather to honor her memory with an Annual 5k Run/Walk on Thanksgiving morning. Last year, we moved the event to Saturday after Thanksgiving. It was a great success, and we look forward to continuing the tradition this year to honor her memory.

name: 2026 Avenue of the Giants Marathon
description: The Avenue of the Giants is one of the most beautiful races in the world!  It runs through old growth redwoods and follows a natural creek in the middle of a state park.  Staged on "The Avenue of the Giants" in Humboldt Redwoods State Park, located in rural Northern California. Course is on a paved road that winds gently up hill but is mostly a flat, fast destination race.  With little to distract you, the tall trees inspire the athlete in each of us to be strong.  The course is certified and the marathon is a Boston Qualifying event.

name: 2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.26
description:
2026 Cal Tri Castaic Lake - 6.20.25

18 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run), 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run) and 6 Youth Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

CASTAIC LAKE. 
The 35th annual Castaic Lake Triathlon takes place at scenic Castaic Lake just 20 miles north of Los Angeles. The Castaic Lake Recreation Area, located just north of Santa Clarita, is an 11,200-acre multi-use facility with two lakes, boating, world class fishing, hiking, walking, horseback riding, wake boarding, jet-skiing, camping, picnicking, kayaking, and sailing.  August is a great time to enjoy the water in the high 60s, and a staging area aptly named Paradise Cove. "Tri-cation" Friday night camping available through Castaic Lake.


THE COURSE. 
The swim course is a modified V shape in Paradise Cove at Castaic Lake, with 8 lifeguards in the water on paddleboards.  The bike course then goes out on back roads to limit your interaction with cars.  The bike course does include some U-turns on back roads to allow this, so athletes should slow down at the turn around points.  The run is primarily on the rolling trails overlooking Castaic Lake. 

WHO WE SUPPORT
All proceeds will benefit the Canyon High School Cross Country and Track Teams (we've been doing this for 33 years to support our programs).  

This is a great triathlon for new triathletes.  For years our coaches and athletes have encouraged new triathletes (young and old), and created a welcoming atmosphere of support.  We offer an enjoyable experience for triathletes of all experience levels.  


AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG).
Mid June temperatures are often cooler in the morning, with early morning fog burning off to reach the mid 80s.  Our event will possibly be around 60 degrees.

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 

Water temps in June typically range in the mid to high 60s.  Email updates will be sent out closer to the race with updates. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

2026 Cal Tri LA - 10.18.26 Playa del Rey, a coastal neighborhood, is known for its more laid-back atmosphere, making it a great destination for those seeking a quieter beach experience in the Los Angeles area. Playa del Rey has a variety of restaurants and cafes, offering diverse culinary experiences. Some establishments feature outdoor seating with ocean views. Dockweiler State Beach, the race venue, offers a beachfront RV park, fire pits for bonfires, and a hang-gliding practice area. It's a great spot for a beach picnic.

18 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run), 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run) and 6 Youth Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Check out the course maps for more detailed information. 

TO DO. The Getty Center, Venice Canals Walkway, Skirball Cultural Center.

AIRPORT. Los Angeles (LAX)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 55 F / 81 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 66 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 Cal Tri La Crema - 6.28.26
description:
2026 Cal Tri La Crema - 6.28.26. Located in Sonoma County, the La Crema Cal Tri Sonoma triathlon starts at iconic Johnson's Beach with a Russian River swim, a scenic bike ride along River Road towards the ultimate destination, La Crema Estate at Saralee’s Vineyard, where athletes run through the vineyards chasing that elusive finish line. Athletes 21+ are encouraged to enjoy a wine pour after the race.

7 EVENT OPTIONS. 3 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, SwimBike and 1640 Yard Swim) and 4 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, SwimBike, 400 yard Swim & 5k Run). All events start at Johnson's Beach with the exception of the 5K which starts and ends at La Crema Estate at Saralee’s Vineyard. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

2026 Cal Tri Ventura - 5.3.26. The perfect weekend getaway, Ventura is a coastal city and beach community that lies midway between Santa Barbara (27 miles) and Los Angeles (68 miles). 

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Ventura Harbor Village. Ventura Pier. Channels Islands National Park

AIRPORT. Los Angeles (LAX)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 55 F / 68 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 59 F. Wetsuit recommended. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 CHALLENGE
description:
🏁 2026 Challenge: Run, Walk & Bike 2,026 Miles in 2026! 🏁

 
Starts January 1, 2026 - Embark on an EPIC year-long fitness journey! Whether you choose to complete this SOLO or TEAM up with friends, the goal is to cover 2,026 miles between January 1 and December 31, 2026
 
🧍‍♀️ Solo Challenger
Take on the full 2,026 miles on your own. Every mile you run, walk, or bike counts toward your personal achievement.

 

👥 Team Challenger
Form a team of 2+ participants and divide the 2,026 miles in any way you choose. Each team member will receive their own Finisher's Medal and Race Shirt in the mail!

 

Registration Includes:
  • Finisher's Medal: Celebrate your achievement with a BADASS medal!
  • 2026 Challenge Shirt or Tank Top: Buttery-soft apparel to showcase your accomplishment.
  • Official "2,026 Miles" Sticker: Display your commitment proudly.
  • RaceJoy App: Sync your activities and track progress on the live leaderboard.
  • Live Leaderboard: Stay motivated by seeing how you and others are progressing.
  • Custom Finisher's Certificate: Personalized recognition of your success.
  • Milestone Achievement Awards: Earn accolades as you reach key milestones.
  • Free Shipping within the USA
  • Charitable Donation to "Direct Relief"- more info on our website
 
🏃 Permitted Activities
All Activity Division:
Running
Walking
Biking
Stationary biking
Treadmill
Hiking
Stand-up paddleboarding
Rollerblading/skating
Elliptical
Swimming

Stationary activities (e.g., CrossFit, strength training, yoga): 100 calories = 1 mile

Enjoy free shipping within the USA. Packages will be shipped in April 2026. Once shipped, you'll receive an email with a tracking number.

name: 2026 Disneyland® Half Marathon Weekend presented by HONDA
description:
In 2026, runDisney® is going to “Celebrate Happy” during the Disneyland® Half Marathon Weekend presented by HONDA, January 29–February 1. Happening amid the 70th anniversary of the Disneyland® Resort, this race weekend will be centered around some of the different ways to celebrate what delights us most. So come enjoy miles of smiles during a 5K hosted by Joy from Disney and Pixar’s Inside Out. Join Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey in an imaginative 10K. Run together with a friend as part of an “it’s a small world®” attraction-themed half marathon. And, for the ultimate achievement, take on the Dumbo Double Dare challenge made up of both the 10K and the half marathon. There are even Kids’ Races hosted by Stitch and morning yoga with Miss Piggy. As always, magic and one-of-a-kind medals are included.

 

Participants must attend the runDisney Health & Fitness Expo at least one day prior to their first event to pick up their race bib, participant shirt and pre-purchased merchandise. The Expo takes place Thursday, January 29 – Saturday, January 31.

name: 2026 Lake Chabot Trail Challenge (Half Marathon & 5K)
description:
“Beginning July 1, 2024, the “Honest Pricing Law” or “Hidden Fees Statute,” SB 478, makes it illegal for businesses to advertise or list a price for a good or service that does not include all required fees or charges other than certain government taxes and shipping costs.”

RACE INFO: We are so excited to celebrate the 42nd annual Lake Chabot Trail Challenge Half Marathon and 5K. This race is well regarded amongst serious trail runners in the outlying areas. The race begins at 8am for the Half Marathon and 8:30am for the 5K. Please arrive early so that you may find parking, pick up your bibs, use restrooms facilities, and be properly prepared to race before the start. Race takes place rain or shine and there are no refunds.

RACE COURSE: The half marathon course is a scenic, hilly loop, mainly on dirt fire roads.  The ridge-line views look down upon scenic Lake Chabot, surrounding grassy slopes, and eucalyptus groves.  Mt. Diablo and San Francisco Bay are visible along the route. There are water stations with first aid and radio support; we recommend bringing your own hydration as well.  The half marathon has a time limit of 3.5 hours. The 5k (3.1 miles) course is an out and back that has gentle rolling hills and consists mostly of paved surfaces.  This route includes one water station with first aid and radio support.

RACE FEE: Pre-registered runners will be guaranteed a t-shirt if registered by Sunday, May 10th, 2026.  The price for the 5K is $40 and Half Marathon $65. You must register by Saturday, June 6th. We will accept race day registration; however, the price for the 5K is $45 and Half Marathon $70. If you register on race day, we can only accept cash, check or Venmo.

There is a nominal fee (~$5) for Chabot parking lot. Free parking on Lake Chabot Rd and nearby streets.

RACE PACKET & BIB PICK-UP:  We will have race packet and bib pick-up on Sunday, June 7th starting at 7am at the Willow picnic site which is also the finish line area. We will not be mailing out any race packets or bibs. Both races are chip-timed.

T-SHIRT: Entry fee includes short sleeve, high quality t-shirts for registrations by May 10th so sign-up early.  There are no guarantee of t-shirts for runners registered after that date and on race day. We ask for those who did not get a shirt to check in after the race. Please ensure that you select the appropriate t-shirt size. We will not be doing any size exchanges from your original request.

AWARDS: Finisher's medals to those who complete their race.  Age division medals given to the top 3 in each of 12 age divisions in the half marathon and 9 age divisions in the 5K.

Photos:  Race photos are being provided by Darrell Lavin of Darrell Lavin Photography. You will receive an email post-race for instructions on how to access and purchase official race photos.

QUESTIONS: If you have any questions, please contact Rachel Lunt at teamlunt07@gmail.com.

DIRECTIONS: The entrance closest to the event's parking lot is: 17404 Lake Chabot Road, Castro Valley, CA 94546.  On Google Maps, this will appear as "Entry of Lake Chabot Parking Space."  The registration area and start lines are just a few minutes walk from the lot ( just follow the signs).

name: 2026 PRE-SALE Ride Santa Barbara 100
description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 15th year!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2026 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2026 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 musette bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with lots of food and beer
  • All Gibraltar Challenge finishers will receive a coin at the top of the hill.
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey $105
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile

  • Over 9,400′ of climbing | Start Time: 7:00 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Tackle a challenging ride that begins at Chase Palm Park, rolls through Carpinteria, and continues into the scenic Lake Casitas region. Climb Toro Canyon and Ladera Lane before testing your legs on the Gibraltar Climb Challenge, a timed 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and over 2,500 ft of elevation gain. Descend, then join the 100KM Coastal Route along Cathedral Oaks through Isla Vista and past UCSB, finishing back at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100-mile/


100 KM + Climb 

  • Over 7,400 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s most stunning terrain, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Tackle the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and the steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then test your mettle on the Gibraltar Climb: a 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and a 2,551 ft elevation gain. After summiting Gibraltar, descend via the technical Painted Cave route, continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community, and return to a well-earned finish at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-climb/

 

100 KM Coastal Route 

  • 3,900 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for intermediate to experienced cyclists only
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s finest scenery, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Challenge yourself on the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then descend toward the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. From there, ride west through Isla Vista, take in breathtaking coastal views at Goleta Beach, pass the University of California, Santa Barbara, and finish back at Chase Palm Park.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-coastal/

 

34 miles 

  • Over 2,200 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 8:30 AM
  • Beginner to intermediate level cyclists 
  • Enjoy a stunning start along the coastline from Chase Palm Park before heading inland to San Ysidro Road. Tackle a gentle ascent on Mountain Drive (max 5.1% grade), then roll past the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. Continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community and finish back at Chase Palm Park. Perfect for those seeking Santa Barbara’s natural charm with just the right amount of challenge.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/34-mile/

*Event details and courses are subject to change. 

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Refund Policy

All entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may do a one-time entry transfer to another event, person or year for $15.

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter! 

Subscribe to our e-newsletter! 📧

description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 15th year!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2026 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2026 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 musette bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with lots of food and beer
  • All Gibraltar Challenge finishers will receive a coin at the top of the hill.
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey $105
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile

  • Over 9,400′ of climbing | Start Time: 7:00 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Tackle a challenging ride that begins at Chase Palm Park, rolls through Carpinteria, and continues into the scenic Lake Casitas region. Climb Toro Canyon and Ladera Lane before testing your legs on the Gibraltar Climb Challenge, a timed 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and over 2,500 ft of elevation gain. Descend, then join the 100KM Coastal Route along Cathedral Oaks through Isla Vista and past UCSB, finishing back at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100-mile/


100 KM + Climb 

  • Over 7,400 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s most stunning terrain, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Tackle the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and the steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then test your mettle on the Gibraltar Climb: a 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and a 2,551 ft elevation gain. After summiting Gibraltar, descend via the technical Painted Cave route, continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community, and return to a well-earned finish at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-climb/

 

100 KM Coastal Route 

  • 3,900 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for intermediate to experienced cyclists only
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s finest scenery, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Challenge yourself on the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then descend toward the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. From there, ride west through Isla Vista, take in breathtaking coastal views at Goleta Beach, pass the University of California, Santa Barbara, and finish back at Chase Palm Park.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-coastal/

 

34 miles 

  • Over 2,200 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 8:30 AM
  • Beginner to intermediate level cyclists 
  • Enjoy a stunning start along the coastline from Chase Palm Park before heading inland to San Ysidro Road. Tackle a gentle ascent on Mountain Drive (max 5.1% grade), then roll past the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. Continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community and finish back at Chase Palm Park. Perfect for those seeking Santa Barbara’s natural charm with just the right amount of challenge.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/34-mile/

*Event details and courses are subject to change. 

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Refund Policy

All entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may do a one-time entry transfer to another event, person or year for $15.

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter! 

Subscribe to our e-newsletter! 📧

name: 2026 PRE-SALE Thrive San Diego Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The Kaiser Permanente Thrive Half Marathon & 5K returns for its 10th year!

We’re excited to THRIVE with you on Saturday, November 7, 2026! More than just a race, it’s an invitation for the entire San Diego community to “Thrive” together—staying active, eating healthy, living well, and giving back. All courses start and finish at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, offering fast, flat stretches with beautiful Mission Bay views and refreshing ocean breezes.

 
Half Marathon: 
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Experience 13.1 miles of scenic San Diego beauty on a loop course that starts on Ingraham Street, winds along Mission Bay, and finishes at Ski Beach. Enjoy fast, flat stretches, picturesque bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes as you chase your personal best.
  • Go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon/ for more information.

 

Half Marathon Relay:
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Take on the Half Marathon Relay with a partner and split the challenge of 13.1 miles! Each runner will cover approximately 6.5 miles before handing off the "baton" to your teammate at Telecote Shores. This scenic route along Crown Point starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, featuring fast, flat stretches, breathtaking bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon-relay/.
 
5K:
  • Start Time: 7:30AM
  • The 5K is a scenic loop route along Crown Point that starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/5k/.
 
Entry Includes:
  • Exclusive Performance Tech Long Sleeve (Half Marathon & Half Marathon Relay) 
  • Official Thrive Short Sleeve Tech Tee (5K)
  • Racer Bib
  • Finisher Medal Unique to Each Distance
  • Chip Race Timing
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Award Winner Prizes
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
  • Access to Thrive Expo
 

Virtual Runners:
  • For runners who can’t make it to San Diego but still want to participate and benefit Make-A-Wish San Diego! Complete your distance anytime during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/virtual-runners/

 

Charity:

Run to benefit Make-A-Wish® San Diego! Join us in granting wishes for children diagnosed with critical illnesses. Donate today to show your support for Make-A-Wish® San Diego on Race Day.

 

For more information on Make-A-Wish San Diego, visit thrivehalfmarathon.com/charity/.

name: 2026 Silver Strand Half Marathon, 10 Miler, 12K & 5K
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Picture this: A heart-pounding, flat-out run along the closed Silver Strand Highway 79, with the majestic Pacific Ocean on your right and the stunning San Diego Bay on your left. 🌊

But hold onto your running shoes because it's not just a race – it's a BLAST! 🎉 As you tackle the half marathon, 12K, or 10-mile courses, you'll groove to the rhythm of the Taku Drummers, jam to the hottest beats spun by a DJ, and soak in live music that'll have you moving to the groove. 🥁🎵

And when you cross that epic finish line, your jaw will drop! 🏖️🌅 You'll find yourself right on the state beach, toes in the sand, and the ocean's gentle waves washing over the shore. But wait, there's more – get ready for the ultimate California Beach Party, featuring a live band and a buzzing beer garden! 🍻🎸

All of this unfolds as you conquer the iconic "Silver Strand" route from Coronado to Imperial Beach. 🌴

And just a stone's throw away is Coronado Island, seamlessly connected to downtown San Diego by a charming bridge. 🌉

But that's not all – when you participate, you're making a difference. Your involvement supports important causes: the Life Sports Foundation, Team Hoyt, and Islander Sports Foundation.

So, what's stopping you? Join us for the San Diego Half Marathon, 12K, 8 Miler, or 5K and prepare for a race day like no other! 🏆👟

Oh, and here's a little something extra – Special Discounted Pricing for All Branches of Our USA Military enlisted and Veterans (proof of Military ID required at Packet Pick-up). And let's not forget our first responders – Special Discounted Pricing for Police, Fire, FBI, and Border Patrol with valid ID.

Get ready to run, dance, and celebrate – this is going to be LEGENDARY! 🙌 #SilverStrandHalfMarathon"

All races will finish at Silver Strand State Beach. Please be sure to visit our Parking & Buses page to see parking options.

🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Picture this: A heart-pounding, flat-out run along the closed Silver Strand Highway 79, with the majestic Pacific Ocean on your right and the stunning San Diego Bay on your left. 🌊

But hold onto your running shoes because it's not just a race – it's a BLAST! 🎉 As you tackle the half marathon, 12K, or 10-mile courses, you'll groove to the rhythm of the Taku Drummers, jam to the hottest beats spun by a DJ, and soak in live music that'll have you moving to the groove. 🥁🎵

And when you cross that epic finish line, your jaw will drop! 🏖️🌅 You'll find yourself right on the state beach, toes in the sand, and the ocean's gentle waves washing over the shore. But wait, there's more – get ready for the ultimate California Beach Party, featuring a live band and a buzzing beer garden! 🍻🎸

All of this unfolds as you conquer the iconic "Silver Strand" route from Coronado to Imperial Beach. 🌴

And just a stone's throw away is Coronado Island, seamlessly connected to downtown San Diego by a charming bridge. 🌉

But that's not all – when you participate, you're making a difference. Your involvement supports important causes: the Life Sports Foundation, Team Hoyt, and Islander Sports Foundation.

So, what's stopping you? Join us for the San Diego Half Marathon, 12K, 8 Miler, or 5K and prepare for a race day like no other! 🏆👟

Oh, and here's a little something extra – Special Discounted Pricing for All Branches of Our USA Military enlisted and Veterans (proof of Military ID required at Packet Pick-up). And let's not forget our first responders – Special Discounted Pricing for Police, Fire, FBI, and Border Patrol with valid ID.

Get ready to run, dance, and celebrate – this is going to be LEGENDARY! 🙌 #SilverStrandHalfMarathon"

All races will finish at Silver Strand State Beach. Please be sure to visit our Parking & Buses page to see parking options.

name: 20th Annual Freedom Run on the Ranch - July 4th 2026
description:
A Ladera Ranch tradition - The Freedom Run on the Ranch is happy to invite you to run in the kids Firecracker 1k or our 5k and 10k runs.  The event provides our community the ability to support local charities through the race registration proceeds and sponsorship opportunities.  We encourage all to enjoy this great opportunity to celebrate our national holiday and have a little fun while running the streets of your community.  We will  have several festivities to support the runners and non-participants at the event with a breakfast and sponsor vendor area during the morning event.  Please help us celebrate the 4th of July festivities and raise awareness and much needed support to the charities.  Remember price increases on June 22nd.  Also help support our charities by purchasing breakfast from participating local restaurants.  All proceeds benefit the charities.

Packet Pickup - TBD

Race Day Calendar:

6:00 am Race Registration opens

7:00 am - 10k run starts

8:30 am - 5k run starts

8:00 am - XclusiveTaqueria Moderna Pancake breakfast begins

9:45 am - Kids 1k run starts

11:00 am - Event ends

name: 2nd Annual Los Feliz 5K Run/Walk 10K and Toddler Dash
description:
The Los Feliz Running Club is very excited and proud to present the 1st Annual Los Feliz 5k Run/Walk and Blood Drive in support of the American Red Cross! The event will take place on Saturday June 1st, 2024 at 8:00AM at the Griffith Park Crystal Springs Drive 5K Loop. The event will be timed.

Concurrent with the event, the American Red Cross will be hosting a blood drive at the race location. Members of the Los Feliz Community are invited to either Run/Walk the event or donate blood.

Participants who run/walk the event and subsequently donate blood will be awarded the special Heart of Gold Medal and goodie bag with extra special giveaways!

Follow this link to register as a donor for the Blood Drive! 

https://www.redcrossblood.org/give.html/drive-results?zipSponsor=LFRC5K

name: 2nd Annual WARC 5K Turkey Trot
description:
Start your Thanksgiving morning with movement, community, and fun at the 2nd Annual WARC Turkey Trot 5K Run/Walk at Lodi Lake Park!

This family-friendly 5K welcomes runners and walkers of all ages and paces. Paid participants (ages 7+) receive a festive Turkey Trot T-shirt and finisher medal, while kids 6 & under can join for free.

The WARC Turkey Trot is all about celebrating movement, gratitude, and togetherness. There are no timing chips or awards — just a fun, feel-good morning surrounded by great people and positive energy. Every finisher is a winner!

Enjoy a scenic route, warm-up session, music, and post-run refreshments — the perfect way to kick off your holiday before the big feast!

Check-in: 8:00 AM

Warm-up: 8:45 AM

Run Start: 9:00 AM

Come for the miles, stay for the smiles — and let’s make this Thanksgiving morning one to remember!

name: 310K Run/walk powered by Leslie Cohen Law
description:
Leslie Cohen Law PC is once again proud to be hosting the 310K Run/Walk, a 5K event that raises funds for the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project. Now in its 14th year, the 310K is a community-driven race that takes place right on the beach in Santa Monica, drawing many returning runners and walkers year after year. The event welcomes participants of all paces—whether you're running to set a new personal record or walking with friends to support a great cause. With in-person and virtual options, the 310K offers a meaningful way to give back while enjoying one of the most scenic race routes in beautiful LA.

NEW DATE & LOCATION!

This year, the 310K will take place on Sunday, November 23rd—a great way to kick off Thanksgiving week with purpose and community spirit.

We're also excited to announce a new start and finish location at Tongva Park (at Ocean Ave. & Colorado Blvd.), just a few steps from the iconic Santa Monica Pier.

Our Beneficiary

Proceeds from the 310K support the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project (DAP), which provides free bankruptcy-related legal services to individuals and families across Greater Los Angeles. Through clinics, educational workshops, and one-on-one legal representation, DAP helps clients understand their rights, navigate the legal system, and find paths toward financial stability. DAP is part of Public Counsel, the largest pro bono legal aid organization in the United States. Leslie Cohen Law PC received the James King Community Service Award from Public Counsel in 2016 in recognition of the impact of the 310K.

name: 36th Annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K
description:
The Lopers Club and the City of Loma Linda present the 36th annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K! The Holiday Classic is the Inland Empire’s longest running annual holiday running event and a local tradition for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities!

Location

The race Start/Finish will take place in front of the Loma Linda Fire Station located at 11325 Loma Linda Drive in Loma Linda. Park in any nearby lot except for the Veteran's Hospital.

Event information

This year’s event will take place on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The Half Marathon, 10K and 5K will run simultaneously. Start time is 7:00 am. The Half Marathon has a course limit of 4 hours which is allows for walkers who can maintain an 18 minute per mile average pace. There will be many walkers as well as runners in both the 5K, 10K and Half Marathon.

The Start/Finish Line will be located near the corner of Barton Road and Loma Linda Drive, in front of the Loma Linda Fire station.

Event features

The Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K,  and 5K run/walk, provides scenic mountain views with stimulating inclines on a course which winds through the lovely streets of Loma Linda. Beautiful, long-sleeved tech shirts will be provided for all participants who register prior to November 9, 2025. Participants registering after the cutoff will receive a shirt while supplies last, we might not have your size if you register in less than three weeks before the event. All finishers of both the Half Marathon, 10K and the 5K event will be awarded beautiful finishers' medals. Trophies will be awarded to the overall top male and female winner of each race. Division medals will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place male and female finishers in each of 20 age divisions.

Bring the kids! The Holiday Classic includes a ¼ mile Elves Trot fun run for children ages 3-6. Every participating elf will receive an adorable Santa medal.

Post-race festivities

All participants of the Half Marathon, 10K and 5K will receive a free breakfast. There is a $3 charge for Elves Trot participants. Also free to all participants, a soothing, post-race mini-massage provided by gentle therapists from Precision in Movement.

Groups/teams

Create a team for your family, friends and coworkers to join. Each team participant will get a $5 discount for teams of between 5 and 14 participants. Each participant will get a $10 discount for teams of greater than 15 participants.

Bib pickup and registration

Pick up your shirt and bib Saturday, December 6, from 10 am to 3 pm, at Running Center in Redlands (1430 Industrial Park Avenue).

Volunteer check-in

Volunteers can pick up their volunteer assignments and T-shirts Saturday, December 6, from 10 am to 3 pm, at Running Center in Redlands (1430 Industrial Park Avenue).

Holiday Toy Drive

Join the Loma Linda Fire Department and ABC7 in the 33nd annual Spark of Love Toy Drive--the largest community toy drive in the nation.

The fire department will be accepting new, unwrapped toys and sports equipment for under-served children and teens. The toys collected will be donated to families within our own community.

Donations are also accepted at both Loma Linda fire stations and at Loma Linda City Hall.

The Spark of Love Toy Drive embodies the spirit of compassion, generosity and community involvement during the holiday season.

name: 39th Annual Tinsel Triathlon
description:
Tinsel Triathlon & 5K
Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon
As one of the oldest and largest independently owned reverse sprint pool triathlons on the West Coast, it is certainly an ideal end of the season endurance race.  The 35 year old event truly can be the perfect venue for Triathletes of all levels.  For first timers who have always wanted to be triathletes the course is well defined, attainable and loaded with helpful volunteers.  We are also an awesome setting for the seasoned triathlete. The course layout lets you push yourself hard for a solid workout.  What better way to get your game on ... Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon!

The Tinsel is a Sunday Triathlon run on a usually sunny, yet crisp, Southern California day with all roads closed and the coffee hot.  The 5K run takes place in a scenic, calm area of West Hemet, California in Riverside County.   Known as a "flat & fast" course, the 12 mile bike ride gives the rider a feeling of being on the country roadside.  The race ends in the 25 meter heated pool at West Valley High School, triathletes will swim 150 meters (up & back 6 times) to the finish line where you receive a unique Tinsel finisher medal.  The awards ceremony follows immediately and the bling is top shelf!

name: 3rd Annual Jerry's Miles for Manhattans
description:
We are back for YEAR 3! A walk honoring the one and only Jerry Fourie! Jerry has done so much for the Pleasanton community, specifically in the area of sports and he was/is truly one of the best there ever will be. Walk participants will loop the Pleasanton Sports Complex to honor him and cherish the memories we had both on and off the softball field. Please join us on December 20th, 2025 for the 2 mile walk (route here).

The walk is free of charge; however, if you would like to make a donation in honor of Jerry Fourie, please donate to the Pleasanton Girls Softball League: The Jerry Fourie Scholarship Fund, a scholarship fund created by his immediate family.

Parking will be available in the two lots off of Parkside Drive that are closest to Hopyard. The rest of the lots east of those parking lots will be inaccessible as fields are closed during the winter.

Lot 1: https://goo.gl/maps/dEyzSxwDp3T41kvz7 

Lot 2: https://goo.gl/maps/mydZMMHZYuzy9U178 

The walk will conclude at 11:30am but all are invited to Porky's Pizza for post gathering fun and perhaps a Manhattan or two to toast Jerry!

We hope to see you on December 20th either in person or virtually!

name: 3rd Annual Porterville 5K/10K Trail Run
description:
Description:

On 4/12/2025, the Porterville Military Academy athletic department is hosting a 5k/10k run/walk starting and finishing at Porterville Military Academy. Join us for a 5k or 10k dirt path course that is out and back. We are also hosting a children's 1/4 mile short course for your little ones to get in on the action. We look forward to seeing your whole family enjoy this community event.

All 5k race participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher Medal
  • Chip time and digital certificate
  • Race bib with individual number
  • Upbeat motivational music
  • Free Parking
All kids 1/4 mile participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher medal

Age Group Winners:

The top three males and the top three females in each age group will be rewarded with a prize after the race! The prize is still being worked on and will be posted here as soon as the artwork comes back. The age groups are...

  • 1-10
  • 11-19
  • 20-29
  • 30-39
  • 40-49
  • 50-59
  • 60-69
  • 70-79
  • 80+

Packet Pickup:

  • Place: Porterville Military Academy front office
  • 4/9/2025 from 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • 4/11/2025 from 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • If you are unable to make it to packet pickup, you can come on the morning of the event from 6:30 AM - 7:45 AM

Virtual Race - If you live locally, you are encouraged to come to packet pickup. Otherwise, the race medal will be mailed to you after the race.

We do not store any unclaimed race packets after the race. If you do not pick up your packet prior to the race, then it is considered forfeited. Leftover supplies are donated to volunteers and local charities.

Who we support:

  • The Experimental Aircraft Association (EAA), is an international organization with over 200,000 members. EAA chapters provide a community for pilots and aviation enthusiasts. The Porterville EAA Chapter 1547 has supported Porterville Military Academy Cadets in multiple facets by providing scholarships, overseeing more than 150 Porterville Military Academy Cadets flying an airplane, and mentoring our future aviators on the theories of flight.

name: 41st Nature Made Great Race: Half Marathon, 5K, 10K, 15K, 10M, 1M
description:
The Nature Made Great Race is a celebration of running that features the incredibly scenic Chesebro Half Marathon mostly trail race, and on road: the Deena Kastor 5K, Old Agoura 10K, 15K Double Stack Challenge, Cronies 10.3 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and United Track 1 Mile run/walk.

Established in 1986, the Great Race has won many awards and accolades over the years including:

Best Half Marathon in Nation by Active.com
Voted #1 Running Event in L.A.
Selected a Top 10K in U.S. by Runner's World
Best Race Swag by Competitor Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by LA Sports & Fitness Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by Active.com
Best Post-Race Party by Runner's World
Best Brunch Run by Athlinks 

 

Runner Perks

  • Run on a beautiful, scenic and serene course
  • Custom-designed drawstring goodie bag with actual goodies
  • Premium technical running top (men's or women's cut, in short sleeve or long sleeve)
  • All finishers are rewarded with a beautiful, commemorative finisher’s medal
  • Two medals for finishers of the 10 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and 15K Double Stack Challenge
  • LA's #1 Post-Race Party with lots of quality free food, music and shopping
  • Live Results with RFID timing
  • Photographers on course
  • Plenty of aid stations
  • USATF certified and sanctioned courses
  • Well-marked routes
  • The Great Race Super Discount on Great Race apparel & gear (the earlier you register, the more offers you receive)
  • Sports & Fitness Expo
  • Free parking at the Expo
  • Free race day parking
  • Announcer greets you at beautiful Chumash Park at SoCal’s most active, fun finish line
  • Hundreds of Age Group Awards
  • Prizing: Audio/Video Equipment to Top Finishers in Select Races like TVs, Headphones, Music Players, etc.

Great Race runners comment year-after-year about the gorgeous scenery, the serenity and the most Most Beautiful Courses in Southern California!

So Much Fun!

name: 43rd Annual Providence Saint John's Health Center Brentwood Run
description:
🏃‍♀️ Join Us for the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run 🏃‍♂️

Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! This historic race features a flat and slight downhill course, making it a fast and enjoyable run or walk for participants of all levels. Beyond the race, enjoy a huge expo with local vendors and a dedicated kids area. Best of all, your participation benefits the Brentwood Library and supports the local community!

name: 46th Annual AMS 5K & Wellness Expo VI
description:
Locals know this as a popular and inclusive community event that offers a fun family environment focused on physical and spiritual Wellness. Participants walk, jog, run, and/or race. This event also includes a Stroller Competition and Costume Contest.  


For those racing, the fast and challenging 3.1-mile course includes certified timing and a large digital clock at the finish.


For EVERYONE, this event provides an opportunity for Wellness and to experience a fun-filled, all-inclusive activity & the American Martyrs community.

name: 49th Annual Holiday Run and Walk for Health
description:
We are very excited to bring back the Kiwanis Holiday run. This year will be the 49th running of this event. We have partnered with Rotary Club of the Delta to make sure we bring a high-quality event. We have worked to provide a better course, and lots of medals. We also hope our school’s challenge will be bigger than ever. There will be a medal to the top five runners in every age category, as well as cash prizes and trophies to our top three High school, middle school, and elementary schools. 

Many people have put a lot of work together to make this event happen, none more important than former race director Paul Schorr.

We hope you join us for the 49th Annual – Kiwanis/ Rotary – Paul Schorr Memorial Holiday Run and walk for health. Do it for the Health of It!

name: 55th NorCal John Frank Memorial Run
description:
March 7, 2026

10-Mile USATF Pacific Association Road Grand Prix event.

Run a spring race along the beautiful Sacramento River Trail and across two iconic pedestrian bridges, the Diestelhorst Bridge and the Stress Ribbon Bridge, in Redding, CA.

Plus a 3-Mile Run/Walk and 1 Mile Run/Walk. Kids 14 and under run the 1 Mile for free.

Course Records:

$2900 in prize purse for 10-Mile, awarded to USATF Pacific Association members.
$2500 in course record prize purse for 10-Mile. $1000 for men/women open course records, $250 for men/women masters (40+ y/o) course records.

  • Women's Open: 55:23 (Sara Hall, 2016)
  • Men's Open: 48:38 (Brendan Gregg, 2022)
  • Women's Masters: 57:09 (Linda Smith, 2010)
  • Men's Masters: 50:47 (Sergio Reyes, 2022)

Packet pickup will be on Friday March 6, 2026, from 11am to 5pm, at Fleet Feet Redding, 1376 Hilltop Dr, Redding, CA 96003.
Race day registration opens at 7:30am at Lake Redding Park, 2225 Benton Dr, Redding, CA US 96003.

1 Mile starts at 8:30 AM.
10 Mile starts at 10:00 AM.
3 Mile starts at 10:05 AM.

name: 5K for Fragile X
description:
Superheroes are back once again!! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18th, 2026 for the 13th Annual 5K Walk/Race for Fragile X and celebrate our Southern California Fragile X Community! Click Here for Event Details for Participants 

Why race for Fragile X syndrome? 

Fragile X syndrome (FXS) is the leading known cause of inherited intellectual disability and the leading single gene cause of Autism. Fraxsocal’s mission is to promote public awareness and with your help we can accomplish this goal! Also, to provide a forum for families and children with FXS to meet & greet and create a stronger FXS community! We also support research for effective treatments and ultimately a cure for FXS. Treatments for Fragile X are likely to help people affected by autism, Alzheimer’s, and other brain disorders.

Fragile X Community 

A Family Fun Day will proceed after the walk with Family, Friends, Food and Fun!! It's a great time to chat with other families affected by fragile X syndrome (FXS) and it's also a nice opportunity for you to take your kid(s) or adult(s) with FXS or any disability for that matter, judgement free! 

How to participate:
  • Participate in person: Sign up to walk, run, bike, scoot or stroll (it's a very family friendly walk/run) All you do is click the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! Mark your calendar and be sure to arrive early so you can get your FREE t-shirt and goodies before we begin. 
  • Participate virtually: Sign up by clicking the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! (Make sure you have someone there in person to pick up your t-shirts otherwise you will be donating them to our organization in which we say, "thank you"! ) 
  • Start a Fundraiser: Whether you are participating in person or virtually you can start an individual fundraiser (starting goal is $250) and attach it to a TEAM (Starting goal of $2,500) in the honor of your Fragile X Super Hero.
  • Become a Sponsor:  Whether you personally, your company or a company you know are interested we have multiple packages to choose from! 
 
Race Fundraising Goal: $75,000 Last year we raised over $55,000!!! Let's see if we can top that!! Donations can be made by clicking the Donate Tab.
 
Share!

Inform your network of supporters! Use these Social Media graphic template to help you tell others that you are racing and/or fundraising! Invite them to race or donate in your honor or in the honor of your Fragile X Superhero.

 

More about our organization: 
FRAGILE X ASSOCIATION of SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA (FRAXSOCAL)
Our non-profit organization was formed to promote public awareness of Fragile X Syndrome with special emphasis on educators and health professionals; provide a forum for families and children with Fragile X to meet and share their ideas, concerns and problems; and support scientific research on Fragile X Syndrome.

name: 71st Annual Fontana Days Run

Race founders were unaware that the annual Half Marathon would grow to include over 2,000 participants. The Fontana Days Run provides participants with a safe, festive, and well organized event. Finish Line festivities include local vendors, exhibitors, entertainment, and food.

name: 8th Annual KIWANIS  RESOLUTION 5K Run/Walk, and 10K Run/Walk
description:
KIWANIS Resolution Races are in-person runs at Mountain View Shoreline Park! We’ve both a 5K and 10K event to choose from, with Digital  Chip timing for both.

 

This year we are again running on Saturday January 3 to give  holiday travelers a chance to participate too. Start the new year out with a great run on a great day on the Bayland trails!. It's a beautiful location with free parking, great race, with post-race snacks and lots of awards.

 

Please note that no dogs or pets are allowed in Shoreline Park.

 

We will again have a 1K Kids run this year for ages 1-10 and this year all 1K participants will also receive a race T shirt. Plan on bringing all kids and the neighbors too! 

 

Race Day is Jan 3, 2026. The 10K starts at 10:00 AM and the 5K starts at 10:15 AM. All inside Mountain View Shoreline Park. Parking is free for all.  

 

All participants who register by December 15 will receive a specially designed race T-shirt.

 

Also please upload photos from your race experience to this website. We'd love to share your experience of the race. 

 

You may visit our permanent website WSJKrun.org for information about past races and Kiwanis current charitable work. Or Click HERE for more info about Kiwanis of West San Jose and/or HERE for specific programs information.

name: 8th Annual KIWANIS  RESOLUTION 5K Run/Walk, and 10K Run/Walk
description:
KIWANIS Resolution Races are in-person runs at Mountain View Shoreline Park! We’ve both a 5K and 10K event to choose from, with Digital  Chip timing for both.

 

This year we are again running on Saturday January 3 to give  holiday travelers a chance to participate too. Start the new year out with a great run on a great day on the Bayland trails!. It's a beautiful location with free parking, great race, with post-race snacks and lots of awards.

 

Please note that no dogs or pets are allowed in Shoreline Park.

 

We will again have a 1K Kids run this year for ages 1-10 and this year all 1K participants will also receive a race T shirt. Plan on bringing all kids and the neighbors too! 

 

Race Day is Jan 3, 2026. The 10K starts at 10:00 AM and the 5K starts at 10:15 AM. All inside Mountain View Shoreline Park. Parking is free for all.  

 

All participants who register by December 15 will receive a specially designed race T-shirt.

 

Also please upload photos from your race experience to this website. We'd love to share your experience of the race. 

 

You may visit our permanent website WSJKrun.org for information about past races and Kiwanis current charitable work. Or Click HERE for more info about Kiwanis of West San Jose and/or HERE for specific programs information.

name: 8th Annual Run4Sharks & Ocean Health Fair 5k/1mile Fun Run...Custom medal to all Finishers: Timed 5k !
description:
Come out and get your fitness on with a 5k timed race through the community streets with police marshals and volunteers to assure your safety. Or choose the 1mi fun run for kids 10 and under, or adults can just walk it! 1mi is NOT timed but all kids will receive a shark themed goody bag and their choice of shark socks!  This is a fun community event of ocean awareness and fitness raising funds for Shark Stewards nonprofit's Ocean Academy group at South Jr High in Anaheim.  As well as their online youth education programs. Choose a 5k run with a 9am start. Walk or run it, professionally timed with prizes for top 3 in each age group. 10 under, 11-15, 16-25, 26-35, 36-45, 46-55, 56-65, 66 over. Kids and family 1mi for FUN, walk/run with bubble station, water sprinkler run through, and other fun stuff. Wear an ocean costume and win a prize. Costume winners top 3 boys & girls.

Sponsor a Kid: We want to send a group of kids to CIMI on Catalina Island, a ocean science weekend. Sponsor a kid, any amount and we will pool the funds to make sure a kid runs instead of you, earning his/her spot on the list to go to Catalina.  Thank you in advance for your generosity.

TEAMS OF 5 OR MORE GET $5 OFF...Here's how: The first four people signing up for the team pay current price. Anyone signing up for  team after the fourth person gets $5 off current price and the first four people will then automatically get a $5 refund. Questions? call or text race director: Maria @ 951-496-6520. 

 

Can't make it to the event? Choose our Virtual Option and do it in your neighborhood. On site, browse through our booths and learn about ocean health, sharks, and fitness from our sponsors. Located at our Ocean Academy school, South Jr. High 2320 E. South St. Anaheim, CA 92806. This is a fundraising event with an Opportunity drawing supporting Shark Stewards, a fiscally sponsored project of Earth Island Institute, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Shark Stewards works to protect sharks and preserve healthy ocean ecosystems.

 

ONLINE REGISTRATION CLOSES 6PM ON FRIDAY NOVEMBER 14th RACE DAY REGISTRATION OPENS AT 7:30 AM.

name: 9th Annual BRAVE Race 2026
description:
The BRAVE RACE is hosted by The Joyful Child Foundation - In Memory of Samantha Runnion (55-0794474).

The Joyful Child Foundation is dedicated to preventing crimes against children through programs that educate, empower, and unite families and communities.

Your participation benefits The Joyful Child's Be Brave-Be Safe Empowerment Programs.

You can choose to participate virtually or join us in person at Wolverine Stadium in Aliso Viejo, CA on Sunday, February 22, 2026

Participants can walk or run a 1K, 5K, 10K. Prize money to top 3 male and female in 5k and 10k.

name: 9th Annual Lake Forest Chamber Elf Yourself 5K
description:
The Lake Forest Chamber of Commerce's 9th Annual holiday FUN RUN 5K takes place in the stunning Lake Forest Sports Park on Saturday, November 22, 2025. It is a fast, flat course contained within the park. Our theme is Elf Yourself to kick off the holiday season! This is a fun family event for all, strollers and pets are welcome!

We have a large post-race expo with local restaurants passing out samples, vendors, and various fitness companies. There is even games & crafts for kids, photos with Santa, bounce houses, a hot chocolate station, and more! Make sure to bring your pets for our pet parade, there are awards for best dressed pets!

Stay up to date with our race by following our social media platforms on Facebook and Instagram!

In order to guarantee receiving a full swag bag, make sure to register by 11/3/25

Packet Pick Up Information: 

Packet Pick-Up will be on Friday, November 21st from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM
Located at Spectrum Specialties & Awards/The Lake Forest Chamber Office
26239 Enterprise Court, Lake Forest, CA 92630

Next Door to South Coast Photography
MUST bring a copy of your signed waiver and an ID
If you want to pick up for a friend, you are able to do so if you have a picture of their ID and a signed copy of their waiver
If you can't make it at this time, we will also have packet pick up in the morning before the race, but make sure to arrive early! 
 

 

Day of Race Information

Parking: Enter the Sports Park from the Portola Parkway entrance (NOT Lake Forest Drive). We will be closing all park entrances prior to the race start for runner's safety. 

The Park will be on lockdown from 8 AM to 11 AM. There are NO exceptions to this rule because it is for runner's safety. 
Overflow parking will be available across the street at Saddleback Church (just a short walk away). If you need to arrive late or leave early, you must park over here and not inside the Park. 
Get to the start line early!
 

This is a timed event with 4 Waves!

  • Wave 1: Fast PR Elves
  • Wave 2: Speedy Elves
  • Wave 3: Runner/Jogger Elves
  • Wave 4: Walkers/Strollers/Pet Elves
     

Additional Runner Information:

The Start Line is located on the large grass area referred to as "the commons" before the soccer fields. 

Awards will be given in age groups for the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd males and females. There will also be top overall awards for males and females. 
Every person will receive a Finishers Medal upon completion of the race!
Make sure to dress up in your best holiday gear! Don't be afraid to go all out!
 

Course Information:

It is a flat 2 1/2 looped course entirely within the Sports Park! We are running on the streets of the Park. 

It will be clearly marked with colorful arrows (one color per lap) & a lead cyclist from Pure Ride Cycles for the fastest runners.
We will have pacers leading each wave! 
 

Tentative Schedule of Events: 

8:00 AM - Runners Start to Arrive

8:30 AM - Race Announcer Starts/Line Up 

8:30-8:45 AM - Carolers 

8:45 AM - Herbalife Warm-Up

8:55 AM - National Anthem 

9:00 AM - Wave 1 Release Fast PR Elves
                Wave 2 Release Speedy Elves
                Wave 3 Release Runner/Jogger Elves
                Wave 4 Release Walker/Strollers/Pet Elves

9:00 AM - Expo Officially Opens

9:15 AM - Finish Line Medals (Ongoing)

9:30-11:00 AM - On Going Raffles & Expo Activities

10:00-10:15 AM - Podium Awards 

10:00 AM - Demo(s) 

10:30 AM - Pet Costume Contest 

10:45 AM - Pet Costume Awards

11:00 AM - Start Clean Up 

Introductions: 

  • Herbalife will be warming up the runners!
  • National Anthem
  • Jade Tully is your race announcer!
  • Caren Ware of Itz About Time will be timing our race!
  • Mary Visconte of Spectrum Specialties/CEO of the Lake Forest Chamber is our Race Director! 

Be sure to say HI to everyone! 
 

Post-Race Expo:


Don't run away after the race. Be sure to hold onto your Bib # to check if you won any raffle prizes! Raffles will be ongoing at the DJ station and written on a dry erase board. Keep checking back to see if you won! 

We have a Kid's Zone called Candy Cane Lane: photos with Santa, games, activities, bounce houses, and more!
Samples from the following: past vendors have included Urban Grill, La Casita Olvera, Coffee, Raising Cane's, A Little Something Sweet, & More! 
 

Fun Facts: 

  • Most of the race is put on by volunteers including our professional photographers: The Walman Photography, and Eagle Community Credit Union.
  • All your pictures are FREE! They will be uploaded onto our Elf Yourself Facebook photo albums, be sure to like our Page! You will be able to download the photos from there! 
  • Be sure to tag our Instagram and Facebook pages on any pictures you post of the event!
  • This Event Supports Local Chamber Charities (such as years past):
    • The Pet Adoption Center of O.C.
    • Boys & Girls Club of Laguna Beach
    • Dream Animal Rescue
    • Kiwanis Club of Lake Forest
    • And MORE!!
       

We thank you for all of your support! If you have any additional questions or concerns, please contact the Lake Forest Chamber of Commerce by emailing info@lakeforestCAchamber.com or calling (949)583-9639.

name: 9th Annual Turkey Trot on The Ranch
description:
THANKSGIVING DAY - Thursday, November 28, 2025 | 8:00AM to 10:30AM 
10K - 8:00AM | 5K - 8:30AM  | Little Gobbler's 1K - 10:00AM 

Rancho Mission Viejo’s 9th annual Turkey Trot on The Ranch features a 10K, 5K, and a Little Gobbler’s 1K that takes participants through the beautiful pathways and walkways of the Community of Rancho Mission Viejo. 

All proceeds from the run will benefit The Nature Reserve at Rancho Mission Viejo, the entity responsible for education and conservation of the historic land of Rancho Mission Viejo. This run will happen, rain or shine!

name: A Merry Christmas Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎅 🎄  Join the Christmas Run! 🎄 🎅

Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)
