name: Big Bear Turkey Trot
description:
The 12th Annual Big Bear Turkey Trot
✨ What’s New This Year
📍 A new home in the Moonridge Corridor, starting and finishing at Dank Donuts.
🌲 A fresh route incluing the new Rathbun Creek Trail, and a memorable lap through the Moonridge Zoo 🦓🦙🦅.
🏃 A paved 3-mile run through the pines that’s approachable for everyone!
🎶 Danksgiving Celebration party at the finish line featuring live holiday music and adult beverages 🍹

 
🗓️ Event Schedule

8:00 AM - Registration & check-in opens
9:25 AM - Holiday Warmup Yoga 🧘 with Colin Schour
9:30 AM - 3-Mile Turkey Trot 🦃
10:00 AM - Danksgiving Party 🎶🍩🥂 with live music & adult beverages
10:30 AM - Awards 🏆 & Costume Contest 🎭
 
💸 Registration
Adults: $40
Youth (under 18): $25
Kids Run: Free
Locals: $5 discount with ID at packet pickup
No refunds (rain, shine, or snow—it’s all part of the fun).
 
🎁 Included with Entry:

🎄 A holiday finisher ornament
🧘 A lighthearted yoga warm-up
🎭 A lively costume contest
🥧 Race timing and awards eligibility (elite wave start available for those who's costume is considered worthy). 
🎶🍹 The Danksgiving party at the finish line
 
📦 Packet Pickup

🗓️ Monday, Nov 24 – Wednesday, Nov 26 (4–7 PM): The Yellow Post, 546 Pine Knot Blvd
🦃 Race Morning, Nov 27 (8–9 AM): Dank Donuts, 42612 Moonridge Rd Big Bear Lake, CA
 
 
🙋 FAQs

Strollers & kids? Strollers are welcome, and the kids under 5 are free.
Refunds? Nope. The Turkey Trot happens in any weather.
Local discount? Show ID for $5 off.
What’s included? Ornaments, yoga, pie, costumes, music, and memories.
 
🎤 Closing Note

The Big Bear Turkey Trot has always been about more than miles—it’s a morning of laughter, costumes, pie, and community. This year, we’ll gather in Moonridge, run the trail, visit the zoo, and then celebrate together at Danksgiving. We’ll see you out there. 🦃✨

name: Bikes & Beers San Diego
description:
Register for California's 12th Annual Bike Ride & Beer Festival 2025! BIKES & BEERS Cycling Event Series is back at ALESMITH BREWING COMPANY for the Best Bike Ride & Beer Event in the business! Ride a 15, 30, or 45-mile route through the beautiful area of San Diego, California followed by a post-ride Beer Festival! Bikes & Beers SAN DIEGO is the area's premier cycling event departing from ALESMITH BREWING COMPANY and traveling the scenic roads of San Diego, CA. All rides feature morning fuel stations, marked routes, GPS turn-by-turn instruction, rest stops, refreshments, ride marshals, and SAG support. Finish back at ALESMITH BREWING COMPANY for a beer festival atmosphere of rewarding craft beers, live music, a charity raffle & much more!

This is a ride for everyone - All riding levels are welcome!


WHAT IS BIKES & BEERS:

  • Pick your ride distance and create a team of friends & family (optional)
  • Mark your calendar for a fun day of cycling and craft beer!
  • Pre Ride:
    • Check in a half hour before your start time
    • We'll provide parking & further ride info in email instructions
    • Enjoy free coffee & fresh pastries
    • Local bike shops offering last-minute tune-ups
  • The Ride:
    • Ride your distance with ride leaders
    • Fully marked routes & GPS turn-by-turn instructions
    • Mechanical support vehicle
    • Rest stops with snacks & refreshments
  • Post Ride: 
    • It's time to enjoy (2) complimentary beers on us!
    • Official co-branded Bikes & Beers Pint Glass for every rider
    • Bikes & Beers high-quality neoprene koozies
    • Enjoy the food trucks, live music, games
    • Check out our Bikes & Beers merch tent & snack stand
    • Live raffle with $2,000+ in prizes!
  • Join & Post your photos on our Facebook Page
    • Keep in touch with your newly made cycling friends!

*Further event information will be communicated in emails after registration and in the days and weeks leading up to event day!


WHAT YOU'LL GET:

  • Official Bikes & Beers X ALESMITH 2025 Pint Glass
  • (2) ALESMITH Craft Beers are ON US!
  • High-Quality Neoprene Beer Koozies
  • Raffle Ticket with a Chance to WIN PRIZES!
  • Collectable Bike Plate - Event Photos!
  • Unique Pretzels & Athletic Non-Alcoholic Beer
  • Entry into the Post-Ride Party with LIVE MUSIC, RAFFLE, GAMES, FOOD TRUCKS & MORE!


NEW TO OUR 2024 EVENTS:

  • PROFESSIONAL PHOTOGRAPHERS - At least (3) photographers will be snapping pics of your Bikes & Beers experience during pre-ride, during the ride, and post-ride! We have amazing photo ops!
  • NON-ALCOHOLIC BEER OPTIONS - Still want to ride with us but don't want the alcohol? We now have Athletic Brewing sponsoring all our events! Looks for the blue tent and cooler full of flavorful non-alcoholic brews!
  • COLLECTABLE BIKE PLATES - At check-in, you'll receive a collectible event wristband and bike plate designed just for this event! They look awesome!
  • SPONSOR SNACKS & GIVEAWAYS - Morning coffee, fresh pastries, post-ride pretzel necklaces, recovery protein & much more!
 

IT'S A CELEBRATION OF CYCLING AND CRAFT BEER!

Riders will also receive a free raffle ticket for a chance to win a brand-new bike and a ton of other prizes including a private brewery tour and cycling gear!

Benefitting local cycling charities to help improve the cycling conditions in your area. Have fun, and give back!

name: Bizz Johnson
description:
Set PRs and qualify for the Boston Marathon on this fast, downhill course! Total net downhill loss for the marathon is 929 feet making it the PERFECT course to qualify on! Per official B.A.A. confirmation, there will be no time penalties assessed for this course.

All races in 2026 will be Sunday, October 11. The marathon and 50K start at 8:00 AM at Mason Station Trailhead on McCoy Road with an out-and-back before jumping onto the Bizz Johnson Trail at Mason Station where the races travel through scenic Lassen National Forest. The first few miles of the course climb approximately 280 feet through the forest to Westwood Junction, then it’s downhill to the finish at Susanville, with a 1300-foot descent over the final 20 miles. The trail follows the route of the old Fernley and Lassen Branch Line of the Southern Pacific Railroad, built in 1914.

Roughly two-thirds of the way through the race, the trail enters the Susan River Canyon. Here, you’ll pass orange cliffs and cross the river ten times on picturesque wooden railroad bridges. About four miles from the finish, you’ll pass through two former railroad tunnels, 800 feet and 450 feet in length.

The Express Half Marathon starts at at 9:00 AM at Goumaz Campground which is Mile 14 of the full marathon route. After a short up-and-back, the Express Half Marathon flies down the Bizz Johnson to the finish.

Starting at Devil's Corral, the new Express 10K on Sunday does the last 6.2 miles of the full marathon. This course promises to be a fast, fun race. 

For all four events, you will be bused to a remote start.

PACKET PICKUP

  • Saturday Noon - 6 PM (50K, Marathon, Express Half Marathon, Express 10K): Susanville Historic Train Depot, 601 Richmond Road
  • Sunday Morning 6 AM - 7AM (Marathon and 50K), 7AM - 8 AM (Express Half Marathon and Express 10K): Susanville Historic Train Depot, 601 Richmond Road

PLEASE visit our website for maps, schedules, and all the important details!!

name: Bizz Johnson's Southside Scramble
description:
Are you ready to SCRAMBLE? This amazing new trail race showcases the best of the Susan River Canyon! Runners will head up the Bizz Johnson Trail from Hobo Camp for the first half and return via the beautiful and flowy singletrack on the Southside trail across the river. The Southside Scramble has 3 different distances to choose from, a 22K, a 14K, and a 7K. All races start and end at the Hobo Camp Day Use Area. On ODD years, we will run a reversed course! For 2025, all races go out the Southside Trail and back on the Bizz Johnson Trail. 

For the Dirty Devil's 22K, runners start on the Fire Road above the Hobo Camp Day Use Area and take the "outbound" portion of the Bizz Johnson Trail approximately 6 miles all the way to Devil's Corral.  From Devil's Corral, runners turn and drop down to the Susan River, crossing over a seasonal foot bridge, and enter the stunningly beautiful Southside trail with its rockslides, vista points, and flowy single track all the way back to Hobo Camp.

The Tunnel's Blast 14K starts on the Fire Road above the Hobo Camp Day Use Area and takes the "outbound" portion of the Bizz Johnson Trail approximately 4 miles to the entrance to the first railroad tunnel. Before heading into the darkness of the tunnel, runners will veer off onto singletrack, where they climb over the top of the tunnel to reach the Southside Trail. From there, they will enjoy the stunningly beautiful Southside trail with its rockslides, vista points, and flowy single track all the way back to Hobo Camp

The "Hobo's Special" 7K starts on the Fire Road above the Hobo Camp Day Use Area and heads approximately 2 miles up to the Twin Bridges Access connector to the Southside Trail. You'll get just enough of the Bizz Johnson's steady climb to excite your senses for the fast, flowy Southside's single-track return.

Finishers:

At Hobo Camp Day Use Area, participants can enjoy a fun finish line party with food and beverages.  All finishers will receive a custom medal and a custom beach towel just in time for a cool dip in the Susan River! Overall awards will be given to 1st through 3rd finishers (M/F/NB). Age group awards will be given to 1st-3rd AG in 10-year age groups.  

Start Times:

7:30 Dirty Devil's 22K

7:45 Tunnel's Blast 14K

8:00 Hobo Special 7K

Aid Stations:

Aid stations will serve fruit and salty snacks, Heed electrolyte, and water.  This is a cup-less race so runners should have their own hydration systems. Hydrapak is our cupless racing partner and runners will be provided with a collapsible cup at packet pickup.

Aid Station #1 is located on the Bizz Johnson Trail at the lower end of the lower tunnel at Mile 3.8. This aid station serves both the 22K and the 14K. 

Aid Station #2 is located on the Bizz Johnson Trail at the Devil's Corral at the Southside trail turnoff at mile 5.94. 22K 

Aid Station #3 is located on the Southside Trail just above the Twin Bridges access trail. This is approximately 2 miles from the finish. This aid station serves all three race distances.

For ODD years, with the reversed course, the Aid Station distances are slightly different. Additionally, the Twin Bridges Aid Station reverts to just hydration.

This race is Trail-Sisters Approved. There will be equal space on the start line for women and women's hygiene products at all aid stations and the finish line.

Event Parking:

Carpooling is HIGHLY encouraged as parking at Hobo Camp is very limited.  

Here are your options:

1. Hobo Camp - Most parking is on the middle and upper levels. There will be volunteers helping you park very tightly. There is also some parallel parking along the entrance road to Hobo Camp after the gate. This parking must only be on the uphill side of the road and you must be pointed in the direction to LEAVE Hobo Camp. There is NO parking on the Fire Roads.

2. There is some parking at Miller Road at the Bizz Johnson Trail (You must not park blocking the Bizz Johnson Trail). This is a short walk of about .25 mile from the start line.

3. There is a LOT of parking at the Bizz Johnson Trailhead across from the Susanville Historic Train Depot at 601 Richmond Road. This is about .75 mi from the start line. This is a flat, easy walk. One option would be to bring your bicycle and ride to the start. It is a flat, easy, short ride. There will be a place at the finish line to lock your bike and leave your keys with the Race Director.

Packet Pickup:

Packet Pickup will be at the Susanville Historic Train Depot at 601 Richmond Road on Friday, June 21st from 3 PM until 6 PM.  Late Registration will be available on Friday at packet pickup.

Race Day morning packet pickup will be available at the Hobo Camp Day Use Area (Finish Line Area) beginning at 6 AM. There will be limited race day registration from 6 - 6:45 AM (22K), 6 - 7:15 AM (14K), and 6 - 7:30 AM (7K).

Post-Race Activities

The Finish Line is approximately .1 mile from the Start Line. Feel free to bring a picnic lunch and EZ-up and hang out on the grass watching the other finishers. We will have hotdogs, watermelon, water, sodas, and non-alcoholic brews from Athletic Brewing Company for runners. If your family wants to join you, there are several newer charcoal BBQs in the day use area. The river has excellent access at the Day Use area so cooling off is a MUST!

This race is capped at  150 runners total for all 3 events!

name: Blazin' Eagles 5K Fun Run/Walk
description:

Benefiting Scouting America

Join us for a fun-filled run/walk in support of Scouting America! Whether you're walking, jogging, or racing to the finish line, every step you take helps fund life-changing programs for local youth.

🟢 What It's About:

name: Blossom Bike Ride
description:
The 36th Annual Blossom Bike Ride will take place on March 7, 2026. We are currently working on the routes for this year.  As the mileage gets longer, the route provides more of a challenge. Our 7 mile family ride takes you along the rails to trails pathway through Reedley. The 20 mile route offers more scenic landscapes north east of town for your viewing pleasure. If you are looking for a little more challenge, you might want to try our 40 mile route. This will get you started on the right course of mileage for the year. If you are looking for the longer ride, we offer the 60 mile route with some climbing. This route will take you into the foot hills east of Reedley.

Let's get ready to Ride!

 
These are ride times:
  • 60 Mile 7:00am
  • 40 Mile 8:30am
  • 20 Mile 9:30am
  • 7 Mile Family ride 10:30
 
Ride begins at:

     Reedley College
     995 N. Reed
     Reedley, 93654
 
Please allow yourself to arrive at least half an hour before ride so that you can check in at registration desk and receive your bib and T-shirt if you signed up for one. We will NOT be checking in riders more than 35 minutes before scheduled ride.  
 
Weather should be a beautiful 73 degrees that day. 
 
See you Saturday!

name: Bowman Run with the Bulls
description:
Join us for the Annual Run with the Bulls 5K Run/Walk!
Lace up your shoes and be part of this fun community tradition that welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The scenic course winds through the heart of Auburn — The Endurance Capital of the World — showcasing its beauty and spirit.

The race starts and finishes at Railhead Park, with all proceeds supporting continued improvements to Bowman Charter School’s large gymnasium — a space that brings our students and community together.

🏅 Registration Details

  • $40 for kids (13 and under)
  • $45 for general registration
  • $50 same-day registration (shirt not guaranteed)
  • Family Discount: Register 3 or more and receive $3 off each runner!
  • Register by March 22 to guarantee your cotton race shirt.

All finishers will receive a finisher’s medal, and age-group awards will be presented for both kids and adults.

🎉 Team Challenge: Join a Bowman class team and help your class earn a special reward for the most participants and fundraising!

❤️ Can't join in person? You can sign up to participate virtually or support the cause with a donation—every contribution helps Bowman students go the distance!

📸 Race Day Highlights

  • Chip timing provided by Singletrack Running
  • Professional race photos by Facchino Photography — included with your entry

Come out and celebrate fitness, community, and school spirit — Run with the Bulls!

name: Brian Waterbury Memorial Rock to Pier Run
description:
The 2025 Brian Waterbury Memorial Rock to Pier Fun Run and Rock’n Around the Pier Half Marathon will take place on Saturday, July 12 with a 7:00 am start time. 2025 marks the 55th running of the Rock to Pier Run and the 11th running of the Half Marathon.

The Brian Waterbury Memorial Rock to Pier Fun Run is a 6 mile beach run from Morro Rock to the Cayucos Pier. The finish line is at the iconic Cayucos Pier. This event is open to participants of all ages and abilities.

The Rock’n Around the Pier Half Marathon event begins at Morro Rock, continues to the Cayucos Pier, turn around and head back towards Morro Rock. At 10.5 miles the course will veer off the beach (through soft sand) and will follow a 1 mile loop through a local park returning to the beach (through soft sand) and finish at Morro Rock. Please note that the course will be closed at 1:00pm for runners. 

Parking is limited in Cayucos and all participants for the Rock to Pier Run are encouraged to return to Morro Bay via provided Bus transportation. There is plenty of parking at Morro Rock and nearby. Arrive early.

Limited shirt sizes are still available while supplies last.   Some sizes are sold out.

Both Events will begin at 7:00am

Water/Aide stations are available - 3 for Rock to Pier 

Transportation is provided from the Cayucos Pier back to the start at Morro Rock where a post event breakfast will be held.  Awards will be at Morro Rock.

This event is held on the beach--you will get wet.   Dogs are not allowed on the course due to the Snowy Plover nesting season. 

Any other questions, please let us know;  kzink@morrobayca.gov

name: Buzz Marathon #26
description:
WHAT'S THE BUZZ?

The Buzz Marathon is a Boston qualifying race, hosted at Camp Roberts California National Guard Installation. This annual event includes; A full marathon, half-marathon, 10K, 5k, and a kids 1-mile run. Proceeds of this event help fund the Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) program with their mission of soldier care. MWR provides services to support the wellbeing of military personnel, their families, retirees, and veterans. The goal of MWR is to create a "home away from home" environment, helping service members maintain morale during training and other high-stress duties.

Boston Qualifier: USATF #CA24001TEB 

 

CAMP ROBERTS ENTRY REQUIREMENTS:

All participants and visitors must comply with base access protocols

Drivers are required to provide:

  • Real ID (or valid government-issued ID)
  • Current vehicle registration and proof of insurance
  • ALL VEHICHLES ARE SUBJECT TO SEARCH AND SEIZURE

All other visitors or passengers (ages 16 and above) are also required to provide a Real ID or government-issued identification.

 

COURSE DESCRIPTION

Runners will start at the heart of the Camp Roberts instillation, heading northeast through diverse terrain and varying elevations. Along the way, participants will take in breathtaking scenic views, with chances to spot local wildlife such as elk, deer, and the elusive kit fox.

The course also offers a unique blend of natural beauty and history, featuring glimpses of California wildflowers and historic military landmarks that highlight the rich heritage of Camp Roberts.

 

AID STATIONS

Aid stations are positioned approximately every two miles, with additional placements at key turns to help guide runners along the correct route.

Stations are located at the following mile markers:

  • 1.6
  • 3.6
  • 5.1
  • 6.55 (Half Marathon Turnaround)
  • 8.0
  • 9.9
  • 12.0
  • 13.12 (Full Marathon Turnaround)


Each station is stocked with water, Powerade, bananas, oranges, energy gels, and latrines.


 

PARKING

Parking on Convoy Parking Lot on California Blvd and Montana Blvd. Short walk to the start/finish line.

 

AWARDS

All participants will receive a T-shirt and a finisher medal. Awards ceremony will be held at noon, where we’ll present a plaque to the overall first-place male and female in each race.

 

PACKET PICKUP

The Camp Roberts MWR will be hosting packet pickup at the Phoenix Recreation Center (Building 6083), located approximately 75 yards from the Start/Finish line at the corner of Arizona and California Blvd.

Packet pickup and security clearance will be available:

  • Tuesday to Friday, March 17th – 20th, 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Race Day – Saturday, March 21st, 6:00 AM - 8:00 AM

Participants are strongly encouraged to check in early during the Tuesday–Friday window to complete security clearance and avoid race-day delays.

On site reg available for $20 extra 3/17 - 3/2010AM-4PM

description:
WHAT'S THE BUZZ?

The Buzz Marathon is a Boston qualifying race, hosted at Camp Roberts California National Guard Installation. This annual event includes; A full marathon, half-marathon, 10K, 5k, and a kids 1-mile run. Proceeds of this event help fund the Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) program with their mission of soldier care. MWR provides services to support the wellbeing of military personnel, their families, retirees, and veterans. The goal of MWR is to create a "home away from home" environment, helping service members maintain morale during training and other high-stress duties.

Boston Qualifier: USATF #CA24001TEB 

 

CAMP ROBERTS ENTRY REQUIREMENTS:

All participants and visitors must comply with base access protocols

Drivers are required to provide:

  • Real ID (or valid government-issued ID)
  • Current vehicle registration and proof of insurance
  • ALL VEHICHLES ARE SUBJECT TO SEARCH AND SEIZURE

All other visitors or passengers (ages 16 and above) are also required to provide a Real ID or government-issued identification.

 

COURSE DESCRIPTION

Runners will start at the heart of the Camp Roberts instillation, heading northeast through diverse terrain and varying elevations. Along the way, participants will take in breathtaking scenic views, with chances to spot local wildlife such as elk, deer, and the elusive kit fox.

The course also offers a unique blend of natural beauty and history, featuring glimpses of California wildflowers and historic military landmarks that highlight the rich heritage of Camp Roberts.

 

AID STATIONS

Aid stations are positioned approximately every two miles, with additional placements at key turns to help guide runners along the correct route.

Stations are located at the following mile markers:

  • 1.6
  • 3.6
  • 5.1
  • 6.55 (Half Marathon Turnaround)
  • 8.0
  • 9.9
  • 12.0
  • 13.12 (Full Marathon Turnaround)


Each station is stocked with water, Powerade, bananas, oranges, energy gels, and latrines.


 

PARKING

Parking on Convoy Parking Lot on California Blvd and Montana Blvd. Short walk to the start/finish line.

 

AWARDS

All participants will receive a T-shirt and a finisher medal. Awards ceremony will be held at noon, where we’ll present a plaque to the overall first-place male and female in each race.

 

PACKET PICKUP

The Camp Roberts MWR will be hosting packet pickup at the Phoenix Recreation Center (Building 6083), located approximately 75 yards from the Start/Finish line at the corner of Arizona and California Blvd.

Packet pickup and security clearance will be available:

  • Tuesday to Friday, March 17th – 20th, 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Race Day – Saturday, March 21st, 6:00 AM - 8:00 AM

Participants are strongly encouraged to check in early during the Tuesday–Friday window to complete security clearance and avoid race-day delays.

name: California December Distance Night
description:
Join us for an evening of distance racing under the lights at Occidental College this December. This event is designed for high school and college athletes looking to leverage their cross-country fitness, as well as community runners aiming to take one final swing at a fast time before the year comes to a close.

The program will consist of 800s, Miles, and Two Miles for runners of all ability levels, as well as a few faster 5k sections to close out the night. Races will be organized for all ability levels, with pacers in each heat to support runners in reaching their pacing targets. 

We hope to see you in December in Los Angeles.

name: Camp Heartbreak – Friday the 13th of February -After Dark  5K. 10K Half Marathon
description:
💔 Camp Heartbreak – Run If You Dare
🌙 Friday the 13th of February – Long Beach
5K | 10K | Half Marathon
📍 5400 E. Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA
📅 Friday, February 13, 2026
🕓 Check-in 4:00 PM
Start Times (Based on distance) | Half 5:00 PM | 10K & 5K 6:30 PM

 
💘 About the Event
Welcome to Camp Heartbreak, where love stories end in sprint finishes and Cupid’s arrows miss… on purpose. 💀


They say heartbreak hurts — but here, it burns calories.

Join us for Run If You Dare, a Friday-the-13th Valentine’s race that mixes romance and ruin under the moonlit shoreline of Long Beach. Whether you’re running from your ex, chasing closure, or just here for the medal and the music, this night’s for the fearless and the heart-strong.

 
🌊 What to Expect
USATF-Certified Course 🏁
Professional Chip Timing ⏱️
Free Race-Day Photos 📸
Finisher Medals for All Participants 🏅
Overall & Age Group Awards
3 On-Course Water Stations (one at each turnaround)
Finish-Line Festival & Camp Dance Party 🎶
Costume Contest — Best Heartbreaker & Most Tragic Love Story 👠💔
DJ, Lights & Glow Effects for that classic CaliFlow After-Dark vibe
Runners, Walkers & Lovelorn Souls of All Paces Welcome!
 
🩶 Course Info
Your journey begins beneath the glowing CaliFlow arch at 5400 E. Ocean Blvd, tracing a flat, paved path along the waves — scenic, fast, and a little bit sinister.

Each turnaround hides a “Camp Heartbreak” surprise — maybe a runaway Cupid, a rose-covered machete, or a love letter gone wrong.

Half Marathon: 3 × 4.36-mile loops
10K: 2 × 5K out-and-backs
5K: 1 loop

Every station features glowing course markers, cheering “counselors,” and enough good vibes to heal even the most tragic of love lives.

 
🔥 The Vibe – Totally Camp CaliFlow


Think Valentine’s Day Massacre meets Glow Run Rom-Com.
We’re talking camp signs, flickering lanterns, red lights, and finish-line slow jams.

Whether you come solo, with your sweetheart, or as a crew of heartbreak survivors, one thing’s for sure — you’ll leave with a full heart and maybe a few goosebumps.

Because at CaliFlow Runs, we don’t fear Friday the 13th.
We run right through it — in style, with heart, and with a whole lot of glow.

✨ Not just a race. Join the movement.

name: Camp Shamrocked: The  Friday the 13th  After Dark - 5K. 10K. Half Marathon
description:
☘️ Camp Shamrocked: The Unlucky Run
🌲 Friday the 13th – 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach
5K | 10K | Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
📅 Friday, March 13, 2026
🕓 Check-In: 4:00 PM
Start Times | Half: 5:00 PM | 10K & 5K: 6:30 PM

 
💀 About the Event
Welcome back, campers… and may the luck be ever in your disfavor. 🍀
They say strange things happen every Friday the 13th — but when it lands right before St. Patrick’s Day, you can bet the leprechauns are up to no good.

Join us for Camp Shamrocked: The Unlucky Run, a moonlit race where green fog meets grit, and superstition takes the scenic route down the Long Beach shoreline. Whether you’re chasing a PR or just chasing your luck, you’ll be part of something rare — a tribe that runs through the chaos with heart, humor, and a little mischief.

 
🌊 What to Expect
USATF-Certified Course
Chip Timing for accurate results ⏱️
Free Race-Day Photos by Nina & Dre 📸
Finisher Medals for All Participants 🏅
Overall & Age Group Awards
3 On-Course Water Stations (one at each turnaround)
Campfire Finish Line Festival 🔥
Costume Contest – Leprechauns, Lucky Charms & Creatures of the Night 👻
DJ, Lights & Green Glow Effects for that signature CaliFlow After-Dark magic
Runners, Walkers, and Shamrocked Souls of All Paces Welcome!
 
🌕 Course Info
The course begins under the glowing CaliFlow arch near Belmont Pier, winding along the oceanfront path under the light of the moon (and maybe a little mischief).

Expect glowing green markers, fog  and checkpoints straight out of Camp Shamrocked lore:
🍀 Cabin 13 — where luck runs thin
🪞 The Clover Crossing — every 13th step’s a gamble
🔥 The Campfire Finish — where legends light up the night

Half Marathon: 3 × 4.36-mile loops
10K: 2 × 5K out-and-backs
5K: 1 loop

Each station will be fully stocked with water, encouragement, and a few surprises to keep your spirits high and your luck questionable.

 
🧿 The Vibe – Welcome to Camp Shamrocked
At CaliFlow Runs, we don’t chase luck — we create it. This is your chance to laugh in the face of superstition, defy the odds, and dance your way across that finish line under a canopy of stars and green glow.

So grab your glow sticks, pull on something lucky (or not), and join us for the most unforgettable Friday the 13th run of the year.

✨ Not just a race. Join the movement.

description:
Join us for our 12th Annual Campus Life Frozen 5k + Kids' Fun Run on Saturday, May 9, 2026 at Woodward Park. This event is for the whole family to enjoy! For those who want or need, we are still offering a virtual race option. There will be BREAKFAST, COLD BREW from Lanna Coffee, and ACAI BOWLS from TOWER BLENDZ! If this is the only reason you show up, we understand! 

This FROZEN 5k benefits Fresno/Madera Youth For Christ and the mentoring work it does with over a thousand students each year. 

 

Pricing:
Campus Life 5k: $45 $35 SPECIAL PRICING 
Virtual Campus Life 5k: $45 $35 SPECIAL PRICING 
Kids Fun Run (recommended for kids aged 2-7): $25 $15 SPECIAL PRICING 
*Shirts are only guaranteed for registrations by 4/23

 

ADDITIONAL TOP FINISHER PRIZE LEVELS!
Top 3 (Men)
Top 3 (Women)
1st Place (11 years and under)
1st Place (12-18 years)

 

Campus Life interacts with students daily to help them “give life to their story”. Find out more about YFC at www.yfcnow.org.

 

Sponsorships are available for the Campus Life 5k.

name: Castle to Coast Fun Run - 2026
description:
Wake up with the sunrise for a unique Central Coast experience!

Castle to Coast starts at stunning William Randolph Hearst Memorial Beach, nestled beneath iconic Hearst Castle. Lace up for an invigorating 8.2-mile run along breathtaking Highway 1, making your way to the charming coastal town of Cambria, finishing at Shamel Park.

Enjoy spectacular early morning ocean views of the Pacific Ocean, making this run as visually stunning as it is energizing. This low-key, feel-good event is the perfect way to kick off your new year, whether you’re a seasoned runner or simply looking for a fun and rewarding challenge.

Along the route, you’ll be supported by enthusiastic Cuesta College Student-Athlete volunteers, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience. At the finish line, participants can look forward to giveaways from Running Warehouse, FLUID Sports Nutrition and other local merchants. Plus, a convenient shuttle service will transport you back to the starting line. Stay and relax in quaint Cambria to celebrate your accomplishment.

name: Catalina Island Half-Marathon & 10K
description:
California's ultimate trail half-marathon will challenge you with its climbs, peaks, and stunning vistas, making it an unforgettable experience. You will begin your journey in Avalon, running past the historic Wrigley Mansion before entering the Interior for several miles of challenging climbs. At the summit, you will be rewarded with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean, and on a clear day, you might even spot two other islands that are part of the Channel Islands.

After taking in the incredible scenery at the summit, you'll descend through the beautiful Wrigley Memorial before returning to the town of Avalon. Additionally, the 10K route offers an equally scenic course as it winds through the picturesque hillsides of Avalon.

name: Catalina Island Marathon, 10K, 5K
description: California's State Off-Road Marathon Championship is also the oldest trail marathon in the state and takes place on beautiful Catalina Island located off the coast of Los Angeles and surrounded by blue ocean, green hills and more beauty than you have ever run through.   Experience the Catalina Island Conservancy the way it was intended to be experienced, on foot, running, and noticing the history and beauty of the island.  This is a bucket list event that you will want to run year, after year, after year.

name: CELEBRATE LIFE RUN
description:
Description: Join two-time world champion triathlete, Siri Lindley, as she celebrates her 6th year cancer-free, officially being cured of Acute Myeloid Leukemia! Siri and her wife, Bek Keat, created this annual run to honor life and make a difference ...not just for people, but for horses too!
Your tax deductible race fee will feed a horse for a week!
This event honors all life, remembers those we've lost, and embodies the resilience of the human spirit.
Race Date: February 21, 2026

Start Time: 9AM (Day of registration opens at 8AM)
Details: The CELEBRATE LIFE RUN will begin and end at Believe Ranch and Rescue where Siri and Bek rescue abused, neglected and slaughter bound horses.
You'll be able to meet Siri, Bek and their beautiful rescue horses! Enjoy horse rides, local artisan pop ups with coffee, baked goods, wine & spirits, arts and crafts! 

Race Fees:
$40 through 8/31 
$50 through 12/31
$60 through 2/20
$70 on race day
(Processing fees included)
Virtual:
$40 through 12/31
$50 through 2/21
(Processing fees included) 

Finisher medals for all participants!

Awards for top finishers and spot prizes from Rudy Project, HyperIce and F2C.

Course Description: Beautiful, picturesque Santa Ynez countryside.
Event begins and ends at Believe Ranch and Rescue, Santa Ynez, CA.
5K Map: Coming soon
 
Swag: Finisher medals included. For those attending the race in person, short sleeve dry fit tech shirts are available for purchase through this registration process that will be picked up on race day.
Virtual runners can purchase shirts here:  https://www.bonfire.com/celebrate-life-run-5k/
 
Beneficiary: 100% of proceeds will be allocated to Believe Ranch and Rescue to help save lives.
Any and all additional donations are tax deductible, 501c Believe Ranch and Rescue.

Weather Policy: Event will take place rain or shine.
 
Event Contact: info@siriandbek.com

name: Cerro Gordo Silver Run
description:
Saturday. May 23, 2026 | Start Time: 8:00 AM | Check-in by 6:30 AM
(Camping & lodging info at the bottom of this description)

Check out the video recap from this past year for more context!

Are you tough enough to race up a mountain road built for mule trains and silver barons?

Join us for a legendary race in the Eastern Sierra - an 8-mile uphill battle climbing 4,600 vertical feet to the historic ghost town of Cerro Gordo, once the richest silver mine in California.

This is not your average run.
This is a gut-check. A pilgrimage. A challenge against time, gravity, and yourself.

The infamous Cerro Gordo Road was carved out in 1865 to shuttle silver down from the mountains. Now, once a year, runners race back up - chasing glory, chasing ghosts, and chasing history.

When you summit the town, the day’s just beginning. Cross the finish line and celebrate with:
– A giant mountaintop BBQ
– Live music and games
– Self-guided exploration of the abandoned town
– And a well-earned sense of triumph.

What’s included:
- Aid stations every mile stocked with fuel and encouragement
- A limited-edition Silver Run 2026 shirt and finishers medal
- Shuttle vans for the ride back down
- Eternal bragging rights: the winner’s name is engraved in silver and enshrined in Cerro Gordo’s history

Last year’s winning time: 1:14:04 by Jacob Banta
Think you’ve got what it takes to beat it?

There’s no time limit. Whether you finish in 1 hour or 5, this mountain has room for all. We’ve had teenagers run with their parents. We’ve had an 81-year-old cross the finish line. All are welcome - as long as you're willing to dig deep and climb.

Check out the 2025 race results:
https://my.raceresult.com/341872/results

Don’t miss the most epic footrace in California.
This is all happening: Saturday. May 23, 2026 
Come run for the silver.

Camping & Lodging

Our neighbor is providing camping spots available in Keeler, CA, less than 1/4 mile from the starting line, available for $20/spot. These will have restrooms available at the campground area. This is by far the cheapest and closest accommodation option. 

Otherwise, Lone Pine, CA is 15 miles from the starting line and has a wide variety of hotels, motels, RV parks, and more. 

Another option is BLM Land camping. There is a lot of BLM land around and you can camp there for free for up to 14 days. Google "BLM camping" for more information. 

There will be multiple parking lots available in Keeler, CA the day of the race to leave your cars. There will be volunteers on site to direct you to these day of the race. After the race, you will be brought down by shuttle bus, back to these parking lots.

name: Champion Mine Trail Race
description:
Challenge Yourself and Enjoy the Great Outdoors

Join the Sierra TrailBlazers Running Club and Bear Yuba Land Trust for the inaugural Champion Mine Trail Race!

Get ready to travel to a must-see destination race in Northern California. Explore some of Nevada City’s most exciting trails with this brand-new half-marathon (13.1 miles) event. The course winds through towering pines, crosses a historic swinging bridge, and challenges runners with a series of rewarding climbs. With multiple aid stations, historical landmarks, and a newly constructed trail section offering varied terrain, this course rivals some of the best trail races in Northern California.

Runners will enjoy breathtaking views along the Tribute Trail and Deer Creek, combined with a beautiful variety of landscapes throughout the race. Best of all, the adventure begins right on Nevada City’s historic Broad Street — a truly unforgettable starting line!

The Champion Mine Trail Run offers a dynamic mix of pavement, gravel, and single-track trails, making it a must-do event for any trail enthusiast.

name: Chasing Santa – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Santa’s on the move and it’s your turn to chase him down the Long Beach coast. Chasing Santa is all about festive miles, holiday spirit, and a little seasonal mischief by the sea. Whether you’re jogging, walking, or just soaking up the holiday cheer, this run is the perfect way to start the season with miles, smiles, and a touch of Santa magic.

Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon and 10-miler start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged in advance for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out & Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More About the Course

This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Child Abuse / Foster Care Awareness 5k Run/Walk
description:
The Social Work Student organizations, Phi Alpha Honors Society, and Title IV-E program at California State University, Fresno are hosting a Child Abuse/Foster Care Awareness 5K Run/Walk, which will not only raise awareness about child abuse and Foster Care but also incorporate a wellness component for families. This dual-purpose event aims to both advocate for child safety and foster care, raising awareness of the need to support the well-being of families, caregivers, and foster youth. By promoting self-care and providing resources for mental and physical well-being, this event seeks to increase family and individual well-being. Proceeds will support next year's event to make this an annual event. 

Special pricing for children 9 and under of $25.00 - Discount applied during check-out.

name: Chino Valley YMCA Reindeer Romp 5K
description:
Join us for the 14th Annual Chino Valley YMCA Reindeer Romp at Ayala Park in Chino, California. 

PLEASE READ: The run/walk starts at 8:15 AM. You are welcome to run with your friends or family.

  • Flat and fast USATF Certified course at Ayala Park in Chino - 5665 Edison Ave., Chino, Ca 91710
  • This 5k is the first leg of the Chino Triple Crown - participate in the Chino Valley YMCA Reindeer Romp, Run for Russ (February 7th, 2026) and the DairyAire (March 7th, 2026) and receive a special Triple Crown medal! 
  • All entrants in the 5k will receive a shirt and finisher medal. 
  • ALL PROCEEDS BENEFIT THE CHINO VALLEY YMCA

 

REGISTRATION FEE SCHEDULE: 

  • 8/1/25 - 11/30/25 $45
  • 12/1/25 - 12/6/25 $50
  • Group discount of $5.00 for groups of 5 or more entrants. Paper applications only. (Please email us for an application)

 

EMAIL: romp@weymca.org

PLEASE LEAVE YOUR PETS AT HOME.

 

Packet pickup and late registration will be Friday, December 5th from 4PM - 6PM at the Chino Valley YMCA. Also Saturday morning before the race STARTING AT 7:00AM.

name: Chocolate Chase 5K for Craniofacial Awareness
description:
Join us for our Inaugural Chocolate Chase where fitness and Craniofacial awareness converge in the most delicious way! Whether you participate in the timed 5K race, one-mile walk, kids dash or just come out to celebrate and support, we will have something for everyone. Best of all--chocolate treats!   Post-race venue in Crocker Park will provide an opportunity for families and friends to connect.  Funds raised will be donated to FacesOfTomorrow.org.  

 

EVENT SWAG:

-Short-sleeved cotton t-shirt for race registrants

-Shirt or cape for superhero dash registrants 

-Commemorative medal for race and dash finishers

-See's chocolate bar at the finish line compliments of Elk Grove Orthodontics

-Referral bonus for referring 5 or more registrants: embroidered logo canvas shopper tote 

-Age group awards for 5K

 

PACKET PICK UP: 

-Saturday May 17: 10-6pm (Fleet Feet, 2311 J Street)

-Race Day Sunday May 18, 7:15am Crocker Park

 

RACE DAY SCHEDULE:

7:15am Packet pick up and event day registration

8:15am: Superhero Kids Dash start

8:30am: 5K and one mile run/walk start

 

5K COURSE INFORMATION:

Start in front of Crocker Art Museum, along Riverfront Promenade through Old Sacramento, along river to Robert Matsui Water Park and back.

 

AWARDS FOR 5K:

Top male and female finisher in each age category will be recognized.  (12 and under, 13-17, 18-21, 22-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70-79, 80+). Awards may be picked up at the awards tent at the post-race venue. If you are unable to pick up your award on race day, please email ChocolateChase916@gmail.com. Awards will not be mailed. 

 

STROLLERS & DOGS:
Strollers are permitted in the race. We just ask that you and your bundle of joy start the race in the back of the pack. No scooters, bikes, skates, skateboards on the course. 

We love dogs, but only service dogs are allowed on the course.  All other dogs are not allowed to participate, but stop by the Cleft Pup Brigade rescue for your four-legged fix!

 

GETTING HERE: 

Crocker Park is located at 211 O Street in downtown Sacramento, steps from the Capitol Mall and the Riverfront Promenade.

-By Car: Parking is conveniently located at City Lot X at 2nd and N Street for $5.  The lot is accessible via 3rd Street, turning right onto N Street. (Follow parking signs.) Two- and three-hour metered street parking is available around Crocker Park. Check parking signage for prices. Pay with card or download the ParkMobile app to find and pay for parking.  

-By Bicycle: Bike racks are located around the Crocker Art Museum's main entrance. 

-Public Transportation  Closest light rail stops are 7th Street & Capitol and 8th & K Street.  YoloBus 42B makes stops within walking distance at Capitol Mall & Front Street and Capitol Mall and 7th Street. Youth and students in grades TK-12 can ride Sac RT for free

name: Cinco De Mayo Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🌶️🏃‍♂️ Run Against All Odds: Cinco de Mayo Run! 🌟

This Cinco de Mayo, challenge yourself and celebrate resilience, community, and culture with the Cinco de Mayo Run Against All Odds! Whether you’re running for fun or for fitness, this event is all about pushing limits and embracing the spirit of overcoming obstacles—just like the holiday itself! 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: CINCO DE MILE 5 QUE- FRESNO 5K
description:
Come and celebrate “5 de Mayo” at this UNIQUE EVENT! Join your fellow taco loving participants and run this SCENIC COURSE out and back along Woodward park. Course is on a bike paved trail and some dirt road/trail! As you cross the finish line, you will be greeted by a post-run FIESTA like none other!  MUSIC ENTERTAINMENT before, during, and after your run, followed by a FOLKLORICO DANCE demonstration. Whether running or supporting a runner, everyone is welcome to celebrate running, food, and community. For sure, a FUN event you don't want to miss! 

Our 5K is a 20-point CENTRAL VALLEY RUNNER OF THE YEAR event. 

All participants receive:

  • FREE TACOS for ALL participants!!
  • MEXICAN “AGUAS FRESCAS”
  • SHIRT  
  • UNIQUE MEDAL 
  • AGE GROUP UNIQUE AWARDS
  • EXTRA/ADDITIONAL MEDAL!!  Reyes Running Series! Collect all of them! 
  • 20 PT RUNNER OF THE YEAR SERIES EVENT (5 mile race)
  • DANCE ENTERTAINMENT (FOLKLORICO/ZUMBA)
  • ATHENA/CLYDESDALE AGE GROUP CATEGORIES
  • KIDS RACES INCLUDING A 10 METER "RUN" FOR KIDS UNDER 1 YEAR OLD
  • GREAT, RUNNING COURSE (WIDE OPEN, OUT AND BACK, DIRT TRAIL)
  • DJ, MUSIC, FUN!!

SPECIAL AWARDS FOR THE FOLLOWING: 

  • LATIN DANCE COMPETITION (Cumbia, salsa, merengue...)
  • BEST COSTUME COMPETITION  for 5 de Mayo!
  • CLYDESDALE (MEN- 225LBS)  AND ATHENA (WOMEN-185LBS) AGE GROUP CATEGORIES 

6:00PM    CINCO DE MILE 5 QUE RUN/WALK AND 2 MILE WALK 

5:45PM    KIDS RACES

                                        AWARDS

TOP 3 AGE GROUP CATEGORIES 5 QUE RUN AND ATHENA/CLYDESDALE GROUP CATEGORIES. NO AWARDS FOR 2 MILE WALK.   

                                        KIDS RACES!!!!

5:45PM- 400 meters (7–10-year-old)                   5:52PM-  50 meters (1–2-year-old) 

5:47PM- 200 meters (5-6 year-old)                       5:55PM-  10 meters (under 1 year-old)

5:49PM-  100 meters (3–4-year-old)

UNIQUE AWARDS FOR TOP 3  (BOYS/GIRS) ON EACH KIDS RACE!! ALL KIDS GET A SHIRT/MEDAL!!

Walking Registration & Packet Pickup:  THURSDAY, 04/30TH/25 (4:30-6:30 PM). FLEET FEET, Fresno. 

Race Day Registration & Packet Pickup:  FRIDAY, 05/01/25 (4:00-5:45 PM) GROUP ACTIVITY AREA                                

Information:  camposlove2run@yahoo.com           Race Director:  Jesus Campos 

Bakersfield runners, join us SUNDAY, MAY 3RD!  Bakersfield Race: bakersfield5que.com

name: Cinderella Trail Run
description:
The course travels through beautiful Joaquin Miller & Redwood Regional parks. You'll wind through tall redwoods along popular Sequoia-Bayview and French trails. Then, come back to the finish down the very technical Cinderella trail. Some runners call it the "Wicked Step Sisters" trail.

(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: Citrus Heritage Run
description:
The Citrus Heritage Run is a Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, and 1-mile kids race on Saturday, January 10, 2026. This unique and “sweet-smelling” course winds through the historic orange groves of the California Citrus State Historic Park in Riverside, CA. As one of the most scenic course routes in Southern California, you will experience breathtaking views of surrounding mountain ranges and skyline as you inhale the smell of sweet citrus and orange blossoms beginning to bloom. This race is truly one-of-a-kind and all race distances sold out in 2025!

This event is a great tune-up race for 2026. We offer high-quality tech-fabric long-sleeve tees in men’s, women’s, and youth sizes, finisher medals, and age group awards. Along the course, you will find entertainment (live bands) and several hydration stops. At the finish line, you will be greeted with music by a live band and post-race refreshments which include freshly squeezed orange juice from a local orange grove, as well as warm food, a celebratory beer and hand-crafted mimosas! 

The Citrus Heritage Run is an experience you won’t want to miss!

name: City of Artesia 5K Run/Walk
description:
Come join us at the 2nd Annual City of Artesia 5K Run/Walk! The goal of our event is to promote health and fitness in the Artesia Community! We invite you to run or walk our event, meet new friends, and enjoy our Health & Wellness expo afterwards, featuring food truck, vendors, giveaways, and more!

Race Bib Pickup: Participants will be able to pick up their race bibs early on Thursday, November 13 and Friday November 14 at the Albert O. Little Community Center at Artesia Park (18750 Clarkdale Ave.) during the hours of 5pm-8pm. Bibs can also be picked up the day of the race before 6:30am!

name: City of Lincoln Huffin' for the Stuffin' Turkey Trot
description:
Welcome to the 8th annual Huffin' for the Stuffin' Turkey Trot presented by the City of Lincoln Recreation Department.

Our 5K run is LIVE with professional timers again this year as we continue our festive engagement with families and community. There is a .17 mile Donut Dash for children 4 to 7 years old to take part in as always. 

This event is a FUN RUN and meant for community engagement & family FUN! There will be 1st, 2nd & 3rd place finisher awards as well as general finisher award for participants who sign up before the deadline. The proceeds from our run helps to support the City of Lincoln Recreations Scholarship Fund which helps offer scholarships (financial aid) to cover fees for our recreation programs to families in need. 

Registration: Registration is now open thru November 24th 2025.  Please register by November 1st to receive a shirt and finisher award!

We do order extra shirts, they will be on a first come first served basis after the deadline. 

Race Schedule: Thursday, November 27th 7:45am arrival

RACE DAY
Plan to arrive no later than 7:45am in order to park and arrive at the starting area for announcements. The first announcments start promptly at 8:00am.

Refreshments provided for all registered participants following the race.

All 5K participants receive a unisex 50/50 cotton blend race shirt. Late registrants are not guaranteed choice of shirt or medal.

Register online by November 1, 2025 to guarantee your shirt size and finisher award!

                           Kids Donut Dash at 8:00am 

                           5K to start at 8:30am 

Route Information: Twelve Bridges Park and trail 5k/10K route  Lincoln Turkey Trot 5K - 

https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6645991889/ 

Pre-Race Shirt Pick Up: Lincoln Community Center 2010 First Street Lincoln CA 95648

Tuesday, November 25th & Wednesday, November 26th 11am to 6pm.

Please plan to attend one of the Pickup days or have someone collect your shirt for you. We will be accepting late registrations at Packet Pickup until sold out; however, please register early to guarantee your shirt and finisher award! IF YOU DID NOT GET A SHIRT OR ARE REGISTERED FOR THE DONUT DASH ONLY, YOU DO NOT NEED to COME TO THE PICK UP DATES. The pick up dates are mainly for the shirt pick up.

Refund Policy: All entries are non-refundable and non-transferable and are considered a donation to our recreation department (without purchase of race insurance)

name: City of Selma 5K Color Run
description:
The City of Selma SPARCS Department is happy to introduce the first 5K Color Run! This event is a non-competitive run for participants of all ages and abilities. This event will not be timed, and color stations will be spread out throughout the course. (YES, COLOR STATIONS!) The colored powder is made of a biodegradable, non-toxic material that is easy to wash off. A T-shirt, sunglasses and medal come included with your registration. Hope to see ya on November 15th!

-SPARCS Staff

name: City to the Sea Half Marathon & 5K
City to the Sea Half Marathon & 5K
City to the Sea Half Marathon & 5K
description:
More info and race registration is at: https://www.citytothesearun.com/ 

The City to the Sea Half Marathon, presented by Running Warehouse, is a breathtaking point-to-point race that begins in the heart of downtown San Luis Obispo. The course guides runners past iconic local landmarks, through scenic country backroads, and along the picturesque Bob Jones Trail, culminating at the edge of the Pacific Ocean in the charming coastal community of Avila Beach.

The Avila-Seaside 5K is an out-and-back course with roughly 75% of the route showcasing breathtaking views of the beach, harbor, and the Pacific Ocean. Keep a keen eye open for sea lions, otters and whales along the route. The course briefly joins the scenic Bob Jones Trail before finishing at the beautiful Avila Beach Resort.

name: Clarksburg Country Run
description:
Please join us for the 59th Annual Clarksburg Country Run. Break away from the city and enjoy some small town hospitality. This event offers a variety of race distances and you can enjoy a complimentary lunch after the race. 

New this year: 5K, 10K, Half, and 30K entries will receive a post-race beer sample (new!), plus a choice regarding their t-shirt type: choose from either a DryBlend long sleeve shirt (available in unisex sizes; Adult S-3X, Youth S-XL) or a 100% polyester long sleeve shirt (Additional $5 fee for 100% polyester) (Available in sizes XXS-2X). Don't want a t-shirt? Opt-out and save $5.00. 5K, 10K, Half, and 30K entries also include a bib/timing, finisher medal, eligibility for awards, and post-race meal.

The Kids Fun Run is non-competitive and not timed, and all entrants will receive a bib, finisher medal and post-race meal. Add on a long sleeve DryBlend t-shirt for $8.00. 

 

Packet Pick Up

Race packets (bib and shirt) can be picked up before the race on Saturday, November 1st, at Fleet Feet in Elk Grove, from 11am to 2pm. Fleet Feet is located at 7460 Elk Grove Blvd #120, Elk Grove, CA 95757. 

On race day, Sunday November 2, 2025, bibs can be picked up at the race site beginning at 6:30 am. In person registration also available during this time. Arrive one hour before your race start if picking up on event morning.

Refund and Transfer Policy

All entries are non-refundable and non-transferable to another event or another athlete; event happens rain or shine. Race insurance is available to participants but is not required. We reserve the right to cancel, delay or postpone the event due to Acts of God or other local emergencies which would threaten the safety and health of participants, spectators, volunteers, or officials. No refunds, deferrals, or transfers to someone else in the case of injury, change of plans, etc. 

Start Times

30K - 8:00 a.m.
Kids Runs - 8:10 a.m.
Half Marathon - 8:30 a.m.
5K/10K - 8:45 a.m.
Please Note: The Clarksburg Country Run course cut-off time is 12:30 p.m.

name: Clovis Rudolph Run
description:
Continue the newest family tradition! Bring friends and enjoy a fun morning of music and Reindeer Games!

 

Kids (12 and under) will receive a bib, finishers medal, and reindeer antlers - Youth Rudolph sweatshirt is extra.

 

Adults reicieve a bib, finisher's medal, reindeer antlers and a Rudolph Run sweatshirt

 

Festivities begin and end at California Health Sciences University (North of the Fairfield Inn & Suites, Sierra and Clovis)

 

Donations and a portion of the proceeds support the Poverello House which serves the hungry, the homeless, and the destitute in our community.

Amenities:

  • Reindeer Antlers
  • Decorated course
  • Rudolph Holiday Sweatshirt
  • Hot Cocoa Bar
  • Chip Timing
  • Finisher's Medal
  • Costume Contest for the most festive outfit

name: Clueless & Breathless 5K, 10K & Half
description:
December 20, 2025 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Like, ugh, are you seriously going to miss this?
Step into your platform shoes and strut into the Clueless & Breathless 5K, 10K & Half—a 90s high school holiday run bursting with mall glam, holiday sparkle, and way too much lip gloss.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you’re a Beverly Hills princess, a debate team queen, or just trying to burn off those holiday carbs, this race is your chance to be totally buggin’—in the best way.

  •  Clueless & Breathless 5K 🎀 This one's as quick as a shopping trip to The Galleria. Bonus if you run in plaid.
  • Totally Buggin’ 10K 💅 Longer than Cher's holiday gift list—and twice as fierce.
  • The Alaïa Half Marathon 👠 Because it's like, a totally important designer challenge. Don’t get mugged—stay hydrated.
  • The Multiverse Holiday Shopping Spree (Virtual) 🛍️ Run any distance, from anywhere—even the food court. Your medal ships post-haste.

Expect mallcore energy, glam cheer zones, 90s jams, and a sprinkle of holiday chaos.
Costumes strongly encouraged—extra credit for fur-trimmed Santa hats and feather pens.

 
📦 Multiverse Option (Virtual Runners Welcome!)
Run virtually anytime from Dec 20–22, and we’ll mail your medal faster than a boyfriend makeover montage.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race—fun, fast, and full of nostalgia.

Sign up now. This run is like, totally important.

 
Parody Disclaimer
This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 90s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: Coalinga Turkey Trot
description:
The inaugural Coalinga Turkey Trot is happening on Thanksgiving morning!
Trot your way through the 5K course or walk the 2K (1.2 miles) before you head home to feast. 
The event is family-friendly, so make sure to sign up your all of your kids, cousins, aunts and uncles! 
The event takes place rain or shine at the Coalinga-Huron Sports Complex on Cambridge Avenue.
Please NO PETS, but strollers are welcome. 
Each participant will receive a Turkey Trot t-shirt. 
Proceeds from the race will benefit the Coalinga Lions Club.

You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon!

 

Overview:

Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.

This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com

name: Concord 5000
description: Concord High School Cross Country and Track & Field teams are excited to host this unique opportunity for our community. Have you been running 5k road races and are interested in running on the TRACK to get your true 5000 meter time with a professional timer? Then this race is for you. We will have a fun, festive atmosphere where you are cheered on by other runners. There will be music, a food truck, a custom shirt vendor and prizes for the top three finishers in each category, plus a special gift for the fastest couple of the night! (It is the day before Valentine's Day!) Proceeds will benefit Concord High School Cross Country and Track & Field programs. Concord High is a Title 1 school with over 50% low-income families, so profits will go toward race entry fees, team gear/uniforms, and individual shoes. Tell all your friends to join us under the lights on Friday, February 13th!

name: Concord California Turkey Trot 5K
description:
Diablo Valley Federal Credit Union (DVFCU) is pleased to welcome you to our information page about the Concord Turkey Trot, a 5K run/walk benefiting Loaves and Fishes of Contra Costa.

The event will take place at Newhall Park on Thanksgiving, Thursday, November 27, 2025, at 8 AM.  For the safety and enjoyment of all participants, registration for this event is capped at 1,850 participants.  Everyone participating in the 5K run/walk course must have a paid registration, with the exception of children 2 years old and under, who will be in a stroller for the duration of the event. 

The course includes varied terrain, including grass fields, park pathways, and city streets. Those participating with strollers or pets will be asked to enter at the back of the start area so as not to impede those wishing to race for time. All 5K Run/Walk Participants will receive a tech t-shirt and a medal!

The race will take place rain or shine.  Once your registration has been paid, there are no refunds. This includes inclement weather or any other reason, such as injuries or personal emergencies.

name: Conquer The Pier at Venice Beach 5K
description:

name: Corona 5000
description:
From 1913-1916, the roar of engines and the thrill of speeds approaching 100 mph electrified Grand Boulevard in Corona, as up to 100,000 spectators cheered during the legendary Corona Road Races. This perfect circle in the heart of “Circle City” was the stage for automotive history. Now, 110 years later, Grand Boulevard is set to pulse with excitement once again!

Join us for the Inaugural Corona 5000, a vibrant 5K run and walk that revives the spirit of this historic course. Lace up your shoes and be part of a new legacy, racing or strolling the iconic loop of Grand Boulevard. 

This is a Race For the Ages, all ages. 

Don’t miss your chance to make history in Corona’s Circle City!

name: Coronado Turkey Trot presented by Rady Children’s Hospital Auxiliary
description:
MOVE YOUR FEET BEFORE THE FEAST!

Join us for the 12th Annual Turkey Trot presented by the Coronado Unit of the Rady Children’s Hospital Auxiliary on Thanksgiving, November 27, 2025, at Tidelands Park. This family-friendly 5K welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. Enjoy a beautiful course along the San Diego Bay and celebrate the holiday with a fun, festive atmosphere! For our 15 and under runners, your age-based pricing discount is already built in as soon as you enter your birth date.

All net proceeds benefit the Orthopedics and Scoliosis Center at Rady Children's Hospital-San Diego. Register early as this event sells out every year!

 

Race Day Schedule


6:30am – Packet Pick-Up Opens

7:35am – Pre-Race Warm Up with Coronado Fitness Club

8:00am – 5K Start 

9:15am – Awards Ceremony (Overall Winners)

9:30am – Event Concludes

Subject to change

 

Packet Pick Up - Hours & Locations

 

Saturday November 22nd, 2025
Spreckels Park
601 Orange Ave, Coronado, CA 92118
10:00 AM – 2:00 PM

 

RACE DAY, November 27, 2025
Tidelands Park
2000 Mullinex Dr, Coronado, CA 92118
6:30 AM – 8:00 AM

 

Notes for Packet Pick-Up

Walk-up Registration is available at Packet Pick-Up if the event is not sold out. Photo IDs are required. You may pick up for a friend if you have a copy of their photo ID. NO EXCEPTIONS! Photos of ID shown on cell phones are accepted. Please plan on attending one of the pre-race packet pick-ups; out-of-towners may pick up on race morning beginning at 6:30am, but it is discouraged.

name: Corporal Javier Bejar Memorial Run     Reedley Police Department
description:
Join us as we honor the life and legacy of Corporal Javier Bejar, a Reedley Police Officer, Marine Corps veteran, and beloved member of our community who made the ultimate sacrifice in the line of duty.

This memorial run is more than a race—it’s a tribute to courage, service, and community. Every stride taken represents our gratitude for Corporal Bejar’s dedication and the enduring impact he left behind.

All participants will receive a commemorative race shirt and finisher’s medal, designed to celebrate his life and sacrifice. Whether you run, walk, or cheer from the sidelines, your presence helps keep his memory alive and supports the values he stood for: honor, commitment, and service.

Together, let’s run in remembrance and unity.

 

Packet Pickup & Schedule

Packet Pickup: Friday, February 20th from 3:00pm - 6:00pm

Reedley PD - Annex Building 843 G Street, Reedley, CA

Schedule:

Saturday, February 21st

6:00am Late Packet Pickup 

7:00am Ceremony

7:20am 6 Mile Walk Start

7:45am 2 Mile Walk & 6 Mile Run Start

name: Countdown to the Finish – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
End your 2025 on a High Note with High Tides Runs!

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free. See map at the bottom of this email

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the tables closest to Claremont Ave
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route
An early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged in advance for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

We will have tent set up west of the Finish Line for spectators to watch you run. See map at the bottom of this email. We do not have shade or seating in the festival area for them.

On-Course Support
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details
Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!

Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.

Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.

Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, and Fountain Valley. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Courage to Thrive 5K Walk/Run
description:
Courage to Thrive 5K Walk/Run 

Sunday, November 9th, 2025 | Bolsa Chica State Beach | 9:00 AM

Join us for a powerful morning of movement, community, and purpose at the inaugural Courage to Thrive 5K Walk/Run Fundraiser. Whether you're walking, jogging, or running—your steps will support something much bigger than the finish line.

What It’s About

This event is hosted by The Courage to Thrive, an upstart organization dedicated to supporting individuals affected by cancer. All proceeds will go toward helping participants access integrative cancer conferences, healing workshops, and unconventional testing not typically covered by insurance. Our goal is to remove financial barriers and provide hope through education, empowerment, and healing resources.  

*Disclaimer: The Courage to Thrive is an upstart organization and is a non-profit, but is NOT currently a 501(c)(3).  Donations will be accepted but are not tax deductible. The proceeds of this event will be used in the formation of the 501 (c)(3) non-profit organization and for the initial objectives of the organization in 2026.   

Who Can Join?

Everyone! This event is open to all ages and all fitness levels. Bring your Thrive Tribe and walk or run in honor of those who have faced cancer, are currently in treatment, or are thriving after diagnosis.

Event Information:

Parking: 

The race will begin next to parking lot 25 of Bolsa Chica State Beach, which is the last lot on the north end of the beach, and is near the intersection of Warner and Pacific Coast Highway 1.  

The entrance to the State Beach parking lots, including Lot 25, is located approximately 1.5 miles south of the parking lot itself, off Pacific Coast Highway. To reach Parking Lot 25 you must use the main State Beach entrance, pay for parking, and then turn right, heading north towards the intersection of PCH and Warner Ave to find Lot 25.  Parking is $20 per vehicle and can be paid with cash, card or apple pay. 

We recommend arriving at least 45–60 minutes before your race start to allow time for parking, bib pickup (if needed), and warm-up. 

Registration and packet pickup (7:30a.m.): 

Registration and packet pickup (including your bib) will be located near the starting line of the race and will open at 7:30a.m.  If you are having someone else pick up your packet they will need two things:

1. A printed copy of your ID
2. A printed, signed copy of the waiver. You can download and print the waiver from this link.

No bibs will be given out without these two things. Our insurance company require us to be strict on this. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Race Day Timeline – Sunday, November 9th

6:00 am: Parking Lots Open. 
7:30 am: Registration is Open 
8:30 am: Warm Up  
9:00 am: 5K start

We will see you at the starting line!

-The Courage to Thrive Run Team
