(We’ll only postpone for tsunamis, tidal waves, or a zombie turkey uprising 🧟‍♀️🦃 — you’ll get an email if that happens.)

 
🎉 Join the Flock!
Bring your crew, bring your feathers, and join us for a morning of miles, medals, and major gobbles!
Let’s make this the most festive trot on the coast.

🦃💨 Come Huff for the Stuff and Run for the Pie!

💫 A Quick Note
There are several races that take place in and around our Long Beach course locations — but there’s only one CaliFlow Runs. 🌊 We are not affiliated with any of them.


If you’re looking for an exceptional race experience with professional chip timing, free photos, well-organized staff, and that signature CaliFlow vibe, make sure you see the CaliFlow Runs name or logo before you register.


If it’s not CaliFlow, it’s just an "average"race.. ❤️

name: Hungry Dog Dash 2026
description:
Whether you are a serious distance runner or a casual weekend warrior, come join us for the 13th annual Hungry Dog Dash 5K run/walk on Sunday, February 8, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. The course will be fast, flat and beautiful as you run along one of San Diego’s most spectacular waterways in Liberty Station, Point Loma.

We look forward to once again hosting runners and walkers of all skill levels and ages at our USAT&F certified course and sanctioned event.

This race is very DOG FRIENDLY! Feel free to bring your leashed, four-legged running buddy to enjoy the run with you.

All proceeds from The Hungry Dog Dash fundraiser go to the Point Loma High School Cross Country Team.  The event also helps raise awareness with younger students in the community about the PLHS running program. We hope you will join us for this community and family event promoting fitness and healthy lifestyles! Finish line activities will include live music, food, drinks, a local business vendor village and fun for everyone.

Please note: The deadline for us to order t-shirts is JANUARY 25, 2026. After that date we cannot guarantee shirts &/or sizes.

Thank you for your support!

PACKET PICK UP INFORMATION  Race packet pick-up is on Friday, February 6th from 5:00pm-7:00pm.  Packet pick up will be at Road Runner Sports located at 5553 Copley Drive, San Diego CA 92111. Each Packet picked up at Road Runner Sports earns PLHS $1.50!

https://stores.roadrunnersports.com/ca/sandiego/running-shoe-store-101.html

We strongly encourage participants to pick up bibs on Friday to avoid long lines on race day.  If you registered after the guaranteed t-shirt deadline on 1/25, you have a better chance of getting a shirt on Saturday. 

If picking up your packet on race day, please give yourself ample time.

name: Impact 5K:  Dash Thru the 80s
description:
IMPACT 5K:  DASH THRU THE 80s STRIKES BACK!

Join us on FEBRUARY 22nd for a day to support addiction recovery!

Check in starts at 6AM, the 5K starts promptly at 8am.  Join us for an inspiring and impactful day at the second annual Impact Drug & Alcohol Treatment Center 5K Run/Walk at the picturesque Hahamongna Watershed Park in Pasadena. This exciting event is designed to bring together our community in support of a healthier, safer, and more vibrant Pasadena.

COME IN YOUR BEST 80s GEAR!  

We will be rocking to the sounds of 80s tribute band THE SKINNY TIES

Dash Thru the 80s will host a costume contest with amazing prizes and judged by KROQ's Megan Holiday!

Impact has been active in the treatment of addiction for men and women for over 50 years.  Our ability to continue this level of care comes because of the generosity of our supporters.  This event, and the funds raised, will go a long way toward making sure that we can continue the simple promise we make to everyone still lost in the fog of addiction:  we're here when you're ready.

We can't wait to see you all at Hahamongna Park!

name: Inaugural AMCFF “Running Con Ganas” 5K to Unite Los Angeles Community at LA Mission College
description:
AMCFF is proud to announce the first ever Running Con Ganas 5K, taking place on Saturday, November 8, 2025, at Los Angeles Mission College. This inspiring community run will bring together students, families, and neighbors to celebrate health, determination, and educational opportunity.

“Ganas” — the Spanish word for “desire, drive, and motivation” — reflects the spirit of this event. All fitness levels are welcome to participate in the 5K, which will weave through the scenic LA Mission College campus and surrounding areas.

Running With Purpose

The AMCFF “Running Con Ganas” 5K is more than just a race — it’s a movement to:

Promote health, wellness, and community pride
Encourage students and families to engage in active lifestyles
Raise funds to support the 2026 AMCFF Scholars, providing financial assistance and resources to deserving students

Runners will receive a medal and timed bib!

For more information, visit www.cardenasfoundation.org/

name: Indio Veterans 5K Run/Walk
description:
This Veteran's 5K Run/Walk is to honor and support the brave men and women who served our country. This family-friendly event is great for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities, offering a course through an area of the Empire Polo. Come join us in this event as we celebrate veterans' service and sacrifice. 

Participants will receive a commemorative t-shirt and a portion of the proceeds will benefit Hunter Lopez Memorial Foundation. This event will also feature a pre-race celebration with refreshments, music, and a special ceremony to honor our veterans. Let's come together to run, remember, and show our appreciation for those who have given so much for our freedom. 

Kid’s under the age of 10 are free and veteran’s receive a $25 discount.

name: Inland Valley Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the 4th annual Inland Valley Turkey Trot! The race will take place in the City of Menifee from Lago Vista Sports Park. The 2 Mile, 5K, and 10K courses are flat and fast with a downhill start and short uphill to the finish along scenic Menifee Lakes. The course is perfect for runners and walkers of all ages!

**Please be aware that this event is held on an open course, which means the streets will remain open to traffic. All three events will occur on the sidewalks and bicycle paths that run along the course.**

**Please visit the Inland Valley Turkey Trot event page for race and course info**

Events

**All events are capped to a limited field size** 

  • 2-Mile
  • 5-K
  • 10-K
  • Endurance Challenge (10K, 5K, 2 Mile)
  • Kids Fun Run (300 Meter Dash)

What's included in registration:

  • 2025 Commemorative T-Shirt - Unisex/Men's and Women's Styles
  • 2025 Finisher's Medal
  • Race Bib with Chip Timing
  • Free Race Photos
  • Complimentary Churro!
  • Post Race Snacks and Refreshments
  • Kids Fun Run Participant Medal and Donut (Kids Ages 2-8 Only)

Race Day Schedule

Race Start begins on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, November 27, 2025

  • 6:30am - 10K Race
  • 6:30am - Endurance Challenge (10K, 5K, 2 Mile)
  • 8:00am - 5K Race
  • 9:00am - 2 Mile Race
  • 9:30am - Kids Fun Run (Parents may run/walk alongside their child during the run)

2Mile, 5K, and 10K Endurance Challenge!

Craving a Thanksgiving Feast running challenge? Sign up for the Endurance Challenge and complete all three distances for the ultimate Thanksgiving Day challenge!

Only 20 spots are available for the Endurance Challenge, so act quickly to secure your spot and get the opportunity to complete all three races!

Run as a team!

Make it a fun Thanksgiving activity for the whole family. Grab your friends and family and sign up as a team! 2025 turkey trot teams will be entered to win a charcuterie board from Boards by Design Charcuterie!

Awards

Custom awards brought to you by goruncrew!

  • The top three overall men and women in each distance will receive a custom race medal and goruncrew prize.
  • Overall winners will receive a complimentary entry into next year's turkey trot event!
  • Set a new course record and win a goruncrew prize!

Course Records

10K

  • Colby Piehler-Pike - 36:37 (2024)
  • Jessica Clayton - 39:46 (2023)

5K

  • Jared Saunders - 17:27 (2023)
  • Angela Neill - 19:30 (2022)

2 Mile

  • Tyler White - 11:50 (2023)
  • Gabriela Sevilla - 15:09 (2023)

Lago Vista Start/Finish Area

  • Snacks and refreshments provided by Baron's Market at the Start/Finish area.
  • Breakfast burritos, coffee and dessert will be available for purchase onsite from local vendors!
  • Each Kids Fun Run participant will receive a participant medal and donut.
  • Our friends from PacificPro Physical Therapy Canyon Hills will be onsite!

name: Iron Mountain Hike
description:
6 mi out & back | Moderate Difficulty | Elevation Gain 1,110 to 1,950 feet | Poway, CA

The first section of the trail is easy to moderate, with little incline. The middle section of the trail switchbacks east of the peak and overlooks Ramona. The top section to the peak is steep, rocky areas and switchbacks. 

Safety Tips: Shade is extremely limited on this trail. Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (hat). Use sunblock. Must carry 2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone.

name: Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
description:
Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
Thursday, November 27th, 2025
Thanksgiving Day
Irvine Valley College

THERE IS AN AWESOME CUSTOM CAST FINISHER MEDAL awaiting ALL you!  Choices of designs when you finish. A great race bib.  And the perfect Turkey designed, fun event shirt. 

7:30 am Turkey Feast Combo 1 Mile and 5k

8:00 am 5k Turkey Trot Race

9:10 am Kids Gobble Wobble Races Start

Two New Race Choices!  Choose the best race for you and earn a custom finishers medal and slice of fresh pumpkin pie!
Run fast, jog, trot, walk, or enjoy a nice stroll on this flat scenic course.  A scrumptious SLICE OF PIE awaits you at the finish. Along with So Cal's best custom cast finisher medal, you get an awesome shirt and CHIP TIMED.  Get your friends and family together and kick off the holidays together!   Guaranteed to be a picture perfect way to start celebrating THANKSGIVING DAY!

Run up a mini appetite with our family friendly 1 Mile or kick it up a notch with our 5k.  For those who plan to really indulge your can double down and enter our Turkey Feast Combo and run the 1 Mile and the 5k back to back!  This flat, friendly course is walker friendly and stroller ready.  Come out and see why it's become a holiday tradition for thousands of people !

We'll DECK out your Thanksgiving trimmings with:

*. Awesome Custom Cast Medals.
*. Soft Comfy event shirts for all.
*. Tasty pumpkin pie at the finish.
*. Custom Race bibs.
*  Chip timing by Itz About Time. 
*. Division awards for top three male and female in each age division. 5 year age spans from 10 & under to 80 & over!
*. Trophies for top three overall finishers male and female.
*. Holiday Expo to jump start your shopping.

1 Mile Turkey Dash:  7:30am Start.  This division is a fun run/ walk and non timed event.  This is great start for those who want a shorter distance to keep their whole tribe together.  It’s and out and back course so you’ll see everyone both directions!   If you gotta skip out quick then come on out for this one and earn some fast bling with a fantastic medal for everyone who finishes.

IRVINE/OC 5k Turkey TROT:  8:00am Start.  This is open to all ages and takes place around the perimeter of the college campus.  It's a speedy course that swings by citrus grove tree's and some pumpkin patches!  it starts and finishes in the same spot so you won't miss seeing your friends somewhere along the way!  

Turkey Feast Combo:  7:30am Start.  This is for the those who like extra helpings at Thanksgiving!  We love this challenge!  Each participant will start at 7:30 with the 1 mile race.  You'll need to complete the 1 mile in 30 minutes so you'll have time to line up for your second race, the 5k at 8am.  You’ll receive 1 shirt and two medals if you complete both races!  Rally up!  You may pick up your 1 mile medal after your 5k race so you don't have to run with it!

Gobble Wobble Kids Event:  These kids races offer shorter distances if they don't want to do the 5k.  9:15 A.M:  Diaper Dash - 50 yards (3 and under)
9:20 A.M:  Tot Trot  - 100 yards (4 to 5 years old)
9:25 A.M: Youth Race -1/4 Mile (6 to 10 years old)
9:28 A.M: Youth Race - Half Mile (11 to 12 years old)


Kid's Gobble Wobble Race Details

All participants receive a race bib, custom cast medal, event t-shirt, and slice of pie!   5k is chip timed and kid's runs are for fun.  We will start lining the kids up at 9:05 per age group.  All the kids races are on a out and back loop and start and end in the same spot.   The course will be closed and lined with volunteers to direct all kids to the turnaround spot. They can turn early if they want with no penalty if they think it's too far.  One adult per child can run with their participant and the parent does not have to register but will not receive the shirt, medal, bib or pie. 

If you have a child that just wants to ride in a stroller with you on the 5k course, they can do so without registering.  They will not receive a medal, bib, shirt or pie but they can share yours! 

Awards

Professional Chip timing and results for all 5k participants. Age Division awards will be given 3 deep in the following age categories: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, *70-74, *75-79, *80 and over. Yes!  We split the final divisions to celebrate our 70 and over rock star field!  We're happy to celebrate this growing category and look forward to seeing everyone earn their race bling! 

Costume Awards will be given for Best Dressed so come decked out and you may take home a prize! Win as an individual or a group (6 people max)!

Early Packet Pick Up: Optional

Packet Pick up will be held on Wednesday, November 26th from 12 pm to 4pm at Road Runner Sports in Laguna Hills.
24291 Avenida De La Carlota; Suite P-5; Laguna Hills, CA 92653  (plan on i being a traffic day, give extra time to 

Pick up your bib and shirt  at packet pick up or on race morning at the race from 6:30am to 7:30am
One person can pick up for others
Walk up registration accepted at early packet pick and on race day morning.
Shirts and Shirts sizes are not guaranteed for race day late registration.

Race Day Pick Up:

You may pick up your race bib and t-shirt on race day from 6:30 am to 7:30 am. In the quad, in front of the performance arts theater. That's the big two story orange building on the Irvine Valley College campus.

Parking:  Cost is $5.  Entrance is only allowed on Jeffrey (Entrance closed on Irvine Center Drive- its part of course).  All other campus entrances will be closed.

YOU MUST purchase a  PARKING PASS AN PUT ON YOUR DASH.  THIS CAN BE DONE ONLINE, AT PACKET PICK UP, OR with attendants as you drive into the lots.  THE CAMPUS PD charge  for every vehicle and look for the passes.  ( This parking fee is required on entering and parking at any local college).

Takes place wind, rain, or shine.

FAQ's
 Are dogs allowed? Due to college's policy, dogs are not allowed on the run course.

name: Ivanhoe Runs Silver Lake! Two-mile Run/Walk
description:
The Ivanhoe Run is back with a new home, more forgiving mile-count and laid back start time.

Join us on Saturday, November 15th for a timed fun run/walk around our beloved Silver Lake Reservoir. Beginning and ending at the Rec Center complex, this casual two-mile loop is for anyone looking to lace up and move: all paces and ages welcome! In addition to the two-mile timed event, a 100m Dragon Dash (for kids 5 and under) will also be held at the starting line.

  • 9am | Day-of Registration, bib and t-shirt pick-up 
  • 10am | Start time for the two-mile timed run/walk
  • 11am | Start time for the 100m Dragon Dash 

Registrants receive: Custom Race T-Shirt* | Chip Timing and Live Results | Finisher Ribbon | Age Group Awards | Refreshments pre and post race!

Whether you're a marathoner, weekend warrior, walker, stroller-pusher, and/or someone who just wants to hang out at the playground and drink coffee, join us! 

All proceeds support Friends of Ivanhoe.

name: Jingle Bell Jog – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Jingle Bell, Jingle Bell, Jingle Bell Jog!

Join us at Alamitos Beach this December for the Jingle Bell Jog, a holly jolly celebration of festive vibes, ocean views, and merry miles. Whether you’re racing to sleigh your PR or just dashing through the sand with bells on, this cheerful coastal run is the perfect way to wrap up your year with some holiday sparkle.

It's the holiday season so dress with flair! We love to see the festive apparel you wear!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA – Google Maps
Parking: Parking in the local lots is usually $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free but limited.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start

name: Jingle Jog
description: High Desert Runners is thrilled to organize the Jingle Jog 5K on December 20th, 2025, starting at 9:00 am at Marie Kerr Park in Palmdale. Participants can register online through the High Desert Runners website or on-site on the day of the event. The 5K run will guide participants through scenic routes within the park, providing an enjoyable experience for all. Every participant will be given a Jingle Jog 5K event t-shirt, and the first 100 finishers will receive a special commemorative mug. To ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience, participants are encouraged to arrive early for check-in and warm-up activities. Individuals can contact High Desert Runners through their official website or Facebook page for more information or inquiries. Lace-up your running shoes and join us for the festive and invigorating Jingle Jog 5K!

name: Jingle Paws 5K
description:
Jingle Paws 5K is a dog-loving fun run/walk benefitting the Guide Dogs of the Desert. Each participant receives a Santa suit that can be worn during the event and is then yours to keep! All participants run, walk or stroll the 5K (3.1 mile) route. Strollers and doggies are welcome! There will also be an Elf Dash for children 10 and under. Follow a fast and relatively flat course beginning at Temple Isaiah (332 W. Alejo in Palm Springs) along a quiet and scenic route through local neighborhoods.

 

Friday, December 12

  • 10am-2pm: packet pick-up and late registration at event site

Saturday, December 13

  • 7:30am: packet pick-up and late registration
  • 9am: 5K start time
  • 10am: Elf Dash start time

 

WHO: Everyone is welcome! Runners, walkers, strollers, doggies - come one - come all for a great morning filled with holiday cheer and lots of Ho! Ho! Ho's! and jingle bells!

 

WHY: Get into the Christmas Spirit and help support the Guide Dogs of the Desert, a 501c3 charity that provides guide dogs at no cost for the blind and sight impaired as well as assistance dogs for those with seizures, Autism, or PTSD.

 

REGISTRATION: Early registration for the 5K is $45. Registration at packet pick-up and event day is $50. The Elf Dash is $10. For your convenience, packet pick-up will be held on Friday, December 12 from 10am-2pm at Temple Isaiah (332 W. Alejo Rd., Palm Springs, CA 92262). Packet pick up and race day registration will also be available on event morning at Temple Isaiah beginning at 7:30am. Plenty of free parking is available!

name: July 4th Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Run Free. Run Proud.
Celebrate America’s independence with the July 4th Freedom Run — where every stride honors liberty, courage, and the spirit of freedom.
Whether you walk, jog, or race your heart out, come together to move for what unites us all.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Juneteenth Freedom Run/Walk
description:
The Juneteenth Freedom 5K/5 Mile Run is an event that goes beyond just a race. Juneteenth commemorates the day when 250,000 slaves in Texas, which became the last bastion for slavery during the final days of the Civil War, were declared free.

All participants in the live and virtual race will receive a tech shirt and medal. The live 5K/5 Mile race will have placement awards.

NEW THIS YEAR: Kids' age group awards and cash prizes for breaking the course record for the 5K and 5 mile races.

The 5 Mile race is a 20-point race in the Central Valley Runner of the Year series.

name: Kendra's Race
description:
In 2006, after the death of their teammate and friend, Kendra Payne, the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) Triathlon Team changed the name of their annual triathlon to Kendra’s Race. The race has been held every year since then and each year the UCSB triathlon team generously donates a portion of the entrance fees to the Kendra Chiota Payne Memorial Fund.

The 2025 Kendra's Race consists a Collegiate Sprint race, Age Group Sprint, 5k Run and Triathlon Relay.

About the course:

The swim will start at Campus Point. Athletes will swim out 200m, take a left, swim for another 400m, take another left, and swim 200m back in. They will head up a flight of wooden steps to the transition area.

Kendra's Race will feature a two loop, 12.7 mile, fast and flat bike course around the Santa Barbara Airport.  Racers will make their way out of transition and head west through the UCSB campus via the bike path, most of which has been recently repaved.  After making their way all the way around the Santa Barbara Airport, cyclists will pass through Goleta Beach and head back onto the bike path towards UCSB.  After completing two loops, racers will then head back into transition.

The run course consists of a 1 loop run over a rolling 5k course. It follows the UCSB lagoon and consists of paved and hard-packed trails. Racers will leave transition and run down to the lagoon. They will run on the trail system on the bluffs before dropping down to the lagoon where they will pass an aid station. Runners will continue along the lagoon to the turn around point. After turning around, runners will follow nearly the same route back before sprinting to the finish in lot 6.

name: Kerman Almond Festival Scholarship Fun Run/Walk
description:
The event kicks off with a 5K Run/Walk at 9 am, funds raised go towards an Agriculture Scholarship. All family members are invited to join the fun! Following the Run/Walk, the Festival will begin at 11:00 am. Enjoy live entertainment, a variety of food vendors, an Almond Baking contest, Kids zone with bounce houses, an Agricultural-Related Photo Competition, Wine Tasting, Arts & Crafts, Car Show and much more!

The Kerman Almond Festival Fun Run/Walk is a family event with a Kids run for 12 and under and a 5K Walk or Run for participants 13 and older.

name: Kids Survival Skills: Fire Crafting and Safety
description:
Understanding fire safety and the science of fire helps kids stay safe and make smart choices in emergencies. This month, junior survivalists will learn how to start a fire through various methods, build awareness about the science of fire, and fuel their curiosity to spark brighter, safer, futures!

All junior survivalists must practice listening and paying attention to rules and guidance, as class focus is on fire. 8+ only due to fire.

name: Kings County Turkey Trot
description:
Welcome to the 2025 Thanksgiving Day, Kings County Turkey Trot!

NEW THIS YEAR: START/FINISH LOCATION, 3K FUN WALK, AND KIDS RACES!!

**KIDS THAT RUN IN THE "KIDS RACE" CAN ALSO WALK THE 3K, OR RUN/WALK THE 5K WITH FAMILY**

What:  The Turkey Trot is back (organized by Champions Recovery Alternative Services), and we can’t wait to see you! Come join the fun on Thanksgiving morning in beautiful downtown Hanford.  

When:  Thursday, November 27, 2025 at 8 AM. (Kids Races will start at 7:30am) - Rain or Shine.   

Where:  Our New Start/Finish Line, 325 N Douty Street (Between Superior Dairy & Civic Center Park), in Hanford.  Same 5K Route, just a BIGGER Race Finish Line Venue to Cheer, Support, Meet Up, and Hang Out with your family and friends!

This course is scenic, and will take you around downtown; before the 5K splits and does an out-an-back on Douty Street, and the 3K Walkers return to the Finish Line!

Medals:  Medals will be awarded to our Top 20 Male & Top 20 Female 5K Finishers, must be registered in the 5K chip timed race!

Kids Races: 1/4 Mile Fun Race, and 1/2 Mile Fun Race. 

Biggest Flock Award: Create your team/group, have your family & friends (maybe your entire work) join it....Win the BIGGEST FLOCK AWARD! Tie-Breaker - Best Dressed!  

Packet Pick-Up:  
Tuesday, November 25th & Wednesday, November 26th from 9 AM to 6 PM, at 311 N Douty Street (Champions Corporate Office). 

On Thanksgiving Morning, we will open at 6:30 AM. To avoid long lines and a late start the day of the race, please pick up your packet early!  

Race Benefits: Champions Recovery Alternative Programs, Inc., a local community-based organization dedicated to nurturing a healthier Kings County.

name: La Jolla Cove Swim
description:
Iconic Open Water Swim held in La Jolla, California the first Sunday after Labor almost every year since 1916. 

There are four swim events available on race day. 

  • 250 Meter kids race "Garibaldi Grommets"
  • 1 Mile "Sea Lions"
  • 3 Mile "Leopard Sharks"
  • 4 Mile "Whole Enchilada" Swimmers compete in both the 1 mile & 3 mile events  - there is about an hour between the 2 swims.

All swimmers receive an event t-shirt. All finishers receive a finisher's medal. There are Age Group Medals awarded that follow U.S. Masters Swimming age brackets. For the kids race it is by individual year. 8 year olds will only be competing with 8 years etc up through 12 years of age.

name: La Jolla Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The La Jolla Half Marathon is one of America's most picturesque and beautiful point-to-point races. Starting at the Del Mar Fairgrounds, the course follows a scenic coastal route before reaching the challenging climb to the summit of Torrey Pines State Park. The course then rolls atop Torrey Pines mesa, continues down through residential La Jolla Shores, and finishes at La Jolla Cove.

For those interested in a shorter option, the La Jolla Shores 5K offers a mostly downhill course and features some of the most scenic views of the last 3.1 miles of the half marathon course.

name: Laguna Hills Memorial Day Half Marathon, 5K & 10K
description:
Join us on Memorial Day to celebrate all of the great Americans and their families and supporters who have earned the right to be honored and cherished on Memorial Day each year.  The event will have three timed-races on May 26, 2025. The Half Marathon is on a picturesque and challenging course that showcases the beauty of Laguna Hills and the surrounding cities.   The 5k and 10k runs will tour the streets of Laguna Hills, and offers a distance and challenge for runners of all ages and abilities.  Children can be a part of the event by registering for the Kids Run.

*** ALL RACES START AT 7 AM ***

name: Lake Hodges Trail Duathlon
description:
THE LAKE HODGES TRAIL DUATHLON RUN | BIKE | RUN

TRAIL DUATHLON Run | Bike | Run is our one of a kind experience during our annual Lake Hodges Trail Fest. Challenge yourself and compete as and INDIVIDUAL or bring friends along for the challenge and compete as a TEAM.

We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel for your event. There will be no cups at aid stations.

name: Lake Hodges Trail Festival
description:
THE LAKE HODGES TRAIL RUNS & TRAIL DUATHLON- RUN | BIKE | RUN

is an annual trail running experience you don't want to miss. We offer something for the whole family to enjoy. Choose from the Lake Hodges 50K, 15K, 10k, 5k, and bring the kids for the the 1 Mile Kid's Fun Run!

 50K is a great introduction into ultra marathons, ideal for all running levels.

NEW! 25K is a great day on the trails, ideal for all running levels.

 15K is a beautiful courses for exploring new trails and accomplishing race goals.

 10K course challenges the runner with a 1,000ft gain but with a beautiful reward of the view from the summit of Bernardo Mountain Peak.

 5K is an old favorite with a new twist, exploring the lakes shore. Great for a quick run or walk.

 Stroller Trail 5K a new way to run on the trails with your little one.

The Kid’s 1 Mile Fun Run is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s medal and other treats.

 Trail Duathlon- Run | Bike | Run is our one of a kind experience to a weekend of racing. Challenge yourself and compete as and INDIVIDUAL or bring friends along for the challenge and compete as a TEAM.

We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

name: Lake Sonoma 100K, 50K, TS Half Marathon
description:
Join us in Healdsburg, California, on April 11th 2026 for the TERREX Lake Sonoma 100K, 50K, and Trail Sisters Half Marathon! We are excited to have adidas TERREX back as our presenting partner!

We are stoked to team up with Mountain Outpost to bring you full livestream coverage, athlete panels, interviews, and commentary from special guests!

Lake Sonoma 100K

The 100K course will start with a climb up Pritchett Peak with a water only stop at the top. Once you reach the summit you’ll head back down toward the Lake Sonoma Visitors Center and then up to the hill to South Lake Trailhead where you’ll embark on an out and back of the original old school LS course and then back down the hill to the finish. It’s the same great Lake Sonoma Relentless experience, only this time with a big climb to kick it all off!

Lake Sonoma 50K

It’s not worth it unless you have to work for it! The 50k start is located in the green space next to the Lake Sonoma Visitor Center (you can’t miss it). After a short road section to get the field spread out  the course then continues onto beautiful rolling single track trails. You will continue past South Lake, Island View, Warm Springs Creek, Wulfow, Liberty Glen and the Bummer aid stations, finally crossing the scenic lake bridge. Remember to save some juice for the last few miles, as you have a screaming downhill towards the finish. The race starts at 7:30am.

Don’t forget to enjoy the views! … and be sure to take a dip in the water to cool off. (but don’t drink!)

Trail Sisters Women's Half Marathon

The Trail Sisters (TS) Half Marathon is a women’s only event. It was created to foster encouragement and camaraderie amongst all abilities and experience levels. This out and back course starts with steep trail ascent to South Lake Trailhead, but also provides a speedy descent to the finish. True to its label, you can expect relentless rolling hills that will challenge your mind and body. Lucky for you though, you will share the journey with a community of supportive Trail Sisters to help you through! You will have 4 and half hours to complete the half marathon course.

Come Celebrate!

Lake Sonoma isn’t just a race event, it’s a celebration. We always complete the weekend with a Celebration and Thank You event at Coyote Sonoma in Healdsburg, CA. Everyone involved with the event is invited to enjoy wine, charcuterie, and share stories from the weekend.

See you on that start line!
Gina & Justin
LS Race Directors

name: Lakewood Run
description:
Join us for the exhilarating Lakewood Run “Powered By Heart, Fueled By Community” 5K Walk/Run, 5K Ruck, and 10K Run! The Lakewood Run returns on Saturday, March 7, 2026!  This event is a celebration of physical fitness, community spirit, and personal determination. Whether you are a seasoned runner, a passionate walker, or a dedicated rucker, there’s something for everyone in this inclusive event. 

There will be delicious food, refreshments, live music, and race results, including a medal ceremony. Also, stick around and visit all our amazing vendors for a chance to participate in an opportunity drawing with great prizes! The Lakewood Run brings together runners, walkers, ruckers, and neighbors for a morning that’s more than just miles—it’s about heart.

 The Lakewood Run is presented by the Lakewood Sheriff’s Station and Soroptimist Int’l of Lakewood/Long Beach. Proceeds from the race benefit both charity organizations.

name: LAP: ATV and Desert Camping Trip to Anza Borrego State Park
description:
UPDATED Liberty Adventure Program: Sunday, November 9-Monday, November 10

Ocotillo ATV & Palm Canyon Campground (about a 2-hour drive from Coronado)

Listen to nearby coyotes while sleeping under the stars. Anza Borrego desert state park is the perfect place to ride ATV’s and explore one of southern California’s best kept secrets. This trip includes basic meals, camping gear, ATV excursion, transportation, and guided hike.

DAY 1:  will depart for ATV tours in Ocotillo, CA at 0800 AM from NAB Liberty and 0830 AM from NASNI Liberty Centers. arrive at Ocotillo, CA and start our two-hour ATV tour. Drive to campground through the Anza Borrego desert state park towards our final campground at Palm canyon. set up camp, visit the visitors center and town, bonfire, dinner, refreshments and Games 

DAY 2: Guided hike through the palm canyon trail, experience photo ops sightseeing, sand sledding, before leaving the area, drive through Julian for apple pie and then back to San Diego. 

 

Packing list will be provided before departure date. please pack in layers to stay warm! as this time of year can be freezing at night. 

 

Camping equipment, food, experience, and transportation provided.  

***Open to JUNIOR ENLISTED E1-E6 ACTIVE DUTY

name: LASAA Mug Run - Altadena Forever Run
description:
LASAA’s mission is to organize athletic events for our members, which include Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department employees and law enforcement officers. We aim to promote health, fitness, and camaraderie among our members.

The Mug Run series began in 1993. Initially, it was primarily attended by law enforcement personnel, with an average of 10 runners each time. Over the years, we’ve expanded our participation to include the general public. Today, we have over 300 runners participating in the Mug Run. This race offers friendly competition and positive interactions between law enforcement and the community. 

This race is commemorating the one-year anniversary of the Altadena Eaton Fire.  One year after the Eaton Fire blackened the ridges above our town, this inaugural run stands as a powerful symbol of recovery.  It's a tribute, to those who lost, those who helped, and those who are rebuilding.  the Inaugural Altadena Forever Run, commemorating the one-year anniversary of the Altadena Eaton Fire, honoring our community's resilience and recovery.  

This event welcomes everyone. Your participation, sponsorship, and presence show solidarity and hope. Proceeds from the Altadena Forever Run support Eaton Fire survivors, helping families restore what was lost and strengthen what endures. The race also helps support the Altadena Sheriff’s Support Group.

name: LASD Turkey Trot 5K
description:
Join Us for the Exciting Turkey Trot 5K at Bonelli Park!

Get ready to kick off the holiday season with a bang at the annual Turkey Trot 5K on Saturday, November 15, 2025! Nestled in the beautiful Bonelli Park, this is more than just a run—it's a celebration of community, fitness, and fun!

Why You Should Join Us:

Stunning Location: Experience the breathtaking views of Bonelli Park as you trot through nature’s beauty.


Free for LASAA Members: If you're a member of LASAA, registration is on us! Non-LASAA members and the public can join the fun for just $30.


Day-of Registration: Forgot to register? No problem! Sign up on the day for $10 (LASAA) or $40 (non-members).


Swag Galore: Every participant walks away with a stylish T-shirt and a dazzling finisher medal, so you can show off your accomplishment!


Exciting Raffle Prizes: Enter for a chance to win incredible prizes, including a brand-new e-bike! You won't want to miss out on this!


This event is perfect for families, friends, and anyone looking to embrace the spirit of gratitude while getting active. Gather your crew, challenge yourself, and celebrate together as we trot toward a healthier lifestyle!

Don't wait—mark your calendars, lace up those sneakers, and join us for a memorable day of fun and fitness! Let’s make this Turkey Trot an unforgettable experience! 🦃🏃‍♂️✨

name: Last Dash Before Midnight 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
Start your New Year’s Eve off with purpose, positivity, and a little sweat. Let’s dash into the new year together!
 

Last Dash Before Midnight – Long Beach Edition

🎉 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
📍 Long Beach, CA
📅 Date: December 31st

End 2024 on a high note with one final run before the clock strikes midnight! The Last Dash Before Midnight is your chance to lace up, take in the stunning Long Beach coastline, and finish the year strong. Whether you're chasing a PR or just embracing the celebratory vibes, this race is the perfect way to reflect on the past year and stride into 2025 with momentum.

Event Highlights
🌊 Scenic Course: Run along the picturesque Long Beach shoreline with refreshing ocean breezes and beautiful sunrise views.


🎶 Festive Atmosphere: Soak in the energy of a fun-filled morning with music, good vibes, and a supportive running community.


🏅 Commemorative Medal: Finish strong and collect a unique medal marking your final race of the year.
📸 Photo Ops: Capture your last run of 2024 with themed backdrops and stunning coastal scenery.

 

Why Join Us?
There’s no better way to wrap up the year than with an uplifting race, surrounded by like-minded runners ready to welcome 2025 on a strong note. Reflect on your accomplishments, set the tone for the year ahead, and make unforgettable memories with an epic morning run!

Registration Includes
✅  Race on a scenic course

name: Leprechaun Chase – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Let's celebrate St. Patricks Day

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4:00-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens 
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

name: Lights for Life 5K
description:
The team at Project 99 invites you to join us for the Lights for Life 5K, our signature mental health and suicide awareness campaign. This year’s event continues our mission to shine a light on suicide prevention and bring the conversation "out of the dark." Your participation helps us spread hope, raise awareness, and ensure that no one feels alone in their struggles.
By running, walking, or supporting this 5K, you are directly contributing to our efforts to educate local students and the broader community about mental health and suicide prevention. Project 99 Play for Life, Inc., is so grateful for the generous support that allows us to make an impact today and grow our mission for the future. All additional donations are tax-deductible and will help us expand our educational outreach, keeping students engaged and encouraging them to "stay in the game" and play for life.
In addition to participating in the race, we encourage youth to get involved behind the scenes, with opportunities to volunteer in event planning, preparation, and execution. Together, we can continue to build a community where mental health is prioritized, and no one is left in the dark.
Let's bring hope, awareness, and prevention into the light.

name: Lookin' for a Cure Palo Alto
description:
Description

Join Us in the Pursuit of a Cure at the Lookin' For A Cure Palo Alto 5K!


Every year, Lookin' For A Cure 5k events light up cities across the United States. These events are not just about running, they are about igniting awareness, and unity in the fight against Ocular Melanoma. By participating, you're not only support groundbreaking research but also bringing together individuals affected by Ocular Melanoma.We are Lookin' For a Cure" in Palo Alto. Join A Cure in Sight on Saturday July 12th, 7AM-11AM at: 2452 Watson Ct. Palo Alto, CA US 94020. Help raise awareness and support the fight against Ocular Melanoma, the most common eye cancer in adults in the United States.  

A Partnership for Progress


A Cure In Sight collaborates with leading research facilities and dedicated physicians that specialize in Ocular Melanoma treatment. Together, we channel the net proceeds from these events into ongoing research projects and patient support programs. Your involvement directly contributes to advancing the quest for a cure. Walk shoulder-to-shoulder with Ocular Melanoma survivors, their families, and the medical professionals who care for them at the Byers Eye Institute at Stanford University School of Medicine. 

All ages are welcome to attend. Come run, walk, or stay in one place and play games at the Third Annual Lookin' for a Cure 5K at Stanford, hosted by A Cure in Sight and the Byers Eye Institute at Stanford.  Set up your team, invite your friends and family, start your fundraiser and you are off to the finish line. Proceeds from this event will support the Stanford Ocular Oncology Program. Stanford is a national leader in providing state-of-the-art care for ocular melanoma patients of all ages and has pioneered groundbreaking research advances. Prithvi Mruthyunjaya, MD, MHS, professor of ophthalmology who anchors the ocular tumor service at Stanford is also working hard at Stanford to bring this event to fruition.

The race also aims to spread the word about the importance of early detection by getting regular dilated eye exams. Ocular melanoma makes up approximately 5 percent of melanomas in the United States. It is estimated that between 6-8 people per million will be diagnosed annually in the Western world. 

Read more about the work Stanford is doing around ocular melanoma here.

Event Details

Packet pick up will be held at Road Runner Sports San Carlos located at: 1125 Industrial Rd, San Carlos, CA 94070 on Friday, July 11th, 2025 from 4PM to 7PM. Come by and grab your race swag and pick up those last minute items that you need to be race ready. 

Race Swag

  • Guaranteed T-shirt, If Registered by July 10th.
  • Finisher Medal
  • Food & Drink
  • Course Aid Station
  • Commemorative Race Bib
  • Free Downloadable Photos
  • Official Finishers Time With Age Group Placements

Race day schedule

  • Registration 7 AM
  • Race start 8 AM
  • Announcements Awards 9:30 am

Free parking is available in the Byers Eye Institute parking lot on the corner of Embarcadero Rd. and Bayshore Rd.

name: Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay | 5K & Kid Run
description:
Get ready for an unforgettable evening of trail running at the Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay & 5K! This race brings together adventure, teamwork, and breathtaking views in one epic event. As the sun sets over the city, you'll traverse scenic trails, soak in stunning skyline views, and take on a thrilling course through the heart of Griffith Park.

🏃 10 Mile Relay – Teams of 4! Gather your crew, with each runner completing the same scenic loop before passing the baton. It's the perfect mix of teamwork, strategy, and fun!

 

🏃 5K Solo Race! A thoughtfully designed route that balances challenge and enjoyment — perfect for experienced trail runners and those new to the sport.

 

Whether you're racing with a team of four or taking on the 5K solo, this event is the perfect way to push your limits, connect with fellow runners, and embrace the magic of trail running under the evening sky. With well-stocked aid stations, an enthusiastic volunteer crew, and an electrifying atmosphere, you'll have everything you need to make this race one to remember.

So grab your teammates, lace up your trail shoes, and join us for an incredible night of running, camaraderie, and unforgettable moments! Register now and experience the Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay & 5K like never before!

description:

Awards

WHAT IS A VIRTUAL RACE REGISTRATION? A virtual race is a race that can be run (or walked) from any location you choose. You can run, jog, or walk on the road, on the trail, on the treadmill, at the gym or on the track (or even at another race). You get to run your own race, at your own pace, and time it yourself. Run on your own, or with friends! Your race bib, shirt and medal will be shipped directly to you. And your registration fee and fundraising efforts will go directly to help support victims of crime through our survivors hope fund. Register Today!

Event Fee

$40.00 Pre Registration | $50.00 Day of Registration -- Includes Shirt, Medal, Goody Bag to First 500 Pre Registered, Food ,Drinks, and Entertainment

name: Love Yourself Run – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
In this season of showing off your love to others, make sure you show yourself a little love as well! Our Love Yourself Run is a reminder to do just that!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support:
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: LSA's Run Home 2026
description:
This is a fundraiser for Life Services Alternatives which provides homes and services for the I/DD community in the Bay Area.

 

Please register to race and donate, or just donate!

 

Life Services Alternatives Run Home

Life Services Alternatives celebrates 22 years after opening their first home with a Live Race Event

  • Race Distances -- 5K, 10K

  • Virtual Run Distances - 5k, 10k - for those who are unable to join on race day.

 

Register early before price goes up and to secure your T-shirt (Shirt sizes subject to availability).  Take advantage of $5 early bird special discount until June 3rd. 

 

Register for LSA's Run Home Here!

Life Services Alternatives, Inc sponsors this race and is the beneficiary. All participants are encouraged to donate and or raise funds for the Life Services Alternatives cause. If you are not a runner or are unable to run you are still available to donate to Life Services Alternatives!

 

About Life Services Alternatives

Life Services Alternatives provides exceptional community living and programs for adults with developmental disabilities. 
 
In our county, there is a housing shortage for adults with development disabilities. In the past 4 years, over 40 programs have closed due staffing issues, low government rates and the high cost of living in the Silicon Valley. A high percentage of adults with developmental disabilities live at home with their parents. Unfortunately, parents age, have health issues, or they can no longer care for their adult child. Parents worry about who will take care of their adult child when they no longer can.
 
Life Services Alternatives helps to alleviate those worries. We opened our first three homes in 2004 in Santa Clara. It was a goal of Life Services Alternatives to establish homes where residents could grow and thrive in a non-institutional setting.  We currently have 15 licensed homes throughout Santa Clara County (San Jose, Campbell, Santa Clara and Morgan Hill) that are home to men and women who are developmentally disabled. Our residents’ range in age from 20 to 80 years old with a wide range of disabilities. 16th home is in the process of renovation and retrofitting to meet the community home standards. Five of our fifteen homes are for individuals who have special health care needs and intensive support needs. Our remaining nine homes, are home to residents who need 24-hour a day, non-medical care and supervision. It is Life Services Alternatives goal to continue to open new homes in our county where residents can live their best possible lives. Your support is needed to reach our goal. Your donation is greatly appreciated and will help change the lives of a developmentally disabled adult.

Life Services Alternatives, Inc sponsors this race and is the beneficiary. All participants are encouraged to donate and or raise funds for the Life Services Alternatives cause. If you are not a runner or are unable to run you are still available to donate to Life Services Alternatives!

 

About Life Services Alternatives

Life Services Alternatives provides exceptional community living and programs for adults with developmental disabilities. 
 
In our county, there is a housing shortage for adults with development disabilities. In the past 4 years, over 40 programs have closed due staffing issues, low government rates and the high cost of living in the Silicon Valley. A high percentage of adults with developmental disabilities live at home with their parents. Unfortunately, parents age, have health issues, or they can no longer care for their adult child. Parents worry about who will take care of their adult child when they no longer can.
 
Life Services Alternatives helps to alleviate those worries. We opened our first three homes in 2004 in Santa Clara. It was a goal of Life Services Alternatives to establish homes where residents could grow and thrive in a non-institutional setting.  We currently have 15 licensed homes throughout Santa Clara County (San Jose, Campbell, Santa Clara and Morgan Hill) that are home to men and women who are developmentally disabled. Our residents’ range in age from 20 to 80 years old with a wide range of disabilities. 16th home is in the process of renovation and retrofitting to meet the community home standards. Five of our fifteen homes are for individuals who have special health care needs and intensive support needs. Our remaining nine homes, are home to residents who need 24-hour a day, non-medical care and supervision. It is Life Services Alternatives goal to continue to open new homes in our county where residents can live their best possible lives. Your support is needed to reach our goal. Your donation is greatly appreciated and will help change the lives of a developmentally disabled adult.

name: Lunar New Year Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🏇🐎 Gallop Into the New Year! 🐎🏇
✨ Step into the Year of the Horse with purpose, energy, and community spirit! ✨
Celebrate culture, fitness, and fresh starts with the Lunar New Year’s Run, which is your chance to embrace the bold spirit of the horse - symbolizing energy, freedom, and forward momentum.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Mammoth Bar Trail Runs
description:
"Standard distance. Mammoth vert."

Mammoth Bar Trail Runs take place on the single-track and double-track trails of Mammoth Bar OHV Area in Auburn State Recreation Area, in the Endurance Capital of Auburn, California.

Mammoth Bar is known for its steep climbs and descents, as well as it's beautiful American River Canyon views.

These are not your average courses. You get more vert per dollar! Yay!

Mammoth Bar is a new event put on by Skybreaker Racing's Race Director under the Singletrack Running umbrella.

name: MaraFUNrun 5K
description:
Runnin’ for Rhett hosts the MaraFUNrun in Land Park this year!

3,000 youth athletes from the Sacramento area take part in a 5K race celebrating the completion of six weeks of participation in our after-school Youth Fitness Program. You can support our local youth by joining us! Register to run, walk, or jog with the kids in our community 5K, volunteer your time, come out to cheer, or make a donation to help keep our Youth Fitness Program free for these youth athletes. It’s also the perfect shake-out before the big Marathon on Sunday.

name: Martha's Village & Kitchen 19th Annual Thanksgiving Day 5K
description:
Martha's Village & Kitchen Thanksgiving Day 5k is an annual, family-friendly, run/walk fundraiser in Palm Desert, CA. The goal of the 5K is to raise awareness about Martha’s Village & Kitchen’s services and to provide funds to support our mission to end hunger and homelessness in the Coachella Valley. Over 5,000 people attend the event including participants, spectators, and volunteers.

  1. Register yourself as an individual, start a team or join an existing team.
  2. Pick up your essential race gear on the packet pick-up days to be determined.
  3. Watch the KESQ News Channel 3 news team, feature stories about Martha's Village.  Segments will be recorded and available for viewing throughout the weekend.
  4. Gather family, friends or create your own team and get ready to run or walk!  
  5. Visit our sponsorship page on our website to learn more about the businesses that are supporting our community.
  6. Lastly, don’t forget to post pics and tag @MarthasVilllage or hashtag #MVK5K on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter and show your spirit!

name: Mash + Dash – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Still full? Perfect. Mash & Dash is here to help you run off that mountain of mashed potatoes with a morning of coastal miles and post-feast fun. It’s the perfect way to keep the holiday vibes rolling while giving those leftovers a little competition. Whether you’re out to burn off pie slices or just want an easy cruise by the water, this run is all about laughter, movement, and shaking off that Thanksgiving food coma.

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
1:00-4:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon and 10-miler start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged in advance for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More About the Course

This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

It’s the perfect way to keep the holiday vibes rolling while giving those leftovers a little competition. Whether you’re out to burn off pie slices or just want an easy cruise by the water, this run is all about laughter, movement, and shaking off that Thanksgiving food coma.

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
1:00-4:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon and 10-miler start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged in advance for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More About the Course

This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Memorial Day 5K, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Run/Walk
description:
This favorite Memorial Day running event takes place near the beautiful Diamond Valley Lake in Hemet, CA. This flat, out, and back course is perfect for your next PR or for those just starting their journey. Runners and walkers of all experience levels are invited to come out and enjoy the Memorial Day festivities! With a 5K Run/Walk (3.1 miles),10K Run/Walk (6.2 miles), and our iconic Kid’s Run (1 Mile), there is something for everyone!

Why Run The Memorial Day 5K, 5 Mile, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Run?

  • Flat & Fast Course in Hemet, CA 
  • Awesome and well-designed race bibs, shirts & medals
  • 10 minutes from Southern California Wineries
  • Lots of excitement in Old Town and Temecula’s Premier Mall
  • Locally owned & locally produced – Memorial Day 5K, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Race is a homegrown race!

Included in your registration:

  • Technical fabric, men’s and women’s race shirts
  • Custom finisher’s medal
  • Chip Timing
  • Support stations 
  • Post-race refreshments
  • Finish line expo

 

Race Start Times:

10K: 7:30 AM

5K: 7:45 AM 

Kids 1 Mile: 9:00 AM

name: Memorial Day Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Honor, Remember, and Run for Freedom This Memorial Day, join us for the Memorial Day Freedom Run - a special event that combines a run with the powerful spirit of remembrance.  Whether you're running solo or with friends and family, this event honors the brave men and women who have sacrificed for our freedom.
Every mile you complete is a tribute to their courage and service.  With scenic routes, motivating challenges, and a community united in purpose, the Memorial Day Freedom Run is more than just a race - it's a meaningful way to pay respect while staying active. 
Sign up today to celebrate freedom, remember our heroes, and run for a cause that matters.  Together, we can make this Memorial Day unforgettable.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Merced River Canyon Run
description:
Mariposa county's classic Merced River Canyon Race returns this year with two options for runners.  

McCabe Flat Flat out. This 5 mile race is from the Briceburg bridge to McCabe Flat campground and back (2.5 each way).  As the name suggests this race is about as flat as a race in the foothills can be. This race can be done at any pace but some will choose to try and set a record on the flattest footrace in the county. 

Burma Grade. This 9 mile race starts at the river level and climbs up the mighty Burma Grade (4.5 each way). This race offers the most elevation of any foot race in the county and leaves the racers with an amazing sense of accomplishment.  

Both races are on hardpacked unpaved roads and offer amazing scenery in the Merced River Canyon.

Note on location and directions, please take highway 140 to get to Briceburg. While there are other ways to get here, they are not recommend, especially not on race day.

name: Merry Miles- Naughty or Nice Run  5K, 10K,  and Half Marathon
description:
🎅 Merry Miles: Naughty or Nice Christmas Run
📅 Sunday, December 14, 2025
📍 Alamitos Beach – 780 E Shoreline Dr, Long Beach, CA 90802

 
🎄 Run for a Cause, Give from the Heart — This Time for Our Furry Friends!


Are you on the Naughty List or the Nice List this year? 😇😈
Either way, grab your Santa hats, elf ears, or that questionable holiday sweater and come jingle those miles at the Merry Miles: Naughty or Nice Run!

This festive coastal run is all about holiday spirit, good vibes, and giving back — plus, we’re collecting donations for the Long Beach Animal Shelter to help local pets in need. 🐾
Bring a toy, treat, blanket, or bag of food from their wish list (posted at check-in) and help spread pawsitive cheer to our four-legged friends waiting for their forever homes.

 
🏃‍♀️ Event Highlights
✨ Professional  chip timing on a flat, fast course
📸 Elfie Stations & finish-line photo ops galore
🏅  Naughty or Nice finisher medals — which one will you earn?
🎅 Costumes encouraged! Dress festive, funny, or fabulously extra 

🎅 Costume Contest with Prizes
🍪 Holiday treats & hot cocoa at the finish-line festival
🎶 DJ Claus spinning holiday remixes all morning
🐕 Pet donation display + “Wall of Giving” photo backdrop
🌊 Stunning Queen Mary views along the shoreline

 
🕒 Schedule of Events
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 8:00 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
🏆 Awards: 9:30 AM

All finishers receive a custom medal, free race-day photos, and yummy holiday snacks — whether you’ve been naughty, nice, or somewhere in between.

 
💝 Why We Run
Because giving back feels even better than crossing the finish line.
Your donations to the Long Beach Animal Shelter help keep rescue pets warm, fed, and full of holiday hope. Every mile = a tail wag of gratitude. 🐾

 
💬 Why CaliFlow Runs
CaliFlow Runs creates inclusive, affordable, and high-vibe races that bring runners and walkers of all paces together. We keep it low-key, coastal, and full of good energy — because fitness and fun should always go hand in hand.

 
🚗 Parking
Free street parking available.
Beach lot parking is $2/hour starting at 8 AM (use Passport app or pay stations).

 
📸 Finish-Line Fun
Between the Naughty & Nice Finish Arch, Santa’s Candy Cane Wall, and Elfie Stations, you’ll need your camera ready — or just keep smiling, our photographers have you covered!

 
🐾 Pet Drive Details
Donation items for the Long Beach Animal Shelter:

Dog & cat food (dry or canned)
Treats, blankets, towels
Toys, leashes, cleaning supplies


All donations will be collected at check-in and displayed at the Wall of Giving to celebrate our community’s generosity and big holiday hearts. ❤️
