name: Midway Shelter Winter Run / Walk ~ 5k, 10k and Kids Run
description:
General Info - December 6th, 2025


Packet Pick up and Race Schedule:

  • December 3rd thru 5th, 2025: 10:00am - 5:00pm Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St / Alameda, Ca. 94501
  • December 6th: 
    • 7:30am ~ raceday registration opens
      8:30am ~ 10k starts
      8:45am ~ 5k starts
      9:45am ~ kids 1/2 mile run starts
      10:00am ~ 5k and 10k awards
       

Event Details: 


Join us for the annual Midway Shelter winter run. Event takes place at the Harbor Bay Ferry Terminal in Alameda on Bay Farm Island and supports a great cause. 


The run will take you along the beautiful shoreline of Bay Farm Island and is a flat out and back with views of San Francisco and the Alameda Main Island. This year we plan to utilize the streets of Harbor Bay Parkway to account for the increase in race attendance. 


The Kids run for 12 and under will be a 1/2 mile course. Kids run will start at 9:45am and will follow a circular loop out and back on the shoreline trail. There is plenty of parking at the Ferry terminal and we will have snacks and drinks when the race is over. 

Midway Shelter provides emergency shelter to homeless women and children and is operated through a partnership with Alameda Homeless Network and Building Futures – learn more about our work by checking out our two websites, below!

Founded in 1989, Midway Shelter of Alameda provides a safe and supportive environment for women and children experiencing  homelessness. By pledging any dollar amount, in addition to your registration, you can support the Midway Shelter provide a safe place for women and their children. Your donation is tax deductible as the Alameda Homeless Network operates as a 501(c)3 Tax ID number 94-3078153)

 

http://midwayshelter.org/donate.htm
www.bfwc.org

Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/

name: Miwok 100K
description:
The Miwok 100K is one of the most beautiful and iconic trail ultramarathons in the world. The course is hilly (11,800 feet of gain) but runnable, with spectacular views of San Francisco and the Golden Gate Bridge, Sausalito, Mount Tamalpais, the ancient redwoods and the Point Reyes National Seashore.

The course features single-track trails and dirt roads with about a mile of paved road. The race is competitive at the front, and a rewarding challenge for all. Less than an hour from San Francisco, the Start/Finish is in the town of beautiful Stinson Beach, nestled against Mount Tamalpais, with its excellent cafés, a small market, lodging, and more.

Course marking is excellent, and you’ll be supported by some of the best volunteers on a race course anywhere. We hire professional medical for all aid stations for those occasional skinned knees and such. Our 2026 runners will receive a custom Miwok 100K finisher’s medal and a Miwok 100K mug.

100K Team Relay is also back for 2026

We have 3 options for you to participate in our event:

1. Miwok 100K on May 2, 2026 (When the race is full, you will be placed on a Waitlist. Your card will not be charged until you are offered a spot, and accept it. Registered runners who drop prior to February 1 will receive a $110 (40%) refund.) 

2. Miwok 100K on May 2, 2026, PLUS an 18 week training plan from coach Race Director Magda Boulet

3. Miwok 100K Team Relay on May 2, 2026 (must have 4 participants per relay)

Please make sure you sign up for the correct event!

description:

WALK-IN REGISTRATIONS ONLY STARTING ON WEDNESDAY 11/26

T-shirts will be provided and will be guaranteed to the first 500 entrants.

name: MLK Freedom Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Join in our annual Martin Luther King Jr. Day Run! Today, we gather to honor the legacy of Dr. King and his enduring commitment to justice, equality, and peace. As we lace up our shoes and hit the pavement, let’s reflect on his powerful message of love and resilience.

This event is not just about fitness; it’s a celebration of community, a call to action for social change, and a reminder of the work still to be done. Together, we can honor Dr. King’s dream and inspire one another to continue striving for a better world. Let’s run with purpose and passion!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

This event is not just about fitness; it’s a celebration of community, a call to action for social change, and a reminder of the work still to be done. Together, we can honor Dr. King’s dream and inspire one another to continue striving for a better world. Let’s run with purpose and passion!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Moorpark Groundhog Day 5k/1M
description:
Benefiting Moorpark High School’s cross country and track programs, the Groundhog Day event consists of two events. Starting at the high school, the 5k is a fast, chip timed road race with an exciting finish at the beautiful Moorpark High School stadium. All ages and abilities are welcome.  All participants age 11 and under who complete the 5k will received a finisher medal.  There will also be a “Catch the Groundhog” 1 mile fun run for kids 11 and under which will be held on the track with finisher medals for all. Registration fees include a t-shirt for all runners (shirts are only guaranteed if you register by Sunday 1/25/26).

Post-race festivities include the awards ceremony with age group medals plus refreshments, vendors, and a raffle of wonderful prizes donated by local businesses.

name: Moraga Turkey Trot-2025
description:
Please join the Moraga Chamber of Commerce on Thanksgiving morning for the annual Moraga Turkey Trot! Trot your way out to the cart path at Moraga Country Club wearing your favorite zany costume, activewear or PJs! You can push a pram, set up a run squad or saunter solo, but just be sure to bring your community spirit!

 

The morning will include “unofficial” timed 5K and 1.5m races, awards for best Thanksgiving-themed costume and speediest turkey, as well as random bib number draws to earn prizes from local businesses. Runners, walkers and lollygaggers of all ages are welcome! 

 

Advance registration is required. Unfortunately, we cannot take registrations on-site. Registrants receive a T-shirt (sizes & tees not guaranteed - see registration details), a numbered running bib and goodies, while they last! Participants will check the digital timer at START/FINISH for self-timing. Come enjoy this wholesome tradition and celebrate Thanksgiving morning together! You do not need to be a member of the Chamber or the Country Club to participate. 

 

5K - START TIME (8:10a) – Participants line up by 8am
1.5m - START TIME (8:25a) – Participants line up following the departure of 5K (8:15am)
 

--Registration day-of is *Not Available*--
Anyone on the course should be registered, bib'd and have signed the waiver.  

Parking will be limited and traffic laws enforced. Arrange for carpool, drop-offs and walking over, whenever possible. Take Care and remember to be kind to one another!

name: Morgan Hill AAUW Wildflower Run
description:
The AAUW Wildflower Run raises money for scholarships and leadership programs for women & girls and community grants. (For information about our organization, go to www.aauwmh.org.) 10K Run, 5K Run, 5K Walk, and 5K stroller/baby jogger category are all on country roads with chip timing. The Kids' 2K  Run (ages 5-11) and our new, "all inclusive, non-competitive" 2K Fun Run/Walk for everyone for ages 2-102 are both on a school track.  
Our new 5K and 10K routes are in a country setting surrounding Morgan Hill with flat terrain on paved roads. Flat and fast for runners wanting to improve their personal record times. Water available at start and finish of race, with multiple water stops along the routes. Strollers are welcome everywhere except on the school's track. No pets permitted on school grounds.
NOTE: The event is an "open course", so you will need to stay to the side of the road as some vehicular traffic is expected.
Register early to be guaranteed a unique, 2026 T-shirt in your size.  In addition to your limited edition T-shirt, we offer bonus baby-T's for the stroller event (while supplies last) and themed medals for youth. See wildflowerrun.org for details.
We offer discount pricing for groups, as follows:
  • groups of 10 or more (request a $5 off per person “coupon code” for your group in advance of registering; enter the code at checkout).
  • school teams (within boundaries of MHUSD) – if your principal has agreed to sign up your school for the "school competition", your school will have a unique school "coupon code" for $5 off any race for student/family/staff; enter the code at checkout.

name: Morgan Hill Veterans Day  Run
description: The Morgan Hill Freedom Fest is proud to host the Veterans Day 5k & 10k and 1 mile children's Run to honor the men and women who have served or are currently serving in the armed forces of the United States.  You will have the opportunity to walk and run with these honorable men and women during the race and express your appreciation for their service as you finish the course with them. We encourage participants to take a moment and say, “Thank you for what you’ve done!” Small gestures mean a lot to those who have sacrificed so much. All proceeds from the  race will go to the Veteran organizations listed on our Partners page.  We hope to see you there!

name: Mountains 2 Beach Marathon and Half
description: Uniquely situated and completely surrounded by beautiful mountains, the city of Ojai holds the start of the Mountains 2 Beach Marathon while the half starts closer to the beach. This point to point race winds through the Ventura River Valley as it makes its way to the pristine beaches of the last great surf town in California, Ventura. Runners will love the gradual downhill nature of the race, which is prime to make you faster but not hurt the knees, and the amazing weather of the area. After a final tour of beach front Ventura, runners and their families are treated to a finish line party only steps away from the surf and the shops and restaurants of Historic Downtown Ventura. As a certified Boston Qualifier, the courses, the race and the surrounding communities make for the perfect destination marathon and half.

After a final tour of beach front Ventura, runners and their families are treated to a finish line party only steps away from the surf and the shops and restaurants of Historic Downtown Ventura. As a certified Boston Qualifier, the courses, the race and the surrounding communities make for the perfect destination marathon and half.

description:
The Parkinson's and Movement Disorder Foundation (PMDF) and the National Spasmodic Torticollis Association are hosting the MOVE4U 5K Walk/Run Fundraiser at Mile Square Park in Fountain Valley, California. name: MVRRC 12th Annual Jingle Bell 5k Run & kids 1 mile race
description:
Moreno Valley Road Runners Club will be celebrating our 12th annual Jingle Bell fun run at Lake Perris State Recreation Area, Dam 17801 Lake Perris Drive, Perris, CA 92571. On December 13, 2025, at 7:30 am.

What: Don’t miss Southern California’s best Jingle Bell tradition! Run/walk a 5K before you open gifts. There will be a 1-mile kids' race (ages 12 and under). Everyone is welcome!

Where: Enjoy a historic course along the Dam, referred to as The Lake Perris Dam. You’ll pass by such a notable lake. What a great way to see the beautiful lake in the morning.

Course: The race starts and finishes at the Dam Area. This is a flat, long course with no traffic.

When: December 13, 2025, at 7:30 am. Packet pick up on race day only.

Race Start Times: The kids’ 1-mile race starts at 8:15 AM, and the 5K starts at 8:30 AM.

Awards: Top 3 boys and girls in the 1-mile race, Top 3 open Males and Females in the 5K.

Prizes: Medals will be given to all participants. The first 50 sign-ups will receive a t-shirt.

Fees: The kids' one-mile race is $5.00, the 5-K race is $20.00. All payments are the same on race day. We take cash, Venmo, the Cash app, and Zelle on race day. The entrance to the park will be $10.00.

For more information, don't hesitate to get in touch with Race Director Henry at mvrrc@hotmail.com or via text at 951-396-5896

MVRRC would like all participants to donate any open gifts for the children in need for Christmas. Thank you.

Instructions on how to get to the Jingle Bell Race at Lake Perris, from the Perris side, after you pass security, you want to make a right on Alta Calle, the first entrance before lot number one. From the Moreno Valley side, you want to drive till you pass Lot Number One. Once you pass the lot, you want to make a left on Alta Calle before the exit on the Perris side.

name: Nail the Rail Half Marathon, 10K & 5K
description:
Join us for a stroll along the Sacramento Rail Trail.  A converted Southern Pacific Railroad track that starts at the base of Shasta Dam and runs for over 11 miles.

Enjoy a the view along the Sacramento River/Keswick Lake in the cool of the morning.  Trail is very flat and fast.

Field is limited to 350.

Races include a half marathon, 10K and 5K.

Finisher awards to Half marathoners.  Awards 3 deep in age groups, plus overall awards.

Start/Finish will be from the Chappie OHV area at the base of Shasta Dam.  Once you cross Shasta Dam you will follow the road down to the OHV area.

Race day registration and packet pickup opens at 7am at OHV area.

Packet pickup and registration on Friday the 25th from 11am to 3pm at Redding Fleet Feet Store at 1376 Hilltop Dr.

Start times:

Half Marathon - 8am

5K & 10K - 8:15am

Cutoff time of 3hrs 30 minutes for half-marathon.

name: Napa Valley Turkey Chase
description:
Welcome to the Turkey Chase, Napa's only Thanksgiving Day 5K/10K! 

The Napa Valley Turkey Chase is a fun family event! Race, jog or walk this fast, paved course around the Napa Valley College and the Napa River Trail and work up your Thanksgiving appetite!

The start & finish line are located in lot J behind the Napa Valley College track. Lot J will also be the staging area for packet pick-up, day of race registration, booths and toilets. There is NO PARKING in lot J .

PLEASE NOTE: THERE ARE COURSE CHANGES THIS YEAR!

The 10K course runs a counterclockwise loop through the college and then meets the Napa River Trail. Runners will go north to a turn around under the Imola bridge near mile 2. Then they will run south to Kennedy Park where the course makes a small counterclockwise loop near the skate park and then retraces the route back up the river trail. The 10K course then meets back up with the 5K by the baseball field and finishes back in lot J.

The 5K course runs the same counterclockwise loop through the college and then connects to the Napa River Trail. Runners will immediately proceed south past mile 2 and turn at the baseball field to head to the finish back in lot J. Both courses have been measured by wheel and GPS, but it is not a USATF certified course.

name: Nelson Family Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18, 2026 at 11:00am for a super fun annual event that features the amazing hospitality and scenery of Nelson Family Vineyards! For 70 years the Nelson family has farmed the land they live on, with the traditions of farming passed on to four generations. Through many seasons of tending and harvest, Nelson Family Vineyards has embraced the truth that great wines are born in the vineyard. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

description:

Overview:

name: New Year's Day Dash – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Start your year on the right foot with the New Year’s Day Dash on January 1, 2026 in Long Beach. Whether you’re starting a new training goal, kicking off a resolution, or just looking for a fun way to welcome the year, this race is the perfect blend of fresh energy and festive spirit. Enjoy a beautiful course along the shoreline, the camaraderie of fellow runners, and the satisfaction of logging your first miles of 2026 before most people have finished their coffee. Make this your tradition and dash into the new year with us

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Wednesday
3:00-5:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Thursday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support
A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, and Fountain Valley. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

No FOOLIN' 5K, 10K, & Marathon 

Get ready for a race where the jokes are plenty, but the miles are real! 🤡🏃‍♂️ The No Foolin’ 5K/10K/Half Marathon is the perfect way to kick off April with a lighthearted run 

So lace up, bring your best sense of humor, and come run a race that’s all about fun, community, and good-natured shenanigans. No foolin’—this is one race you won’t want to miss! 🎭🎉

Bib Pick-Up and Start Times


OPEN: 6:15 AM - 7:35 AM
Location: Race Ready Athletics Tent near the start line
Start Times:
Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K: 7:30 AM
 
Parking Information
Free street parking is available or beach lot parking is $2.00 per hour.
 
Awards

Everyone gets a finishers medal 

 

1st, 2nd, 3rd Place Awards
The top 3 male and female finishers in each distance will receive a  placement medal.

name: No Foolin' Foot Race
description:
Explore San Carlos' outstanding trail system as a runner in the fourth annual No Foolin' Foot Race! There's something for everyone with four challenging events through Big Canyon, Eaton and Pulgas Ridge. 

  • 1K (~350ft of climbing) - Perfect for adventurous kids age 5-10

  • 5k (~530ft of climbing)

  • 10k (~1,500ft of climbing)

  • Long Course NEW this year! (15-18K with ~2,500ft of climbing)

Registration opens September 27, 2025. Early bird pricing available through March 18, 2026.

Consider yourself warned: This race is no joke! Our courses are technical, grueling and loads of fun. To that end, we will be hosting training runs in early March. Join our Strava Club for updates.

Start and Finish Festival at Crestview Park. Professional timing; Tech-Ts and free runner photos for all participants; Awards in multiple categories. 

All proceeds benefit maintenance and improvement of San Carlos open space trails. 

Brought to you by the Parks and Recreation Foundation of San Carlos and the City of San Carlos with support from A Runner's Mind.

name: Noyo Headlands Race
description:
Join us on Saturday, August 8, 2026 for the 10th annual Noyo Headlands Race. This year we'll have a half marathon, 10K run, 5k run, 5k fun walk, and half-mile kids' run along the stunning coastal trail in Fort Bragg, CA. Enjoy some of the most remarkable scenery Northern California has to offer and have a great time running with your friends! The oceanfront trail consists of asphalt and soft track, is fairly flat, well maintained, and commonly used by runners year-round.

This race benefits Mendocino Land Trust in its mission to conserve and restore habitat, scenic areas and working lands while also providing public access to beautiful places in and around Mendocino County.

name: NURSES ROCK Run/Walk
description:
Will you run and be their heroes by joining the Nurses Rock Run-Walk 5K-10k & BONNIE CHALLENGE?

We have all learned how incredibly valuable our nurses are to our health care system.  Help us give back to those aspiring nurses through supporting the Bonnie Fang Foundation in our search to support those to keep us alive.  In 2026 we will be offering the live experience and a virtual run to provide the perfect opportunity and flexibility to participate safely while interacting with our nursing and running community live & online to support a great cause.  

Sign up TODAY and join us as we culminate your work on running and our audience of future nurses.  

Whether you run or walk, by yourself or with friends, you will make a HUGE IMPACT for our nurses and the future of the nursing profession!

As we continue with our planning, your support or donation of any kind is always appreciated in that it will go towards helping more amazing nursing students while bringing awareness to the nursing shortage that impacts each and every one of us. 

They are our heroes and you are theirs.  Register NOW and let's get moving!

*START GETTING YOUR GROUPS TOGETHER! AWARDS FOR OUR TOP 3 LARGEST GROUPS!

Directions to Frank G. Bonelli Park
120 Via Verde, San Dimas, CA 91773

Bonelli Park is located on the Northeast corner of the 10 and 57 Freeways in San Dimas, CA.

From San Diego, 5 north to 57 north, cross over the 10 freeway and exit Via Verde Dr.
From Redondo Beach, etc. 10 East to 57 North and Exit Via Verde
From Pasadena-210 to 57 and exit Via Verde
From the East-10 to 57 North and exit Via Verde

Take the Via Verde Dr. Exit off of the 57 Freeway. Head East, down into the park. After entering through the gate, take the second left into the parking lot, additional parking is further east on Via Verde.

*Please note that there is a separate parking fee of $12 for Bonelli Regional Park

name: Oakland Tech 5km Fundraiser Race and 1 Mile Fun Run/Walk
description:
Support Oakland Tech Students and Programs
Join us for a 5K trail race or 1-mile fun run/walk in beautiful Joaquin Miller Park on November 2, 2025 (end of Daylight savings time.) The course winds through towering redwoods and offers both a scenic stroll for casual participants and a challenging route for competitive runners.

This event is a fundraiser for the Oakland Tech PTSA, which provides invaluable funding for student programs and activities. Every dollar makes a difference for our students. The PTSA supports the Oakland Tech Cross Country team by covering costs for meet entry fees, training equipment, nutrition, and travel — all essential for helping our runners perform at their best.

Oakland Tech Cross Country athletes have a proud tradition of success, with both varsity cross country teams winning the Oakland Championship for the past three years. Your participation helps continue this tradition of excellence.

Sign up for the race or make a tax-deductible donation to show your support for Oakland Tech students.

Bib pick-up: Saturday, November 1nd, 2pm-4pm @ Transports or Sunday, November 2rd, 8:30am @Joaquin Miller Meadow

Date: November 2rd, 2024

  • 1 mile Fun Run/Walk Race Start: 9:00 am
  • 5 km Trail Race Start: 9:30 am

Can't run but want to support us? Donations are tax-deductible. Tax ID: 94-6174624

name: Oh! The Places You'll Run – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Congratulations, today is your day, you're off to grab miles, you're off and away! This weekend we run in honor of Read Across America Day!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4:00-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens 
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!

name: On Track Running Turkey Trot
description:
Join On Track Running, Simi Valley’s neighborhood running store, for our first annual Turkey Trot 5k race!

Celebrate Thanksgiving with a flat and fast, chip-timed 5K race!

📍 Thursday, November 27th, 2025
📍 8:00 AM start at 4590 Ish Drive, Simi Valley

All runners are welcome, whether you're chasing a PR or just running for the fun!

🎽 The first 200 registered participants will receive a free race shirt and medal.
🏅 Age group awards for top finishers.

Packet Pickup & Registration:
• Wednesday, November 26th from 1-5 PM at On Track Running
• Race day registration available from 6:30–7:15 AM on site

Bring your friends and family. We’re making it a morning of community, movement, and lighthearted fun!

Course: We’ll start at the store, loop around the building, then head down Ish and turn left to join the bike path alongside the wash. The course is an out-and-back on the wash, with a few harder turns at the water station and at the turnaround point, before heading back down the street and around the building to finish.

Follow us on Instagram @OTRunning and join us on Strava to connect with our crew.
We can’t wait to see you there!

name: OneLegacy Donate Life Run/Walk 2026
description:
OneLegacy Donate Life Run Walk is back!

 

Join us for our 2026 OneLegacy Donate Life Run Walk  to run or walk with your team and celebrate the power of organ, eye and tissue donation. 
Founded in 2003 by local organizers Craig and Kathleen Hostert of Fullerton, the annual OneLegacy Donate Life Run/Walk is the largest event of its kind in the nation. The event features an inspiring opening ceremony, competitive 5K run and healthy 5K/1K walk, followed by a Family Festival with food vendors, live entertainment, special activities for children and a raffle drawing.
A non-competitive 5K/1K Run/Walk to educate and inspire the community about organ, eye, and tissue donation with proceeds benefiting the OneLegacy Foundation.
LOCATION: Azusa Pacific University, 701 E Foothill Blvd, Azusa, California 91702
DATE: April 25, 2026
EVENT SCHEDULE:                 
  • 7:00 am Registration 
  • 8:30 am Opening Ceremony
  • 9:20 am 5K Run/Walk starts
  • 9:40 am 1K Run/Walk starts
  • 7:00 am to 12:00 pm Family Festival with food, opportunity prizes, children's activities, vendors and more!
Please practice social distancing as best you can; we want everyone to be safe and healthy.

description: Operation Megaphone, also known as "OMP", is an annual worldwide event designed to connect military teens from around the world to discuss key issues that affect military teens, promote communication across all military services, and provide opportunities for teens to give back to their communities. name: Palisades Will Rogers 5K Run
description:
For 47 years, the Palisades Will Rogers 5 & 10K Run and Kids’ Fun Run has been a centerpiece of the Palisades’ 4th of July celebration.   The Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation and it’s Presenting Sponsor, Providence Saint John’s Health Center, is doing everything they can to support the recovery effort in the aftermath of the unprecedented fire.   Although the fire destruction and residues have made it unfeasible to hold the event at our traditional location, we are holding a 5K Run and Kids’ Fun Run at Venice Beach this year.  We look forward to neighbors and friends joining us to celebrate all that makes the Palisades such a special community, and enjoy a healthful start to the 4th of July in a safe environment.

Race proceeds this year will go toward rebuilding the Pacific Palisades Park & Community Center, as the Palisades centerpiece for neighbors of all ages to gather and recreate together.  The Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation is also accepting direct donations toward that effort.  Donations may be made through the Foundation’s website at RunSignUp.com, or by mail to Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation, P.O. Box 601, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272.

Sign up now…See you on the 4th of July!

Race Committee

Race proceeds this year will go toward rebuilding the Pacific Palisades Park & Community Center, as the Palisades centerpiece for neighbors of all ages to gather and recreate together.  The Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation is also accepting direct donations toward that effort.  Donations may be made through the Foundation’s website at RunSignUp.com, or by mail to Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation, P.O. Box 601, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272.

Sign up now…See you on the 4th of July!

name: Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Expo
description:
The Palm Springs Health Run & Wellness Festival has now become one of the largest events of its kind in Southern California and follows a spectacularly beautiful path in and around Ruth Hardy Park with picture perfect views of the San Jacinto Mountain Range. Hot, hip and fun is how describe the desert oasis of Palm Springs.

This USA Track and Field certified 10K and 5K event has caught the attention of serious runners and nationally recognized health and wellness speakers.

The Expo has grown substantially since its inception and now has over 100 vendors showcasing the latest in nutrition and exercise techniques, KESQ News Channel 3 Food Challenge, LifeStream Blood Bank Drive, rock climbing wall, walk on water and Aerial performers.

Not only is the event a way for health conscious individuals and families to come together, but it has now become a major fundraiser.

description:
Join us for an unforgettable day of community, celebration, and inclusivity, at the Palm Springs Pride 5K Run & Walk! Whether you're a speedster or a casual stroller, this event welcomes everyone of all ages and abilities to help support our local LGBTQ+ organizations. To ensure a safe, enjoyable, and high-quality experience for everyone, we're capping this year's race at 1,200 participants. If you're thinking about joining us, don't wait too long—spots are filling up fast! Register and secure your spot in this year's celebration of love, resilience, and community pride.
Full event details are available on https://palmspringspriderun.com/.

name: Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race
description:
Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race
 

April 19, 2026 – Mariposa, California

 

A Note from the Race Director
 

Hello everyone! My name is Nate Moore, and I’m excited to share that I’ll be directing the 2026 Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race through my company, San Joaquin Running Co.
We love supporting local community events, especially those that celebrate trail running and the unique beauty of our region. Our goal is to carry forward the traditions that make this race special, while adding the same energy and care we bring to our other events.
Through San Joaquin Running, I help organize a variety of races across the Central Valley and Sierra foothills, including the Shadow of the Giants 50K, Pincushion Hill Climb, McKenzie Preserve Half Marathon, Sycamore Island 5K/10K, and others. Each event is built on the same foundation: creating tough, fun, and memorable experiences for runners of all ages and abilities.
I’m truly honored to help guide the Paseo de Mariposa into its next chapter. Together, we’ll keep this race a family-friendly tradition that highlights the heart of Mariposa and the adventure of trail running.

 

About the Event
 

Nestled in the Sierra Nevada foothills, just outside Yosemite National Park, Mariposa is rich in history and natural beauty — the perfect setting for outdoor adventure. On Sunday, April 19, 2026, join us for the seventh annual Paseo de Mariposa Trail Run, featuring 5K and 12K courses that begin at the historic Mariposa Courthouse (built in 1851, the oldest courthouse west of the Rockies still in use).
This family-friendly community event celebrates health, wellness, and active lifestyles. In support of our mission to engage youth in outdoor activity, all children under 18 can participate in any race for free.

 

Race Distances
 

5K – Family-Friendly & Beginner-Friendly

Shortest and most accessible option.
Starts at the courthouse, with sections on paved roads, a short climb past the high school, and a dirt fire road turnaround.
Perfect for families, walkers, and those new to trail running.
 
 

12K – The Big Adventure

Longest and most challenging route.
Features steep descents, a creek crossing, and a tough single-track climb to Slaughterhouse Road and the Flume Trail.
Stunning views along rugged single-track with significant elevation gain.
No strollers permitted; youth under 13 must be accompanied by an adult.
 

Safety & Support
 

Aid stations will be positioned across all distances.
Mariposa County Search and Rescue will be on site for runner safety.
Trails include technical terrain — rocks, roots, and climbs — so please run or hike your route ahead of time if possible. Bringing a buddy is always recommended.
For everyone’s safety: no dogs are permitted on any route.
 

Why Join?
 

The Paseo de Mariposa is more than a race — it’s a celebration of community, family, and the outdoors. Whether you’re chasing a personal best, enjoying a scenic hike with friends, or introducing your kids to trail running, this event is designed for all ages and abilities.

 

✨ Mark your calendars for April 19, 2026!

We can’t wait to see you in Mariposa for an unforgettable day on the trails.

name: Patagonia Salmon Run 5K
description:
Patagonia is excited to announce the 29th Annual Salmon Run, to be held November 16, 2025.

This year marks the 29th Annual running of the salmon and we are going to make it better than ever. As a reminder, this race always sells out, so make sure you get your registration in.

This year's race beneficiary will be South Coast Habitat Restoration, a local non-profit organization based in Carpinteria that is dedicated to environmental stewardship and habitat enhancement. South Coast Habitat Restoration is actively supporting fish restoration for steelhead trout and locally is working on a fish passage project in the Ventura River watershed at the Wheeler Gorge campground removing four migration barriers and installing two bridges. 

Additionally, we want the Salmon Run to be a Zero-Waste-Event to mitigate sending anything to the waste stream that doesn't have to. We will send out details on how to prepare for this closer to the day of the race, but plan to bring your own water bottle and coffee mug.

 

Please note: 

For race participants, the Patagonia Store located at:

235 W. Santa Clara St

Ventura, CA 93001 

Is excited to offer a 25% off discount if racers bring their bib into the store.  This is a onetime use offer on full priced Patagonia items only and valid from 11/16/2025 through 11/22/2025.

 

Packet pickup will begin at 7:30AM on Sunday, November 16

THERE WILL NOT BE DAY-OF REGISTRATION FOR THE SALMON RUN. ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST REGISTER ONLINE, WHICH CLOSES AT NOON ON MONDAY, NOVEMBER 10th OR WHEN THE RACE SELLS OUT

name: Pie Pursuit
description:
Pie Pursuit 5K — Run for a Cause, Stay for the Fun
Join the 746 Sports Foundation for our inaugural Pie Pursuit 5K, a community-centered fun run with a festive twist! Participants are encouraged to dress in their favorite costumes — from turkeys to pilgrims — and take part in a lighthearted 5K that features family-friendly pie-toss zones along the course.

This unique event is more than just fun and games — it's a fundraiser with purpose. All proceeds directly support local youth through scholarships, free sports events, and community programs organized by the 746 Sports Foundation.

 

Participants will enjoy:

  • Official timed results for those wanting to track their pace

  • Custom Pie Pursuit race shirts and finisher medals

  • Prizes awarded for best costumes, fastest finishers, and most pie-covered runners


Whether you run, walk, or get covered in whipped cream, your participation helps empower the next generation right here in Shafter.

 

Because every pie thrown is a step toward stronger community roots.

name: Pincushion Hill Climb
description:
1 mile. Straight up. This will be a chip timed hill climb starting at the San Joaquin River Trailhead in the South Finegold picnic area (Millerton Lk SRA; end of Sky Harbor Rd) and finishing at the top of Pincushion Mountain. There will be a special prize for the Top 3 Male and Female finishers, age groups winners will receive awards as well as Clydesdale/Athena division winners. All runners will receive a custom finisher award and event shirt. 

Pincushion Hill Climb: Mountain Goat Edition! The Mountain Goat race is for those who like to go the extra mile or miles. Your first run up will be timed and scored for the regular event then you have until 12pm (4hrs total) to complete as many trips up to Pincushion Peak as possible. Your first trip down you must take the long way (just over 1.5 miles) after that you may descend the same route you take to the top. You must complete at least 2 trips to the top in order to be considered a Mountain Goat. You will receive a special finishers award and the top Male & Female runners will receive an additional award.

name: Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

 PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options on Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race, check out the bib pick up tab for the latest.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. Payment of $5 per car may be required Enter the park off La Palma from eastbound or westbound lanes starting at 6:00 AM until approximately 6:45 AM, when the eastbound lanes along the park will be closed for the start of the 10k race. Thereafter, access to the park will be via westbound La Palma only when the course is clear of runners. 

Additional parking is available in the following areas: 1) Paved/gravel lots adjacent to softball fields at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (very limited capacity); 2) residential areas directly across from the park; 3) residential areas west of Fairmont Blvd off Hondo Dr; and 3) on the street and in church parking lots off of the Fairmont Connector between Esperanza and Fairmont Blvd. 

We expect heavy traffic on race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

RACE DAY SCHEDULE - Subject to change, please check the event website in November for final details
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

name: Polar Bear Run 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
Are you ready to embrace winter in all its glory? The Polar Bear Run is calling all runners, adventurers, and cold-weather warriors!
 

Why Calilflow Runs?
CaliFlow Runs is dedicated to creating inclusive, energetic, and community-driven running events that celebrate you. We bring people together to promote health, wellness, and positive vibes through races that are accessible, fun, and infused with the unique culture of the Golden State.
 
Who Can Participate? Everyone - Runners, Walkers, Strollers - All are welcome
 
About Our Courses: Our courses are open, which means you'll be sharing the path with other runners, walkers, and beachgoers. Safety is our top priority, so please stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The courses are well-marked, with water stations and restrooms available along the way.
 

Course Information: https://www.caliviberuns.com/w/CaliVibeRuns/Page/SantaMonicaCourse
 
Bib Pick-Up and Start Times:
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM End 7:35 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
Half Marathon Start Time: 7:00 am
5K, 10K, 15K & 10 Miler Start Time: 7:30 am

 
Start Location:5400 Ocean Ave
Long Beach, CA US 90803

Parking Information:
Street parking is free. Parking machines are $2.00 per hour.
 

Awards: 
The top 3 men and women in each distance will receive a medal.
Podium awards ceremony for 5K/10K at 8:45 AM
Podium awards ceremony for half marathoners at 9:30 AM
 
Frequently asked questions:
 https://www.caliviberuns.com/w/CaliVibeRuns/Page/FAQFrequentlyAskedQuestions

name: Poppy's Run for Life - Berkeley (Fall 2025)
description: Join us for Poppy’s Run - Berkeley, a community event dedicated to raising awareness and supporting those affected by suicide. Set against the beautiful backdrop of UC Berkeley and the surrounding area, this run brings together students, families, and local residents to honor loved ones and advocate for mental health.

name: Pottery Painting at the Hot Spot Liberty Station
description: Get creative with ceramics and paint your own unique piece of pottery at the quirky and beautiful Hot Spot Studio! All supplies and necessary kiln firing is provided so that your food and drink safe ceramic mugs can be taken home to be used or displayed.

name: Pre Reg 2027 Heroes 4 Hearing 5K
description:
This is the registration page for 2027 - if you are looking for info on the Aug 16th 2026- please go to 

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/FountainValley/Heroes4Hearing

 

Place

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

HearAid Foundation presents our 6th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 15th, 2027 in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. 

Join us for an exhilarating run along the marina and water front in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the sea.

Event Details:

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Course Description:

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff .

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 2 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!

We look forward to seeing you adjacent to the aquarium for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

HearAid Foundation presents our 6th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 15th, 2027 in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. 

Join us for an exhilarating run along the marina and water front in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the sea.

Event Details:

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Course Description:

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff .

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 2 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity.

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!

We look forward to seeing you adjacent to the aquarium for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

name: Pre Reg 2027 Torrance Memorial Medical Center, BRA Run, Los Angeles
description:
Day of Event

Our 14th Annual 5K & 13K are held on a fully paved course next to the sand in Playa Del Rey on August 30th, 2026

6:00am: Parking Lots Open (LA County charges $13, bring cash). The line backs up so arrive early. 

7:00am: Registration and Vendor Booths Open

7:05am: Warm up for Bike Tour

7:10am: Bike Tour Starts 

7:30am: Costume Contests

7:40am: Warm Up for 5/13k

8:06am: National Anthem 🇺🇸

8:10am: 13K start (2 hour time limit, 15 min per mile pace or faster)

8:30am: 5K start

10:00am: Kids Run starts (time is approximate and depends on when the last 13K walkers are off so kids can run clear)

10:10am: Awards Ceremony

Share your photos on social media! We are @brarunla and @runmercury and our official hashtag is #brarunla. We will be resharing your posts whenever we can.


Charity

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run. We have the unusual distance of 13K because women have a 1 in 8 risk (or 13%) of having breast cancer in their life. A 13K is also slightly more than 8 miles.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Costume Contest

Dress up in celebration of the BRA Run! Our participants get creative with their attire and we have awards to celebrate. Wear a decorated bra (sports bra, lacy bra, nursing bra, any type of bra) or dress up your shirt! You can wear the bra on its own or over a shirt. Looking for ideas? Here are some of last year's costumes.

Winners will be announced in the following categories:

Female Individual: Best Decorated Bra
Male Individual: Best Decorated Bra
Team*: Best Dressed

*Teams must have 5 or more people to enter the team competitions.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.

Beach to City Challenge

Want to nab an additional medal? Take part in the Beach to City Challenge with the Greta Garbo medal!

Greta Garbo, the cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor, called Culver City home, so we celebrate her with a special medal. If you run both the BRA Run and Screenland 5k (in Culver City) back-to-back, you can claim this bonus bling!

If you ran Screenland 5k 2025 and BRA Run 2025, you can claim your medal at BRA Run 2025
If you run BRA Run 2025 and Screenland 5k 2026, you can claim your medal at Screenland 5k 2026

You can only claim the bonus medal once a year.

Sign up for Screenland 5k 2025 to ensure your Greta Garbo medal. If you register for Screenland 5k at the BRA Run finish line, you'll get a discount on registration.

A list of those who qualify for the medal will be published on the BRA Run website in August before the event. Check to make sure your name is on it!

Thank you so much to ©Harriet Brown Inc. for working with us to bring you the iconic images of the great Greta Garbo that are used in our challenge medals.

name: Pre Reg 2027 Torrance Memorial Medical Center, BRA Run, Los Angeles
description:
Day of Event

Our 14th Annual 5K & 13K are held on a fully paved course next to the sand in Playa Del Rey on August 30th, 2026

6:00am: Parking Lots Open (LA County charges $13, bring cash). The line backs up so arrive early. 

7:00am: Registration and Vendor Booths Open

7:05am: Warm up for Bike Tour

7:10am: Bike Tour Starts 

7:30am: Costume Contests

7:40am: Warm Up for 5/13k

8:06am: National Anthem 🇺🇸

8:10am: 13K start (2 hour time limit, 15 min per mile pace or faster)

8:30am: 5K start

10:00am: Kids Run starts (time is approximate and depends on when the last 13K walkers are off so kids can run clear)

10:10am: Awards Ceremony

Share your photos on social media! We are @brarunla and @runmercury and our official hashtag is #brarunla. We will be resharing your posts whenever we can.


Charity

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run. We have the unusual distance of 13K because women have a 1 in 8 risk (or 13%) of having breast cancer in their life. A 13K is also slightly more than 8 miles.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

name: Pre Reg 2027 Wrigley River Run & Tadpole Trot Presented by Long Beach Clinical Trials
description:
This page is for the 2027 Event, for the event on June 6th, 2026 please visit www.wrigleyriverrun.com for full event information.

The start/finish, expo area and bib pick up will be located in the parking lot of Westland Real Estate Group/Long Beach Beer Lab, at 520 W Willow St, Long Beach, CA 90806.

There is special pricing of only $10 for youth 17 & under who want to do the 5k or the 10k.

The Half Combo is a total of 13.1 miles and includes a 5k and 10 Mile Entry. You will receive a half marathon time as well as a time in each event. You will also receive a bonus medal. There are no age group awards for the Half Combo.

If you have a group of 6 or more contact us about your options for a group discount.

The Wrigley River Run is the Long Beach Neighborhood Foundation’s signature event and is designed to promote community involvement, education, tolerance, and a healthy non-violent lifestyle.  All funds generated from the event are used to benefit youth organizations in Long Beach and the surrounding communities.

name: Pre Registration 2026 - Beverly Hills Run of the Stars
description:
This is the page for the 2026 event! (If you are looking for the event held on Oct 19th, 2025, please click here https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/BeverlyHills/STARS5K) 

 

Lace up and run through the flat, scenic streets of Beverly Hills at this year’s 5K on October 18th, 2026!

 

Run or Walk on your own or on a team!

Can’t make it in person? Join our Virtual Challenge and complete your 5K from anywhere in the world.

We’re also hosting a 1K “Stars of Tomorrow” Kids Race held at the same location right after the 5K- perfect for young runners ready to shine! (Note: All ages are welcome to participate in the 5k but only those under-10 can registers for the 1k.)

 

This event supports NOT TODAY CANCER and their mission to find a CURE for devastating childhood cancers. 
 
Despite childhood cancer rates being on the rise, a desperately small amount of US Federal Funding for Cancer Research goes to children. 
 
When Mason was 9 years old he was diagnosed with T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).  His cancer was treated with chemotherapies that have been in use for decades, because there is a devastating lack of funding for new treatments with better outcomes!  
For two years, Mason and his family used the slogan “Not Today Cancer'“ as their mantra and when he died from the disease, the journey continued and this local non-profit was founded in Mason's honor. Scientists are close to a cure to help children like Mason and you can help! 
 
NOT TODAY CANCER 

 

Packet Pick Up, where you can get your shirt and bib, on Saturday, the day before the race. Time and Location TBD. 

If you are having someone else pick up your bib, shirt, and bag, they will need two things. A printed copy of your ID and a printed signed copy of the waiver. You can download and print the waiver here.  No bibs will be given out without this. The lawyers and our insurance company require us to be strict on this, sorry for the inconvenience.

If you are unable to join us the day before, you can pick up your bib and shirt on race day in the festival area but get there early and be prepared to wait in line on race day.
*Reminder: Please wear your bib on the front of your clothes so that your photos can be tagged and so we know you are with the event.*

DAY OF RACE INFO: https://www.nottodaycancer.care/ntc-run

RACE PARKING:  TBD

Race Day Schedule:

TBD

name: Pre-Registration 2026 Plymouth Rock n Run
description:
Please visit https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/Anaheim/PlymouthRocknRun to sign up for the 2025 Plymouth Rock n Run or to view results or photos. This site is only for 2026 early registration. 

 

Get ready to lace up your running shoes and join the fun at the most exciting event in Anaheim, CA!

It's all happening on Thanksgiving Day, at  La Palma Ave, right in the heart of beautiful Yorba Regional Park. We've got a fantastic day of activities and races planned for you, so let's dive into all the exhilarating details:

Event Highlights:

🏃‍♂️ USATF-Certified Courses: We've got both 5k and 10k courses that'll take you on a thrilling journey along La Palma Ave and the enchanting Santa Ana River Trail, all while you soak in the natural beauty of Yorba Regional Park.

⏱️ Chip Timing: For those competitive spirits, we've got chip timing for the 5k and 10k run/walk events. Race against the clock and challenge yourself to a new personal best!

👦👧 Kids' Fun Run: Calling all young runners! We've got a Kids 1k fun run for those aged 10 and under, and even a 100-yard tot trot for the little ones aged 4 and under. It's a blast for the whole family!

🥇 Awesome Awards: The top male and female finishers in both the 5k and 10k races will receive special awards. Plus, medals three deep for top runners in 18 different age categories. Everyone's a winner!

🏅 Custom Finisher Medals: You won't want to miss our custom-designed diecast finisher medals for all 5k/10k and kids run/trot participants. It's a race souvenir you'll cherish!

👕 Stylish Shirts: Participants in the 5k and 10k get cool shirts in adult unisex, women's, and youth sizes. Show off your accomplishment in style!

👫 Team Spirit: Gather your friends and form a team of 8 or more – you'll enjoy fantastic discounts! There are also team competitions with awards for the biggest, fastest, and highest fundraising teams.

🎉 Finish-Line Festival: The fun doesn't end at the finish line! Join us at the finish-line festival for a costume contest, live music, delicious food, freebies, and tons of entertainment for adults and kids of all ages. It's a celebration like no other!

PACKET PICK-UP 
Multiple options are planned for the Saturday, Tuesday and Wednesday leading up to the race day. Check out the bib pick up tab for the latest details as they are confirmed and follow us on social media for the fastest updates.


LOCATION/PARKING 
The event staging area is located at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (7300 E La Palma, Anaheim Hills, CA 92807), just past the softball fields near the 5k/10k start line. 

Parking is available inside Yorba Regional Park. Payment of $5 per car may be required Enter the park off La Palma from eastbound or westbound lanes starting at 6:00 AM until approximately 6:45 AM, when the eastbound lanes along the park will be closed for the start of the 10k race. Thereafter, access to the park will be via westbound La Palma only when the course is clear of runners. 

Additional parking is available in the following areas: 1) Paved/gravel lots adjacent to softball fields at the west end of Yorba Regional Park (very limited capacity); 2) residential areas directly across from the park; 3) residential areas west of Fairmont Blvd off Hondo Dr; and 3) on the street and in church parking lots off of the Fairmont Connector between Esperanza and Fairmont Blvd. 

We expect heavy traffic on race day morning; carpooling and early arrival is strongly recommended!

PRELIMINARY RACE DAY SCHEDULE - SUBJECT TO CHANGE
6:00 AM - Late registration/packet pick-up 
7:00 AM - 10k start 
8:00 AM - 5k start
8:40 AM - 5k & 10k overall winners announced* 
9:00 AM - Kids 1k fun run & 100ish-yd tot trot (tot trot first, followed by 1k) 

* Age group winners will not be formally announced; runners can claim their medals at the awards table shortly after they finish. The top three overall participants are based on gun time, the first to cross the finish is the winner, and age group awards are based on chip time.

Get ready for an unforgettable day of fitness, fun, and community spirit. We can't wait to see you at the starting line! 🏃‍♀️🥳🏆

name: Pre-Registration Screenland 5K 2027
description:
This is only the Early Registration page for the 2027 event, please go to

https://runsignup.com/Race/CA/CulverCity/Screenland5K  or https://www.screenland5k.com for more information about our event on March 1st, 2026 and to sign up.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our start studded Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.

All participants will receive commemorative bib, official time, medal and shirt and on course support and entertainment, entrance into the post race party and free downloadable event photos among many other perks.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the 5K at Screenland and then either the 5K or the 13K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run in August at Dockweiler Beach .  If you missed Screenland in the spring, you can start the challenge at BRA Run in August and finish it at Screenland the following year.

We update the list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K  at www.BRArunLA.com.

name: Project Youth OC - 2025 OC Marathon
description:
Join Us for the 2025 OC Marathon and Support Project Youth OC!

Since 2004, Project Youth OC has proudly partnered with the OC Marathon as an official Charity Partner. This year, we're celebrating 21 years of making a difference through this incredible event!

The OC Marathon offers something for everyone:

  • 5K Walk/Run: Saturday, May 3, 2025, at the OC Fairgrounds.
  • Marathon & Half Marathon: Sunday, May 4, 2025, starting at Fashion Island and finishing at the OC Fairgrounds.When you join our team, you’ll help empower youth and strengthen families across Orange County.

Every dollar raised through peer-to-peer fundraising goes directly toward life-changing mentorship, education, and support services for over 1,500 youth and their families each year.

Together, we can run, walk, and fundraise for a brighter future!

Thank you all for your support!

name: Race for Open Space
description:
Big Sur Land Trust's 2026 Race for Open Space is a one-day trail running event dedicated to fostering an appreciation of natural spaces in Monterey County and celebrating the health benefits of time spent in nature. This annual event invites runners and hikers of all ages to find wonder among Monterey County’s most iconic landscapes. This time of year will provide participants with sweeping views of green ridge lines punctuated by colorful wildflowers.

Centered around Palo Corona Regional Park, participants are invited to choose their adventure by registering for a 5K, 12K, 25K, or 35K+ trail run. Each course promises a spectacular journey through sections of the Palo Corona Backcountry, normally closed to the public. A one-mile Fun-Run will be offered for individuals of all ages and abilities.

Race for Open Space’s technical partner, Inside Trail Running, will oversee the start/finish line, trail-marking, aid stations, and participant timing/results. All activities will be offered in compliance with public health and safety guidelines. Our community is deeply passionate about our mission to inspire love of land across generations, conservation of our unique Monterey County landscapes, and access to outdoor experiences for all. 

On the day of the event, community partners and businesses such as Alvarado Street Brewery will help participants celebrate crossing the finish line with beer, food, and interactive tabling displays.

description:
Big Sur Land Trust's 2026 Race for Open Space is a one-day trail running event dedicated to fostering an appreciation of natural spaces in Monterey County and celebrating the health benefits of time spent in nature. This annual event invites runners and hikers of all ages to find wonder among Monterey County’s most iconic landscapes. This time of year will provide participants with sweeping views of green ridge lines punctuated by colorful wildflowers.

Centered around Palo Corona Regional Park, participants are invited to choose their adventure by registering for a 5K, 12K, 25K, or 35K+ trail run. Each course promises a spectacular journey through sections of the Palo Corona Backcountry, normally closed to the public. A one-mile Fun-Run will be offered for individuals of all ages and abilities.

Race for Open Space’s technical partner, Inside Trail Running, will oversee the start/finish line, trail-marking, aid stations, and participant timing/results. All activities will be offered in compliance with public health and safety guidelines. Our community is deeply passionate about our mission to inspire love of land across generations, conservation of our unique Monterey County landscapes, and access to outdoor experiences for all. 

On the day of the event, community partners and businesses such as Alvarado Street Brewery will help participants celebrate crossing the finish line with beer, food, and interactive tabling displays.

name: Race to Cure Sarcoma Los Angeles
description:
The Race to Cure Sarcoma (RTCS) Los Angeles brings together hundreds of members of the community who have been impacted by this disease. Each year, the Sarcoma Foundation of America raises awareness and funds for much-needed research, through RTCS events across the country. JOIN US for our annual event in Los Angeles! 

TOGETHER WE CAN FIND A CURE.

name: Race to the Flagpole
description:
The Race to the Flagpole is a community oriented race through beautiful wine country in Livermore California. The event is organized by the Livermore Granada Boosters, a local organization that has been celebrating the excellence of scholar athletes in Livermore since 1949. 

We accomplish our mission by promoting scholar athletic events with thousands of photos/video posted on our website, social media, and newsletter. Throughout the year, we recognize top individual and team achievements with Wall of Fame photos, posted throughout the community. At the end of each school year we host our Olympian Banquet for all varsity athletes and coaches. At this event, we recognize high character athletes of Livermore and Granada High Schools in 70 Varsity Sports. We induct past athletes into the Livermore Hall of Fame and award $16,000 in Scholarships to the top boy and girl student athletes from each high school.

All proceeds from the Race to the Flagpole supports these activities.

name: Radiant Futures 5K
description:
We’re lacing up for a purpose! Join us for the 3rd Annual Radiant Futures 5K: SOLE Purpose, where every step you take helps build a safer, more radiant community. Together, we’ll walk, run, and move forward in solidarity with survivors, raising awareness and support to end domestic violence and human trafficking.

This year’s 5K Run/Walk takes you through the beautiful Fountain Valley Sports Park and the scenic Mile Square Regional Park. This year's, will NOT be a certified 5K Run/Walk due to construction. 

All participants will receive a finisher medal, finish line photos and video, and access to the post-race celebration expo.

Bring your energy, your community, and your sole purpose, to make every stride count for safety, healing, and hope.

Register today before spots fill up!
