name: Toddler Tuesday: Patrol Puppies and Firehouse Friends
description: Join us for a fun-filled morning designed just for little ones! Toddlers will get to meet a famous firefighter pup and explore a real firetruck up close. Kids can crawl, climb, and play on soft play mats and building blocks, making it the perfect mix of adventure and safe playtime.

name: Torrance Memorial Medical Center, BRA Run, Los Angeles
description:
Day of Event Schedule

Our 14th Annual 5K & 13K are held on a fully paved course next to the sand in Playa Del Rey on August 30th, 2026

5:15am: Parking Lots Open (LA County charges $13, bring cash). The line backs up so arrive early. 

6:15am: Registration and Vendor Booths Open

6:30am: Bike Tour Starts 

7:05am: Costume Contests

7:16am: National Anthem 🇺🇸

7:30am: 13K start (2 hour time limit, 15 min per mile pace or faster)

7:50am: 5K start

9:30am: Kids Run starts (time is approximate and depends on when the last 13K walkers are clear of the kids run course)

9:45am: Awards Ceremony

Share your photos on social media! We are @brarunla and @runmercury and our official hashtag is #brarunla. We will be resharing your posts all week post-race!


Charity

In its 14th year, The BRA Run supports Evelyn’s BFF, a charity that helps breast cancer survivors get back to their new normal while supporting counseling, reconstruction, and other items that people are often not able to get covered by their insurance. Most of our grant recipients have bills going into 6 figures! This event is the biggest fundraiser for this all volunteer organization and determines how many people they can help this year.

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.


Location

12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach
Playa Del Rey, CA US 90293

Evelyn, the founder of the Evelyn's Breast Friends Forever (BFF), a 501(c)3 non-profit public benefit charity foundation, started this event in 2013 and in her honor we have a 5K and a 13K at the BRA Run.

Join us for Evelyn's party so we all can help other breast cancer survivors and their families. Our event spreads awareness of breast cancer reconstruction to the community by encouraging men and women to run and walk in their BRA (Breast Reconstruction Awareness) in honor and in memory of those who have been diagnosed with breast cancer.

Donate to Evelyn's BFF.

Make it a Virtual Run/Walk

Can't make it in person but want to be a part of the event and support breast cancer survivors? Sign up for the virtual run and we will mail you a bib, shirt and medal.

12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach

name: Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5k
description:
Get ready to join the community for the 23rd annual Tulare Santa Fe Trail-A-Thon 5k, hosted by the Tulare Sunrise Rotary Club! This fun and impactful event supports the club’s High School Scholarship Program, which in 2024 awarded a $5,000 4 year college and a $1,500 trade school scholarship to two Tulare High School seniors. 

Event Details:

Date & Location: The race begins and ends at Live Oak Park, Tulare, offering a scenic route and plenty of space to enjoy the day.

 

Time: Onsite registration and bib pickup will run from 8:00 am to 8:45 am, with the race starting promptly at 9am.

 

Registration: This year we are charging a registration fee of $15 per participant. This fee helps cover the costs of the finisher and winner medals and the timing system costs. We will also accept donations this year.

Awards and Prizes:

Finisher Medal: All finishers will receive a commemorative medal and lanyard and Rotary participant pin.

 

Age Group Awards: Medals will be awarded to top finishers in each age group: 9 & Under, 10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60+ (Male and Female).

 

Fastest Runner Awards: The top male and female runners will each receive a special trophy and $100 gift card!


Sponsor Opportunities:

Want to help make a difference in the lives of local students? Consider becoming a sponsor! Contact Matthew Hamilton at matt@hamiltonmarketing or Petrus Tjandra at ptjandra@aol.com for more information.

 

Join us for a memorable morning on the Santa Fe Trail as we come together to support education and enjoy some friendly competition. See you on race day!

name: Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk - Los Angeles, CA
description:
Place, Date, and Time


November 9th, 2025

8:30 am - Opening Ceremony

9:00 am - Race Start Time

Woodley Park

6350 Woodley Ave - Section 1

Van Nuys, CA 91436

__________________________________

Description

 

What is a Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk?
The Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk Series was created to honor the heroic life and death of Stephen Siller, a New York City firefighter (FDNY) who lost his life on September 11, 2001 after strapping on his gear and running through the Brooklyn Battery Tunnel to the Twin Towers. The Tunnel to Towers Foundation supports the families of catastrophically wounded and killed first responders and veterans through their Fallen First Responder and Gold Star Family programs, which provides mortgage free homes and smart homes to these families in need. In 2021, the Foundation sought out to eradicate the issue of homelessness within our veteran community by providing housing and support to any veteran experiencing homelessness. For more information on the Tunnel to Towers Foundation, please visit www.t2t.org.

This will be our 1st Annual Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk in Indianapolis and we are excited to grow the community’s commitment  to honor first responders, remember 9/11, and raise funds for the Tunnel to Towers Foundation.

 


How far is a Tunnel to Towers 5K Run, Walk, & Climb – Los Angeles?
This is a 5K (3.1 miles). You are welcome to walk or run this event.

 

What is the best time to register?
The best time to register is always RIGHT NOW. Registration is tied to a price tiering system where the price increases occur one week after the opening of registration, one month before the event, and on race day. 

 

What is the age limit?
There is no age limit. All are welcome!

 

Is there parking available?
Please carpool if you can, and parking is available in the lots around Woodley Park.  

 

Where can I pick up my packet?
We will have early packet pick-up at a site and place TBD and announced closer to the event. Additionally, packet pickup will be available on event day morning.

 

Can someone else pick up my packet for me?
Yes, they can.

 

Do I have to wear my bib number?
Yes, please display your bib on the front of your outermost garment. Those who run without a bib will be asked to leave the course and will not be allowed to finish.

 

I am a fast runner. Can I get a front line position?
Runners predicting a faster pace may make their way to the front of the line, based on space availability (hint: arrive early!).

 

Will the Event be timed?
Yes, the event will be timed. You are also more than welcome to use a smartphone, or watch to keep up with your own time.

 

Will water be available?
There will be water available at the start/finish. There will be very limited water at the start and finish line. Please hydrate before the event starts, or bring water with you if necessary. 

 

Will there be food at the event?
We are working with local food trucks and vendors to bring food on-site at the event.

 

What can you bring to the event?
You will be responsible for all of your personal belongings you bring to the event. Please leave anything that you do not want to run/walk with locked securely in your vehicle.

 

Can I run with a stroller, backpack, wheelchair, roller blades, bicycle, etc?
You can participate with a stroller, wheelchair, and/or backpack. No roller blades, bicycles, or pets.

Please leave all personal items and valuables in your vehicle. All items should be stored securely at the owner's risk. T2T will not be responsible for the loss of any items.

 

What should I wear if I am participating?
The general public should wear comfortable clothes and shoes. We encourage everyone to wear patriotic colors and carry flags if you would like. We LOVE to see Red, White, and Blue! Military and first responders, we encourage you to wear your gear/uniform, or anything that signifies what department or branch you serve. 

 

How can my company/organization sponsor this event?
Please send all sponsorship correspondence with your contact information to losangelesrun@t2t.org and someone will be in touch with you within 24 hours.

 

What does a corporate sponsor receive?
Based on the level of financial commitment, sponsors are able to receive a fabulous package of promotional opportunities, prominent logo placement, registration passes, and a chance to align your company's name with a top event benefiting a national non-profit. Contact us at losangelesrun@t2t.org.

 

I would like to donate goods or services to this event. How do I do that?
Contact us at losangelesrun@t2t.org. We make every effort to keep costs down to allow us to give the most to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation. Your generosity will be so appreciated.

 

Where does all the money raised get allocated?
All funds raised from Tunnel to Towers 5K Run Los Angeles will be donated to the Tunnel to Towers Foundation for many of their programs. The mission of this Foundation is to honor the sacrifice of firefighter Stephen Siller who laid down his life to save others on September 11, 2001. We honor our military and first responders who continue to make the supreme sacrifice of life and limb for our country. 93% of all money donated to the Foundation goes directly into their programs to help fallen first responders and veteran families.

 

If I win an award and am not present for the award ceremony, where can I pick it up?
Please contact us via email at losangelesrun@t2t.org  and we will do our best to make arrangements to get your award to you.

 

As a participant, can I fundraise/encourage others to donate?
Yes! Once you are registered, you will be given directions to start your own fundraising page and you will be able to accept donations online. Do you want to donate cash/money? We can help you with that. Contact us at losangelesrun@t2t.org  and we can walk you through the process or you can send donations directly to Tunnel to Towers Foundation - ATTN: Tommy Mazza - 2361 Hylan Blvd., Staten Island, NY 10306 - please give us your information so we can add it to your fundraising page.

 

Does my registration fee count towards my fundraising goal?
Registration fees help offset some of the expenses associated with making the Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk one of the country’s greatest annual events, however your fundraising efforts enable us to help first responders and continue building smart homes for the most catastrophically injured service members.  To show our appreciation for your time, passion, and effort, we recognize each fundraising milestone that is reached with prizes branded with the Tunnel to Towers logo.

 

What are the fundraising levels & prizes?
You can find the fundraising incentive levels here. 

 

Can I get a refund? Can I transfer my registration?
Unfortunately, ALL SALES ARE FINAL and we do not allow refunds. However, you may transfer your registration to another participant. For instructions on how to transfer your registration, please email us. 

 

How can I volunteer?
It's simple! Click on the volunteer option while above and enter your information to sign up. Thank you!

 

Will I receive an event T-shirt?
Your registration fee includes a T2T Los Angeles event T-shirt. However t-shirts are not guaranteed for participants that register on race day. To guarantee you receive a 2025 event T-shirt, you must register by October 21st.

 

Are friends and family that are not registered allowed to attend?
Of course!  They can cheer you on at the start, course or  finish line.

name: Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk - Santa Rosa, CA
description:
What is a Tunnel To Towers Run & Walk?
The Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk Series was created to honor the heroic life and death of Stephen Siller, a New York City firefighter (FDNY) who lost his life on September 11, 2001, after strapping on his gear and running through the Brooklyn Battery Tunnel to the Twin Towers. Honor all of those who lost their lives on September 11, 2001, and support our first responders and military who make extraordinary sacrifices in the line of duty! For more information on the Stephen Siller Tunnel to Towers Foundation please visit www.T2T.org.

This will be the first year in Santa Rosa and we are excited to once again bring together the community to honor first responders, remember 9/11, and raise funds for the Tunnel to Towers programs. 

How far is a Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk?
This is a 5K (3.1 miles) walk or run event. Anyone can run, walk, or experience this event.

Can I register on the day of the run?
Yes. Registration will open at 7 am the morning of the run. There will be a $5 late registration fee for those who choose to register on the morning of the race for all registrants except for First Responders. If you wait to register, we may not have a shirt for you and we can not guarantee sizes for late registrants.

When does online registration close?
Online registration will remain open until the start of the event. If you register after packet pick-up, you may not receive your t-shirt and any other race day swag.

Does my registration come with a T-shirt?
If you register before October 20th you are guaranteed a shirt. People who register after this date are not guaranteed a shirt and will get one as supplies last.

Can I transfer my registration to another participant?
Yes. See the information above OR contact us at santarosarun@t2t.org and we will manually change it in our system.

Can I get a refund?
We do not provide refunds for the event regardless if you cannot make the date or the foundation needs to cancel the event for extenuating circumstances. Registration may be transferred to another person.

Do I have to wear my bib number?
Yes, please display your bib on the front of your outermost garment. Those who run without a bib will be asked to leave the course and will not be allowed to finish.

I am a fast runner. Can I get a front-line position?
Runners predicting a pace faster than 6 minute/mile will be seeded in the front corral (arrive early!)

Will there be awards for running?
Yes, awards will be given out to the top 3 runners in each category: male/female Overall, male/female first responders in gear, top 3 boy/girl teen, top 3 boy/girl child

What can you bring to the event? Can I run with a stroller, backpack, wheelchair, roller blades, bicycle, etc.?
Strollers and wheelchairs are permitted. Firefighter turnout gear and military backpacks are also permitted. Please leave all personal items and valuables in your vehicle. All items should be stored securely at the owner's risk. Tunnel to Towers Foundation will not be responsible for the loss of any items.

Will water be available?
Yes, a water station will be available along the route and there will be water available at the start/finish line.

Is there a medical staff available on-site?
Yes, there will be an Emergency Medical Service team available on site. There is also radio communication available on the course to help communicate with the EMS.

Where can I pick up my packet?
Packet pickup will be available on race day starting at 7:15 am. We will also hold early packet pickup at Santa Rosa Plaza (1071 Santa Rosa Plaza, Santa Rosa, 95401) in center court near the Charlie Brown statue and Sephora, from 3:30 to 8: pm on Thursday November 6th

Can someone else pick up my packet for me?
Yes, they can. They must present a copy of your registration receipt. And don't forget to thank them!

How can my company/organization sponsor this event?
Please send all sponsorship correspondence to santarosarun@t2t.org with your contact information or call 347-708-9391.

I would like to donate goods or services to this event. How do I do that?
You can contact us at santarosarun@t2t.org.

As a participant, can I fundraise/encourage others to donate?
Yes! Once you are registered, you will be given directions to start your own fundraising page and you will be able to accept donations online. Do you want to donate cash/money? We can help you with that. Contact us at santarosarun@t2t.org and we can walk you through the process.

Does Tunnel to Towers offer fundraising incentives?
Yes, we offer fundraising incentives each year; check out our latest in our Fundraising Guide. To qualify, complete your fundraising by June 30, 2025, for winter and spring events, or December 10, 2025, for Summer and Fall events.

Does my registration fee count towards my fundraising goal?
Your registration fee does not count toward the fundraising goal.

Can I still donate to a team and/or individual after the start of the race?
Yes. Donations will be accepted for 6 weeks after the event on the race registration website.

Where can I mail an OFFLINE donation (check made payable to Tunnel to Towers Foundation)?
Please mail any offline donations to:

Tunnel to Towers Foundation
ATTN: Thomas Mazza-Santa Rosa
2361 Hylan Blvd.
Staten Island, NY 10306

name: Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk - Santa Rosa, CA
description:
What is a Tunnel To Towers Run & Walk?
The Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk Series was created to honor the heroic life and death of Stephen Siller, a New York City firefighter (FDNY) who lost his life on September 11, 2001, after strapping on his gear and running through the Brooklyn Battery Tunnel to the Twin Towers. Honor all of those who lost their lives on September 11, 2001, and support our first responders and military who make extraordinary sacrifices in the line of duty! For more information on the Stephen Siller Tunnel to Towers Foundation please visit www.T2T.org.

This will be the first year in Santa Rosa and we are excited to once again bring together the community to honor first responders, remember 9/11, and raise funds for the Tunnel to Towers programs. 

How far is a Tunnel to Towers Run & Walk?
This is a 5K (3.1 miles) walk or run event. Anyone can run, walk, or experience this event.

Can I register on the day of the run?
Yes. Registration will open at 7 am the morning of the run. There will be a $5 late registration fee for those who choose to register on the morning of the race for all registrants except for First Responders. If you wait to register, we may not have a shirt for you and we can not guarantee sizes for late registrants.

When does online registration close?
Online registration will remain open until the start of the event. If you register after packet pick-up, you may not receive your t-shirt and any other race day swag.

Does my registration come with a T-shirt?
If you register before October 20th you are guaranteed a shirt. People who register after this date are not guaranteed a shirt and will get one as supplies last.

Can I transfer my registration to another participant?
Yes. See the information above OR contact us at santarosarun@t2t.org and we will manually change it in our system.

Can I get a refund?
We do not provide refunds for the event regardless if you cannot make the date or the foundation needs to cancel the event for extenuating circumstances. Registration may be transferred to another person.

Do I have to wear my bib number?
Yes, please display your bib on the front of your outermost garment. Those who run without a bib will be asked to leave the course and will not be allowed to finish.

I am a fast runner. Can I get a front-line position?
Runners predicting a pace faster than 6 minute/mile will be seeded in the front corral (arrive early!)

Will there be awards for running?
Yes, awards will be given out to the top 3 runners in each category: male/female Overall, male/female first responders in gear, top 3 boy/girl teen, top 3 boy/girl child

What can you bring to the event? Can I run with a stroller, backpack, wheelchair, roller blades, bicycle, etc.?
Strollers and wheelchairs are permitted. Firefighter turnout gear and military backpacks are also permitted. Please leave all personal items and valuables in your vehicle. All items should be stored securely at the owner's risk. Tunnel to Towers Foundation will not be responsible for the loss of any items.

Will water be available?
Yes, a water station will be available along the route and there will be water available at the start/finish line.

Is there a medical staff available on-site?
Yes, there will be an Emergency Medical Service team available on site. There is also radio communication available on the course to help communicate with the EMS.

Where can I pick up my packet?
Packet pickup will be available on race day starting at 7:15 am. We will also hold early packet pickup at Santa Rosa Plaza (1071 Santa Rosa Plaza, Santa Rosa, 95401) in center court near the Charlie Brown statue and Sephora, from 3:30 to 8: pm on Thursday November 6th

Can someone else pick up my packet for me?
Yes, they can. They must present a copy of your registration receipt. And don't forget to thank them!

How can my company/organization sponsor this event?
Please send all sponsorship correspondence to santarosarun@t2t.org with your contact information or call 347-708-9391.

I would like to donate goods or services to this event. How do I do that?
You can contact us at santarosarun@t2t.org.

As a participant, can I fundraise/encourage others to donate?
Yes! Once you are registered, you will be given directions to start your own fundraising page and you will be able to accept donations online. Do you want to donate cash/money? We can help you with that. Contact us at santarosarun@t2t.org and we can walk you through the process.

Does Tunnel to Towers offer fundraising incentives?
Yes, we offer fundraising incentives each year; check out our latest in our Fundraising Guide. To qualify, complete your fundraising by June 30, 2025, for winter and spring events, or December 10, 2025, for Summer and Fall events.

Does my registration fee count towards my fundraising goal?
Your registration fee does not count toward the fundraising goal.

Can I still donate to a team and/or individual after the start of the race?
Yes. Donations will be accepted for 6 weeks after the event on the race registration website.

Where can I mail an OFFLINE donation (check made payable to Tunnel to Towers Foundation)?
Please mail any offline donations to:

Tunnel to Towers Foundation

2361 Hylan Blvd.
Staten Island, NY 10306

name: Turkey Day Trot-  5K & Family 1-Miler
description:
🦃 Turkey Day Trot: Stride for Peace 5K + Family 1-Miler
📍 Crescent Bay Park — 2000 Ocean Ave, Santa Monica, CA 90405
📅 Thanksgiving Morning — Thursday, November 27, 2025
⏰ Check-In Opens: 7:00 AM | Event Begins: 8:00 AM

     This is an UNTIMED Event

Bib Pick/Runner check is on event day. You will pick up your number prior to

the event kick off. Check in opens at 7:00 AM 

 

🌅 Start Your Thanksgiving with Purpose


Gather your loved ones and begin your Thanksgiving morning with gratitude, movement, and meaning.
The Turkey Day Trot: Stride for Peace is an untimed, family-friendly event featuring a 5K Stride for Peace and a Family 1-Miler along the beautiful Santa Monica shoreline.

Walk, stroll, or stride—there’s no rush, just fresh ocean air, good company, and a spirit of togetherness.

 
💫 Event Highlights:


5K Stride for Peace — Scenic, peaceful, and community-centered
Family 1-Miler — Perfect for kids, grandparents, strollers, and all abilities
Coastal views and festive photo ops
Finisher medals for every participant
Free event-day photos
Post-stride music, refreshments & finish line festival fun
 
🗺️ The Course
Begins and ends at Crescent Bay Park
Follows the Santa Monica Beach Path with ocean views
Water stop at North Beach Playground
Clearly marked turnaround points
Returns to the park for celebration and photos
 
💜 Striding for a Cause

We’re proud to partner with Merge Opportunities, a Long Beach–based nonprofit creating pathways to employment, education, and empowerment for individuals facing barriers to work.

Their programs provide hands-on job training, mentorship, and community support — helping participants build confidence, develop skills, and achieve long-term stability.

During registration, you’ll have the opportunity to donate directly to Merge Opportunities, ensuring every stride helps create meaningful opportunities and stronger communities for all.

 
🌿 Remembering Lala – Walking for Love & Healing
This year’s Stride for Peace is inspired by Remembering Lala, honoring victims of domestic violence and supporting survivors on their path to freedom and healing.

The holidays can be difficult for many, and domestic violence reports increase by up to 30% during this season.
By striding together, we raise awareness, offer compassion, and take steps toward a future where every home is safe, and every heart is free.

 
🧡 Join Us
Make this Thanksgiving morning more than a meal — make it a movement.
Bring your friends, your family, your pets, and your gratitude. Together, let’s stride for peace, healing, and hope.

name: Turkey Trot 5k Fun Run
description: Get ready to move at the Turkey Trot 5K & Fun Run on Saturday, November 29th at 10:00 AM! Join us at Coach B’s (2527 University Ave, San Diego) for a festive morning of fitness and fun. The run kicks off at 10 AM sharp—so lace up your running shoes and bring your best costume! Fun and creativity are highly encouraged, with prizes awarded for the best costumes. After crossing the finish line, stick around for the post-run celebration featuring fresh donuts, a live DJ, cold plunge recovery, and leg compression therapy and prizes. Whether you’re walking, jogging, or just cheering, it’s the perfect way to kick off small business Saturday with some of your favorite local small businesses!

name: UCSD
description:
Discover a new side of UC San Diego!

Join us for an urban orienteering adventure across one of California’s most dynamic campuses—where sun-soaked coastal bluffs meet cutting-edge research facilities, and hidden courtyards give way to modern architectural icons.

Established in 1960, UC San Diego spans over 2,178 acres in beautiful La Jolla—right by the Pacific. It’s home to distinctive landmarks such as Geisel Library, lush eucalyptus groves, and the winding “Snake Path” sculpture at the heart of campus.

Whether you’re a first-timer or a seasoned navigator, this event invites you to explore the campus like never before—map in hand, compass set, and ready for discovery. Bring your friends and find your way through this vibrant campus maze of research hubs, plazas, and hidden gems.

This event is co-hosted by the UCSD Orienteering Club - go Tritons!

Event Team:

  • Event Director: Rachael Qian
  • Course Setter: Kaushik Komandur
  • Visit the Volunteer page to learn how to help with the event.
    • See "Volunteer" at the top right of the page. 🔝
    • Volunteers receive up to a $20 credit toward a race registration fee.
    • Volunteer roles explained in detail

Format: Traditional 

Map:  scale  1:7500  |  5m contours

Courses: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced

​Starts: 10am to 11am

name: Ukiah Turkey Trot
description:
Get ready for an exciting Thanksgiving tradition like no other! Join us for the Ukiah Turkey Trot prediction runs, featuring two distances, prizes, and scenic courses at Lake Mendocino. Participants need to predict their finishing times before the race, and the winners will be those who come closest to their predicted times. Closest times win a Turkey ($100 gift card to Co-op). The second & third best predictions win Thanksgiving Pies. The fastest male and female by time also win awards. NO TIMING DEVICES ALLOWED.

The course at Lake Mendocino offers different experiences for both distances. The 5K is a stroller-friendly paved out and back run, perfect for families and runners looking for a picturesque route. Meanwhile, the 10K is a challenging course that takes participants through both paved and single-track trails, promising some adventure and breathtaking views.

Don't miss out on this memorable event! Register now for the Ukiah Turkey Trot prediction runs and be a part of this Thanksgiving Day celebration of fitness and community.

name: United Health Centers Foundation Fun Run
description:
Get ready to lace up your sneakers for the 4th Annual Fun Run! The UHC Foundation is excited to host this year's event on Saturday, March 28, 2025, at Woodward Park (Art of Life Area). Whether you're up for the 10K Run, 5K Run, 2 Mile Walk, Mascot Race, or the Kids' Races (divided by age group), there's something for everyone. We’d love your support—join us as a sponsor, runner, walker, or cheerleader! Every dollar raised will help provide top-notch medical, dental, vision, and specialty care at United Health Centers, break down barriers to life-saving healthcare, and train the next generation of primary care clinicians. Let's run, walk, and race to make a difference!


Our 10K is a 30 point Central Valley Runner of the Year Series Race.

Sign up for the UHC Foundation Fun Run today and start chasing your fitness goals and those sweet cash prizes!

name: VALENCIA Trail Race
description:
Run the VALENCIA Trail Race, run the awesome trails and killer hills with breathtaking views of the Santa Clarita Valley in a 10K, Half Marathon, or 50K Ultra race. For runners who love to run great trails and want to accomplish a good challenge. Prepare to take on the Awesome Trail Challenge in Valencia, California. Southern California features a diverse range of nature and terrain, giving runners a wide variety of spectacular trails and running experiences. Located north of Los Angeles up against the California State park boundaries is Valencia, a suburban community that is surrounded by hills and mountains featuring awesome trails to be experienced.

Registration is now open with course distances for all types of runners to offer a variety of challenges. Experience a course that takes you up challenging hills to the peaks and along the ridgelines with panoramic views, then into the canyons and valleys for a truly awesome trail challenge.  Registration is available on VALENCIATrailRace.com or on the popular Active.com running network. 

Learn more at >> VALENCIATrailRace.com

name: Valentines Live, Love, RUN 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
💘 Celebrate love and fitness this Valentine’s Day with our charming Valentine's Run! Whether you’re running solo, with a partner, or with friends, this event is all about spreading love and joy. Enjoy a scenic route adorned with chocolates and fun photo ops!

❤️ Join us for a day filled with laughter, community spirit, and a post-run celebration featuring treats and goodies. Bring your love for running and let’s make this Valentine’s unforgettable! Sign up today and let the love run wild!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Ventura Turkey Trot
description:
2025 - Event Registration 

Grab your friends and family and join us for the festive Ventura Turkey Trot 5K & Kids 1K. This loop course is fast and flat, so come out and sweat with us before you sit down for your Thanksgiving feast.

All registrants in the 5K and Kids Run will receive a custom finishers medal. Plus choose from our fun 2024 Turkey Trot Shirt or Mug.

Packet Pick Up

Wednesday, November 26th from 1pm - 5pm at Mile 26 Running Co (2222 E Thompson Blvd, Ventura, CA 93001)

Thursday, November 27th (Race Morning) - At the Race (Hofer Dr just off King at the Ventura Auto Center) starting at 7:00am. 

 

Food Drive

Please bring non-perishable food items, such as canned meats, legumes, fruits, or vegetables. They will be donated to the food drive being held by the Ventura County Area Agency on Aging, which is a division of the Ventura County Human Services Agency.

 

Start Times

5K - 8:00am

Kids 1K - 9:15am

name: Veterans Day Run
description:
The annual Veterans Day Run & Walk takes place each year on November 11 in Downtown Porterville before the Veterans Day Parade.  It features a 10K run, 5K run, 5K walk and free kids fun run.  Finish the race and stay for one of Porterville’s largest parades of the year.  The low cost pre-registration entry fee includes a bib and long-sleeved commemorative shirt that is designed special each year.  Plus, there is a discounted rate of $10 for veterans and those in active military duty (please note, you are only allowed to enter one coupon per transaction.  If you need to register multiple participants that are veterans/ active duty, please register them in separate transactions).

Don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions:  parks_leisure@ci.porterville.ca.us or (559) 791-7695.

name: Vibha Bay Area Dream Mile 2026
description:
Vibha Bay Area's The Dream Mile

5K / 10K / Half Marathon /Virtual

 

2100 ISHERWOOD WAY, FREMONT, CA, 94536 (USA)

SUNDAY, JUNE 7, 2026

Flat courses with minimal elevation changes.

All registered participants will receive a t-shirt and a finisher's medal.

All proceeds go towards causes supported by Vibha.

                                                    

What is Dream Mile?
The first Dream Mile was organized by Vibha volunteers in Atlanta in October 1998. The Dream Mile is a Run / Walk Fundraiser event organized by Vibha, with the anticipated participation of 1,000 patrons from across the greater San Francisco Bay Area.  The Dream Mile has become a permanent fixture on the calendars of runners in various cities across America. To date, The Dream Mile has raised more than $3M to support upwards of 180,000 children.

Who is it for?
The Dream Mile is for anyone who would like to walk or run a few miles to help realize the dreams of millions of underprivileged children.

  • To learn more about Vibha, visit Vibha.org
  • To learn more about Vibha in India, visit India.Vibha.org
  • Follow Vibha on Facebook(VibhaOrg), Instagram(@Vibha_Org), Twitter(@VibhaOfficial)
  • Follow Vibha in India on Facebook(VibhaIndiaOfficial), Instagram(@VibhaGlobalOne), Twitter(@Vibha_In_India)

What are the Race Distances?

The Dream Mile 2025 consists of 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon running/walking events

What is the Virtual Option?
Cannot join us at The Dream Mile on race day?  Sign up for the VIRTUAL option!

  • Choose the VIRTUAL option and do any challenge category.
  • Run your race on your own or with your friends - any day, anywhere, anytime - between now and race day.
  • Email proof of completion to DreamMile@Bayarea.Vibha.Org.
  • Pick up your medal and t-shirt at one of the bib distribution locations.

Highlights:

  • 5K/10K/Half Marathon courses
  • Professional chip-based timing
  • Half Marathon Pacers for 7 different pace groups to help achieve your HM PR
  • T-shirts for all registered participants (unless you opt out)
  • Finisher medals for all distances for registered participants

* In case the in-person event is canceled due to any unforeseen circumstances, the event will be held virtually. No refunds will be provided.

Registration information:
The online registration will be open till Sunday, June 1st, 2025. Please register by April 15th to guarantee your t-shirt size choice. After that, the t-shirt size is based on availability.

We highly recommend you register online by Friday, May 30th, to avoid disappointment due to race day registration unavailability due to your choice of race distance selling out. Only if there are any open spots left at the close of the online registration, we will offer registrations at the race packet pickup and the race day morning up to 30 minutes before the race starts.

Up to 10 participants can register together in a single registration transaction. For more than 10 participants registering together, please do multiple registration transactions.

For registration instructions:  https://help.runsignup.com/support/solutions/articles/17000062676-register-for-a-race

name: Visalia Emergency Aid Race Against Hunger
description:
Visalia Emergency Aid's (VEA) Race Against Hunger is on the most thankful day of the year, and we are so thankful that YOU are joining us!

We are recognized as the largest timed Thanksgiving 5K Run in the Central Valley, with over 6,000 participants! However, we are more than a race - we are building community! As a participant, you'll not only join thousands of runners and walkers from the Central Valley, but you'll also be able to say that you are helping the Visalia Emergency Aid Council ensure that no child goes to bed hungry in Tulare County. All funds raised go straight to our food pantry programs, ensuring that local households in need are connected with the food resources they require. Step by step, this race is making a tangible difference in our community! That's how we turn Miles Into Meals!

description:
RACE LOCATION: 

CUTLER PARK, 15520 Ivanhoe Drive, Visalia, CA. 93292

4th ANNUAL VISALIA HALF MARATHON & 10K - YOU DON'T WANT TO MISS OUT ON THIS RACE!

 

Race Start Time: 7:30 AM

 

10K Hydration/Aid Stations: Mile 2.0 & 4.0 (Water & Gatorade) Porta Potty at Mile 1.5 & 4.6

Half Marathon Hydration/Aid Stations: Mile 2, 3.8, 5, 5.9, 6.55, 7.2, 8, 9.2, & 11

This Course is FLAT & FAST with paved trails, closed roads, DJ’s, and MORE! 

 

At the Finish Line, you will be welcome back with your Custom Finisher’s Medal, Hot Breakfast, Chocolate Milk, and a Post-Race Celebration In The Park that will Rock & Celebrate YOU! You’ll want to stay around and relax in the park with your running buddies!

Whether you Run or Walk, you'll want to join this memorable experience in the beautiful setting of Cutler Park & St. John's River Trail.

description:

name: Volunteer Opportunity: Feeding San Diego
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE SIGNING UP

MWR VADM Martin Liberty is volunteering at Feeding San Diego on Thursday, November 13, 6pm - 8pm to aid with food sorting at their Distribution Center. This two-hour, hands-on volunteer shift may include cleaning fresh produce, packing boxes of food, or sorting through food that has been donated. This is a great opportunity to give back to our local community. 

Register online to join our volunteer group (volunteer cap -12 people). Beginning November 6th, MWR Liberty will contact all signups by email. Signups will be required to confirm they are volunteering no later than November 12, 2025. Every helping hand counts, and we want to ensure all spots are filled to maximize our impact. If you can no longer make it, please notify us no later than November 12th. 

MWR Liberty transportation is provided and will depart from VADM Martin Liberty Center at 5:15pm. Please arrive a few minutes prior to ensure we leave on time. Select your preferred transportation plans during registration. An LOA will be provided for your community service hours. Volunteers can expect to receive their LOA within 7 days of their completed shift.

Waitlist

If we reach volunteer capacity (full registration), please email us to be placed on a waitlist. We will contact you if space becomes available and will also notify you of future related volunteer opportunities.

name: Waffle Run
description:
Waffle Run Hosted by Huckleberry's (Fresno-Clovis)

Join us for the Waffle Run, a fun and delicious way to kick off your holiday season while supporting a great cause! Whether you’re an avid runner or just looking to enjoy a scenic walk, our event offers both a 5K and a 2-mile distance on the beautiful Clovis Old Town Trail.

 

Starting and finishing at the California Health Sciences University, this is the perfect opportunity to work off that turkey and earn a well-deserved waffle breakfast!

 

As you lace up your running shoes, know that every step you take contributes to a meaningful cause. A portion of all proceeds, along with your generous donations, will go directly to the Poverello House, an organization dedicated to helping those in need in our community.

 

Youth Pricing: Special pricing for youth 12 and under.  Includes Medal, Shirt, and Breakfast Coupon.

 

Choose Your Distance: Participate in the 5K run or take a leisurely stroll on the 2-mile route—perfect for families and all fitness levels!

 

Waffle Breakfast: After the race, join us at Huckleberry's to enjoy a delicious waffle combo breakfast featuring a half belgium waffle, 2 eggs and choice of bacon or sausage. Fuel up and celebrate your accomplishment with fellow participants!  You can redeem your waffle breakfast on race morming, or any day before January 1st.

 

Bib tear-off coupons valid at these locations:

 

Huckleberry’s

  • 222 E Bullard Ave, Fresno
  • 4360 W Shaw Ave, Fresno
  • 2100 Clovis Ave, Clovis

Support a Great Cause: Your participation helps provide essential services to those facing challenges in our community.

 

Gather your friends, family, and fellow waffle enthusiasts for a day filled with fitness, fun, and philanthropy. Don’t miss out on this unique opportunity to indulge in waffles while making a positive impact.

 

Register now to secure your spot and join us in supporting the Poverello House!

 

Let’s make this a waffle-filled day to remember! 🧇✨

name: Walk for Jenna's Joy: Mental Health Awareness
description:
This event is a walkathon on April 26th, 2025 in El Dorado County (EDC). This walkathon will raise money for the non-profit Jenna Sue Souza Furst Memorial Scholarship Fund which provides scholarships and a free therapy session to local high school students within EDC. The walkathon aims to spread mental health awareness with an emphasis on our youth. The trail will start at the Placerville Town Hall, go through main street, and loop back to Placerville Town Hall, utilizing the EDC trail at the end.

The registration at the event will begin at 8am and will close at 10am. The walk will begin at 9am. T-shirts and raffle tickets will be available for purchase on this website and at the event. Local businesses will be donating fantastic and generous raffle prizes.

name: Walk for Water 5k
description:
Walk Their Journey. Change Their Future.

Join us for a powerful and transformative experience at the Walk for Water 5K Charity Fundraiser, co-hosted by Pathway To Tomorrow and Drop of Water. This isn’t just a walk—it’s a step into the daily reality that millions of women and girls in Africa face just to access something as basic as water. 

Every day, women and girls spend 200 million hours hauling unclean water, often walking miles under a burning sun, along dangerous paths, carrying heavy containers. Every two minutes, a child dies from a water-borne disease, and 1.5 million children under five die annually in Africa from diarrhea caused by unsafe water. 

Ethiopia, Africa’s second most populous country, is in the grip of this devastating water crisis. Nearly half of its 125 million people lack access to clean water, according to UNICEF.

The situation is even worse in rural areas — where 80% of Ethiopians live and are hit hardest by this crisis, forcing women and girls to walk long distances just to find unclean water. Girls are expected to miss school to collect water for their families. Each journey robs a girl of her education, her safety, and her childhood. For far too many, these walks end in tragedies, like gender-based violence and death — not just exhaustion.

We walk not just for awareness—but for action.

This 5K fundraiser challenges participants to take 7,000 steps, representing the average distance many walk each day to collect water. As you walk, you’ll carry not just steps—but stories. Stories of resilience, hardship, and hope. You'll walk in solidarity with those who can’t just turn on a tap.

We’re asking each participant to go further by asking friends, family, and coworkers to sponsor their steps with a donation to the cause, or join their team to fundraise or walk alongside them!

Our goal? To raise $250,000 to fund 2 deep borehole wells and rural piping systems in up to 16 rural villages in Ethiopia. This will provide clean, safe, and sustainable drinking water for up to 16,000 people. 

Your steps can change a life. Your walk can build a well.

Register today. Walk their path. Bring water home.

The 5K route is along the Main Trail at Griffith Park - 4800 Crystal Springs Drive, Los Angeles, CA 90027

The course is flat, scenic and shaded, covering the perimeter of the golf course.

name: Waves & Whales 5K Trail Run
description:
The annual Waves & Whales 5K Trail Run‐Walk is held on the Mendocino Coast in Point Arena. Taking full advantage of the location, the run takes place on the Point Arena-Stornetta Unit of the California Coastal National Monument. The course begins behind City Hall in the conifer forest off Highway 1, makes its way to the coast where it follows the bluffs, and then winds back into the pine and cypress forest.

Proceeds from the Waves & Whales Trail Run support ACORN Partners in Education’s environmental stewardship program, Students Protecting the Coast, which engages youth in hands‐on learning with a focus on conservation and community outreach. Students Protecting the Coast began during the 2012‐13 school year as part of the local and national campaign to include the Point Arena‐Stornetta Lands in the California Coastal National Monument. Students continue to learn about our coastal landscape and are empowered to use their voice by sharing what they’ve learned with the community.

ACORN is committed to hosting a sustainable event that honors the natural landscape and educates the larger community. The Waves & Whales Trail Run promises to be a worthwhile coastal excursion—runners can expect a rejuvenating run surrounded by natural beauty and the knowledge that they are supporting the continued stewardship of this land by, and for, the next generation.

  • Hikers welcome.
  • Participants receive organic cotton t‐shirt and snacks. (Register early to ensure a t-shirt in your size.)
  • Age categories and awards. (Hand-made award medallions from Point Arena Tileworks.)

name: We Run Oakland: For Our Children 2026
description:
Announcement

Join DO & A Sista's Touch for our 9th annual charity, 5K, to raise Human Trafficking Awareness. We are excited to announce that the planning for the 9th annual 5k walk/run event is underway! Staying committed to social justice and our communal effort to stand in the fight against human trafficking in a bold way, the goal this year is to increase our engagement with an even larger community, increase registrations by a minimum of 10%, and reach a goal of over 275 registrations.  We look forward to seeing you on August 22nd (Location TBD). 

Race location and Route TBD! 

 

5K Your Ways - Virtual 5k Option: 

If you cannot participate in the event in person, you can also show your support by participating virtually. With the virtual option, you can choose where and how you participate in the 5k/3.25 mile distance. You can stay indoors (treadmill/stationary bike) or map out the distance in your neighborhood or another safe open space. You can run, walk, or ride a bike, whatever your pleasure; we just want you to share space with us to show solidarity in the effort to stop human trafficking. Once you finish your physical activity, enter your results so you can be added to our results board. You will have until September 23rd to enter your numbers. And just like that, you will have supported local nonprofit organizations that provide services to those impacted by human trafficking, supported AST programming, physically challenged yourself, and increased your knowledge on how you can help in the fight to stop human trafficking. 

The Cause -

STOP HUMAN TRAFFICKING! 

As we continue our mission to cultivate Black Excellence through the inspiration of African-American women, it is important that we also do the work to ensure our children are healthy and whole. Taking on the role of advocate in the community, this civic engagement event provides us the opportunity to assist in the efforts of mitigating the perils of human trafficking, which is, unfortunately, impacting the African-American community in the Oakland/Bay Area.

The We Run Oakland: For Our Children series is an annual family/community event designed to focus on our collective responsibility to STOP human trafficking. Through the partnerships of local organizations, the main goal is to bridge the gap between community, resources, and self-care. We hope you will join us in our effort to educate the community in understanding the vastness of this epidemic on a local level and demonstrate how the collective can make incremental changes to achieve positive outcomes.

name: Wheel Be Spinning: A Cozy Fall Pottery Class
description:
Nothing says fall like a cozy indoor activity. Pottery making is usually broken down into two main categories: wheel-thrown and hand-built ceramics. In this class you will learn the fundamentals of wheel pottery. This class welcomes all skill levels. Just bring yourself and a willingness to get a little muddy.  

*Liberty is pleased to offer this art class at a special reduced price as part of larger efforts to increase military access to the arts and skills classes. Class is open to Active Duty E1-E6 only. 

 

What to wear

Please wear closed-toed shoes. Recommended to wear a short sleeve shirt. 


 The address of the studio we will be visiting is found below:
Mud Lily ** 2888 Adams Avenue ** San Diego, CA 92116 **

name: Wild Rose Half Marathon & 5K
description:
Wild Rose Half Marathon & 5K
Saturday, May 16, 2026 – 8:30 AM
Pleasant Grove Bike Path, Roseville, CA (start/finish at Moksa Barrel House)

The brand new Wild Rose Half Marathon & 5K is blooming in Roseville this spring! Starting at Moksa Barrel House, runners will enjoy smooth paved trails, fresh air, and a new PR!

  • Half Marathon: A unique forked out-and-back on the Pleasant Grove Bike Path with less than 240ft of elevation gain. Flat, fast, and ideal for chasing a personal best.
  • 5K: A popsicle loop through William Hughes Park with just 40ft of elevation gain. Short, fun, and welcoming to runners of all levels.

All Half Marathon & 5K Runners will receive their choice of a Wild Rose technical shirt or BOCO running hat, a finishers medal, plus a drink ticket from Moksa Brewing Co. (21+). Walkers will receive a finishers medal and a drink ticket. After the race, stick around for raffle prizes from our sponsors.

Presented by Bad Luck Run Club

name: Winter Runderland 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon. Kids Dash
description:
🎄✨ Winter Runderland — The Most Wonderful Run of the Year!
Clip on those bells, grab your crew, and make Long Beach your very own North Pole with sand. Jingle all the way, CaliFlow-style!

 

🎅❄️ Winter Runderland 5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 (Easy Parking)
📅 Sunday, December 7, 2025
✨ Where jingle bells meet running shoes and holiday cheer hits full speed! ( We provide the Jingle Bells, you provide the running shoes)

 
🕕 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times


📦 Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM to 7:35 AM (@ Race Ready Athletics Tent)
🏁 Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 7:30 AM
⚠️ No late starts — Santa waits for no one (he’s on a global schedule).

 
🛍️ Pre-Race Packet Pick-Up – Hosted by Lululemon
📍 6460 E Pacific Coast Hwy Unit 115, Long Beach, CA 90803
🕓 Thursday, December 19 | 4 PM – 7 PM

Avoid the race-mas stress. Swing by early, grab your gear, and maybe pick up something cozy and shiny.
🎁 Free 90-minute garage parking.
📸 Picking up for a friend? Bring a photo of their ID.
(Note: Lululemon elves won’t have race answers — but our Race Ready crew will!)

 
🎄 About the Event
Welcome to Winter Runderland, where snowflakes meet shoreline vibes and everyone on the “nice list” gets a medal!

Clip jingle bells to your shoes and jingle-jangle down the coast like you’re leading Santa’s warm-weather reindeer squad. It’s a holiday tradition with a Cali twist — ocean breeze, twinkle lights, and the sound of bells in rhythm with your stride.

 
🎁 What You’ll Get
🏅 Custom Holiday Finisher Medal (looks good under a tree or on Insta)
⏱️ USATF-Certified Course + Professional Chip Timing
🎶 DJ spinning holiday remixes at the Finish Line Festival
📸 Epic Photo Ops every few steps — elves not included (but encouraged)
📷 Free Race Day Photos for your memories and memes
🥇 Age-Group & Overall Awards — show off your “run-deer” speed
🍪 Finish-Line Snacks + Hot Cocoa + Candy Canes
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations every 2 miles
🎭 Festive Costume Contest!
 – Most Festive Outfit 🧣
 – Best Group / Family Theme 🎁
 – Most “Extra” Holiday Spirit 💃

🎅 Special Guest: Santa Claus!
He’s trading the chimney for the coastline — wave, snap a selfie, or tell him what PR you want for Christmas!

 
🅿️ Parking & Event Info
🚗 Free street parking
💵 Beach lot $2/hr (Passport app or machine)
🚻 Restrooms near the start
👶 Stroller & walker-friendly
🏁 Fully marked, flat, fast course with sleigh-worthy views

💫 Know the Difference


Other event companies may operate in the same areas, but the CaliFlow Runs experience is one of a kind.

If you’ve found our races and love our vibe — the community, the energy, the photos, the finish line fun — make sure you’re signing up for the real thing.

Before registering, always look for the CaliFlow Runs name or logo so you know you’re joining our event — where every race is built with heart, inclusivity, and good vibes only. 💙✨

 
☀️ Weather & Safety
This event is RAIN or SHINE — because elves don’t cancel.
(Only postponed for tidal waves or zombie reindeer 🧟🦌 — we’ll email you if that happens.)

 
💫 Join the Holiday Movement
Post your sparkle and tag @CaliFlowRuns + #WinterRunderland #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!
Don’t miss #FreeEntryFriday — Santa isn’t the only one giving presents this season.

name: Winter Whirl – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Bundle up… or don’t! It's California! Winter Whirl is spinning into Long Beach where the only flurries are the kind that come from the waves. While the rest of the world is shivering, we’re keeping it cool with sunny miles, festive fun, and just a hint of pretend winter magic. Whether you’re chasing a shiny new PR or just cruising the path with a smile, this run is all about coastal cheer with a wink at the season.

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
1:00-4:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon & 10-mile start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More About the Course

This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Womble Rumble
description:
Beneficiary~
Proceeds from this event will go to the Lodi High School Track & Field Program and the Lodi Track Club.

Course~
Both the 5K and 10K (two loops of the 5K) are flat on mostly paved road.  Figure eight'ish loop with one side approximately two-miles and the other approximately 1-Mile. Both the Kid's .5 Mile and 1-Mile are on paved road. 

Fees~
Kid's .5 Mile and 1-Mile $30
5K/10K Run $40.
Fees include custom T-shirt (*Registered before November 12, 2025 at 11:59 AM) and post race refreshments.

T-Shirts~
Free race t-shirts to all pre-registered runners (registration must be received by November 11, 2025 @ 11:59 AM.)  T-Shirts and sizes not guaranteed thereafter.

Early Packet Pick-Up~
Will be held 11-21-25 at 6pm at IDOL Beer Works in downtown Lodi

Directions~
From Hwy 99 take Turner Rd., 1.5 miles west to the entrance to the park. 
From I5, take Turner Rd. east to the entrance to the park.

name: Women's History Month Virtual 5K with Foundation for Women Warriors
description:
Register today for Foundation for Women Warriors' Women’s History Month Virtual 5K. Registration is free!

 

Whether you plan to run, walk, hike, or bike – log your miles in honor of the trailblazing women who defied societal norms. We encourage you to participate in honor of a woman in history who inspires you and to share her story!

 

Rally your own team! Become a captain and recruit your running team. Captains get a free tote bag with teams of 4 or more. Look for this option in the registration portal to set up.

 

Don’t forget to post who you are running for and your results on social media! Tag us for a chance to win the various prizes below:

→ The first runner to post results will receive a FFWW tote bag.

→ The runner to post the fastest time will receive a $25 Running Warehouse gift card.

→  Become a team captain and receive a tote bag with teams of 4 or more.

→ The runner /captain to post a group photo with the most friends or family that participated will receive a $25 Running Warehouse gift card and FFWW magnets for everyone in their group.

→ All runners who tag us on social media will be entered in a giveaway! On April 1st, three lucky runners will be selected receive a $25 Running Warehouse gift card.

 

You can go a step further in supporting our woman veteran community by hosting your own 5K fundraiser through the registration portal with these easy steps:
1. Select the “Sign Up” button on this page.
2. Begin filling in the fields with your information.
3. Once you get to the donation page, click “Become a Fundraiser” and set your goal.
4. After you register, you have the option to share your fundraiser via Facebook and/or you can copy the link to share on your other socials. You will also be able to access your fundraiser via the link in your confirmation email.

 

COMPLETE YOUR RUN/WALK BY MARCH 31ST, REGISTER TODAY!

name: Woodland Turkey Trot
description:
Presented by Title Sponsor Dignity Health

Start your Thanksgiving morning with a fun, family-friendly tradition that supports Yolo Food Bank.

Runners and walkers of all ages are welcome, with race distances for kids and adults winding through the city of Woodland. Whether you’re chasing a personal record or enjoying a relaxed stroll, the Woodland Turkey Trot is the perfect way to kick off your holiday with fitness, laughter, and community spirit

Enjoy fresh coffee from Gallery Coffee and delicious breakfast options from Brunch-in-a-box. Stick around for the medal ceremony and join us for the afterparty at Blue Note Brewing Company(10am - 12pm) in downtown Woodland

Arrive at least 30 minutes early, or trot virtually in your own neighborhood to join the fun from anywhere!

name: Wrigley River Run & Tadpole Trot
description:
Visit www.wrigleyriverrun.com for full event information.

The start/finish, expo area and bib pick up will be located in the parking lot of Westland Real Estate Group/Long Beach Beer Lab, at 520 W Willow St, Long Beach, CA 90806.

There is special pricing of only $10 for youth 17 & under who want to do the 5k or the 10k.

The Half Combo is a total of 13.1 miles and includes a 5k and 10 Mile Entry. You will receive a half marathon time as well as a time in each event. You will also receive a bonus medal. There are no age group awards for the Half Combo.

If you have a group of 6 or more contact us about your options for a group discount.

The Wrigley River Run is the Long Beach Neighborhood Foundation’s signature event and is designed to promote community involvement, education, tolerance, and a healthy non-violent lifestyle.  All funds generated from the event are used to benefit youth organizations in Long Beach and the surrounding communities.

name: Yosemite Half Marathon
description:
The Yosemite Half is a mostly-downhill, scenic course through the Sierra National Forest just outside Yosemite National Park, finishing right in front of beautiful Bass Lake. In May, the lake is full and the waterfalls are pumping, so there is truly no better time to visit!


Race Details
Date: May 9, 2026
Location: Bass Lake, CA
Terrain: Mixed, road and trail
Course type: Point-to-point

The Yosemite Half Marathon sells out quickly every year, so don't wait. Register today and join us!

name: Zoom Angel Island
description:
Angel Island is a hilly, grass- and forest-covered island that provides spectacular views of Marin County, San Francisco, and the Golden Gate. Trails and roads circle the entire island and climb Mount Livermore. Bring the whole family and enjoy a post-run picnic at beautiful Ayala Cove.
(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: Zoom San Francisco
description:
All races start/finish at East Beach and head West along the popular Golden Gate Promenade. The 5K event climbs up Battery East trail to the Golden Gate Bridge before heading back to the finish. The 10K and Half Marathon courses continue underneath the Golden Gate and follow the Coastal Trail to Baker Beach with spectacular views of the Pacific Ocean along the way. The 10K turns around at the Baker Beach aid station while the Half Marathoners head through Seacliff and continue along Coastal Trail to the turnaround at Lands End overlooking the historic Sutro Baths.
(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: ‘A CHARLIE BROWN CHRISTMAS 5K/10K’ (Los Angeles, CA)
description:
In 2025, A Charlie Brown Christmas turns 60 years old! Join us as we honor six decades of timeless holiday cheer, iconic characters, and heartwarming tradition on Saturday, December 13th at Griffith Park right in the heart of Los Angeles (Flat and Fast, Out-And-Back Course in the park). The Snoopy Kids Dash kicks off the event at 7:10am followed by the 5K at 7:30am and the 10K at 8:15am.
ALL participants will receive a festive top-notch, Officially Licensed Peanuts® finisher medal, participant bib, and performance tech t-shirt.  There will also be an appearance by Santa and Post-Race Refreshments! So, come out and show everyone your best holiday attire and spirit! 
Don't wait long to join the fun! This event will be very limited to the first 2,000 participants and this event 100% sold out in 2023 & 24'! This event is a part of the ongoing ‘Peanuts® Event Series’, with over 100,000 participants that have participated in the series across all 50 U.S. States!⏰
